title: Negogiation and Creator Partnership Specialist
description:
Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

About the Role

We are looking for a persuasive and highly organized Creator Partnerships Specialist to act as the closer for our ambassador program. While our sourcing team identifies the best short-form creators, your role is to take those qualified leads, initiate contact, and successfully bring them onboard.

You will manage the entire lifecycle from the first outreach message to signing the final sponsorship agreement and tracking their live deliverables. IMPORTANT: WE HAVE STRICT EXPECTATIONS FOR HOW MANY CONFIRMED CREATORS YOU ARE ABLE TO DO IN A WEEK. YOU MUST BE ABLE TO CONFIRM AT LEAST 5-15 CREATORS PER WEEK.

What You’ll Do

Outreach & Pitching: Take warm and cold leads from our sourcing database (focusing on micro-influencers, sports tipsters, and live streamers) and pitch our ambassador and referral programs.

Negotiation: Negotiate rates, deliverable timelines, and usage rights, ensuring agreements align with our budget and marketing goals.

Contract Management: Draft, send, and execute sponsorship agreements. You will be responsible for ensuring all terms are clearly understood by the creator.

Onboarding: Distribute creator briefs, unique referral links, and any necessary assets, ensuring creators have everything they need to succeed.

Tracking & Compliance: Monitor creator channels (TikTok, Instagram, etc.) to confirm when content goes live. Ensure posts adhere to the agreed-upon briefs and track the initial performance/referral metrics.

What We’re Looking For

Deal Closer: Proven experience in influencer marketing, talent management, or sales, with a track record of successfully negotiating and closing creator deals.

Bilingual Fluency: Native-level fluency in Spanish and English is required, as you will be communicating and negotiating daily with creators based in Mexico and across Latin America.

Niche Familiarity: Comfort working with sports, tech, or gaming commentators, understanding standard rates and expectations for micro-influencers in these spaces.

Highly Organized: Exceptional ability to manage multiple overlapping negotiations, keep CRM/tracking sheets perfectly updated, and herd cats when creators miss posting deadlines.

Tactful Communication: The ability to be firm on contract terms and deliverables while maintaining a positive, relationship-building tone with talent.

title: Technical SEO Developer (Hands-On, Performance-Driven)
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Technical SEO Developer who can implement SEO changes directly, not just recommend them.



This role is for someone comfortable working inside CMS files, templates, and codebases to improve crawlability, performance, and keyword rankings. If your experience is mainly content SEO, reporting, or tool-based optimization, this role will not be a good fit.



What You Will Do

 • Audit and implement technical SEO fixes related to:

 • Crawlability and indexation

 • Site architecture and internal linking

 • Canonicalization and rendering issues

 • Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile performance

 • Work directly within:

 • WordPress (themes, plugins, core files)

 • Shopify (Liquid templates, SEO constraints, performance)

 • PHP-based platforms (e.g. OpenCart or similar)

 • Implement structured data and technical enhancements at code level

 • Optimize websites for traditional search and AI-driven search experiences (GEO / GSEO)

 • Take ownership of ranking performance and SEO KPIs

 • Use SEO tools to diagnose issues, but rely on implementation, not automation alone



Required Skills & Experience

 • 3+ years of hands-on technical SEO implementation

 • Comfortable editing live websites and templates

 • Working knowledge of:

 • HTML, CSS, JavaScript (rendering understanding required)

 • PHP and Shopify Liquid

 • Experience working directly inside:

 • WordPress, Shopify, and PHP-based e-commerce platforms

 • Strong understanding of:

 • Google Search Console

 • Ahrefs / Semrush

 • Screaming Frog, Lighthouse, GTmetrix

 • Able to clearly explain why SEO actions are taken and how they affect rankings

 • Good command of spoken and written English



Nice to Have

 • Experience with SQL or Python / Node.js for SEO automation

 • Practical exposure to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AI search)

 • Proven examples of technical changes leading to ranking improvements



Important Notes

 • This is not a strategy-only or reporting-only role

 • Candidates who rely mainly on plugins, widgets, or third-party apps without understanding the underlying technical mechanics will not be suitable

 • You must be comfortable implementing changes yourself

title: Book Keeper (Australia)
description:
Bookkeeper — anew Australia

Location: Australia (remote/hybrid considered) Reports to: GM / CEO

Employment type: Part-time (flexible, depending on candidate)

About anew

anew is a New Zealand-founded sustainable beverage brand producing plant-based, reusable bottles filled with naturally alkaline spring water. Our Australian business has scaled quickly — reaching 450+ doors in its first month of launch, with partners including BP, Ampol, Really Good people and the Provedores. As the AU business grows, we're looking for a detail-oriented Bookkeeper to own the books for our Australian entity, with scope to grow into a broader role across our NZ and US operations as the business expands.

The role

You'll own day-to-day bookkeeping for anew Australia (Anew Australia Pty Ltd), working closely with the finance and operations team to keep the books accurate and current as we scale distribution and retail partnerships. This is a hands-on role for someone who's comfortable working independently and wants to grow with the business — the AU entity is the starting point, with the opportunity to take on NZ and US bookkeeping as our multi-entity finance function develops.

Key responsibilities

Maintain accurate, up-to-date financial records for anew Australia in Xero

Process accounts payable and accounts receivable, including supplier invoices, distributor and retail customer payments, and reconciliations

Perform regular bank reconciliations in AUD

Reconcile sales and inventory data flowing from Shopify, Upstock, Zoho and 3PL/fulfilment partners into Xero

Support month-end close, including journal entries, accruals, and prepayments

Manage GST reporting and BAS lodgement, liaising with external accountants as required

Track distributor and retail partner invoicing and payment terms as the partner network grows

Maintain organised, audit-ready financial records and supporting documentation

Support ad hoc reporting and financial administration as the AU business scales

As the role grows: support bookkeeping and reconciliation across anew's NZ and US entities, and contribute to multi-entity consolidated reporting

About you

Proven bookkeeping experience in Australia, with solid knowledge of GST and BAS requirements

Strong working knowledge of Xero (essential); experience with Zoho One, Shopify, or 3PL/logistics platforms is a strong plus

Comfortable working independently and managing competing deadlines in a small, fast-moving team

High attention to detail and a methodical approach to reconciliation and record-keeping

Clear communicator, comfortable flagging discrepancies and working with non-finance stakeholders

Interested in growing into a broader, multi-entity finance role as anew expands

Bookkeeping qualification (e.g. Certificate/Diploma in Accounting, or working toward) preferred but not essential with sufficient experience

Why join anew

You'll be joining a lean, fast-growing sustainable brand at an exciting stage of its Australian launch — with real scope to shape financial processes now and grow into a wider role across our NZ and US markets as anew scales.

title: SURGERY MEDICAL BILLER
description:
We are seeking an experienced Medical Biller with a strong background in surgical billing and out-of-network (OON) claims who can manage the entire billing cycle from claim submission through final payment.

We need someone who understands that billing does not stop when a claim is submitted. The right candidate knows how to track claims, identify payment issues, work denials and underpayments, communicate with payors, and take the necessary steps to get claims paid correctly.

Responsibilities

Manage professional medical billing from claim creation through final payment

Bill and follow up on surgical and high-dollar claims

Manage out-of-network (OON) claims and understand the additional follow-up required for OON reimbursement

Work with Medicare, Medi-Cal, and commercial payors

Review claims for correct CPT/ICD-10 codes, modifiers, units, provider information, and billing requirements

Monitor aging and outstanding claims and take appropriate follow-up action

Research and resolve claim rejections, denials, and payment discrepancies

Prepare corrected claims, reconsiderations, and appeals

Review EOBs/ERAs for incorrect payments and underpayments

Follow up directly with insurance companies until claims are properly processed

Maintain detailed documentation of all billing and follow-up activity

Identify recurring payor issues and help develop solutions

Take ownership of assigned claims and ensure they do not fall through the cracks

Required Experience

3+ years of hands-on medical billing experience preferred

Strong experience with professional surgical claims

Out-of-network medical billing experience required

Experience managing billing from initial claim submission through payment

Working knowledge of Medicare, Medi-Cal, and commercial insurance

Strong understanding of CPT, ICD-10, modifiers, CMS-1500 claims, EOBs/ERAs, denials, corrected claims, reconsiderations, and appeals

Experience researching and resolving unpaid, denied, and underpaid claims

Ability to communicate effectively with insurance companies and escalate claims when necessary

Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through

Strong Plus

Previous Team Lead, Billing Lead, or Billing Supervisor experience

Experience training or overseeing billing staff

Tebra/Kareo experience

Experience with complex or high-dollar surgical claims

Experience with GAP exceptions, Single Case Agreements (SCA), Letters of Agreement (LOA), and out-of-network reimbursement

Familiarity with payer disputes and reimbursement negotiations

Who We Are Looking For

This is not an entry-level billing position.

We are looking for someone who is experienced, persistent, organized, and accountable. You should be able to review an unpaid or underpaid claim, determine what went wrong, and know what action needs to be taken next.

Our ideal candidate does not simply submit claims and wait for payment. We want someone who takes ownership of the account, follows through with the payor, and works the claim until appropriate reimbursement is received.

If you have strong experience in surgical billing, out-of-network claims, and start-to-finish revenue cycle management, we would like to hear from you.

If you HAVE done this and you're proud of the numbers, keep reading. This is a senior, long-term seat at a brand already in major US retail, and we pay properly for people who move the needle.



About us

We're anew — a premium bottled water built on a bottle made entirely from plants, independently proven to contain zero microplastics, zero BPA, and zero PFAS, filled with natural mineral water. It took a decade to develop.



We're on shelf in the US across Sprouts (400+ stores), Whole Foods, Costco, and Bristol Farms, and we operate across New Zealand, Australia, and the United States.



What we haven't cracked yet is TikTok Shop. That's your job.

Set up, optimise, and run the TikTok Shop end to end: seller account, listings, images, video assets, compliance, shipping, promotions

Build the affiliate engine. This is the core of the role: source creators, run open and targeted collaborations, negotiate commission, ship samples, chase content, and cut the ones who don't perform

Build a repeatable creator brief so affiliates produce content that converts — not content that just looks pretty

Manage TikTok Shop ads, Spark ads, and boosted affiliate content

Plan, run, and coordinate LIVE selling sessions

Manage the sample/seeding budget and keep it profitable

Track GMV, CTR, conversion rate, commission spend, and creator ROI daily — and tell us what you're changing because of it

Report weekly on what's working, what you killed, and what's next





Hard requirements (non-negotiable)

3+ years in ecommerce, with at least 2 years directly operating a TikTok Shop (US market strongly preferred)

Affiliate/creator recruitment at volume — you can tell us how many creators you've onboarded and what they generated

You've run TikTok Shop ads and understand the difference between boosting a winner and burning budget

Comfortable with numbers: contribution margin after commission, creator ROI, and knowing when a deal is unprofitable

Excellent written English — most creator outreach is written by you

Reliable internet and a machine that handles CapCut/Canva-level work

Real proof: shop names, screenshots, GMV, affiliate counts



Nice to have: beverage, supplement, wellness or other consumable/FMCG experience; video editing; a live-selling host network you can tap.

Your TikTok Shop experience is limited to being an affiliate yourself

You've managed a shop for under a year

You need a manager to hand you a daily task list

You're running three other full-time clients

You're going to send a generic copy-pasted application







Long-term, stable role with a founder-led brand already in major US retail

Real ownership. You will not be micromanaged. You will be held to results.

Put "TIKTOK-ANEW-2026" as the first line of your application. If it's not there, we won't read it.

, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.



PHASE 1: LEAD CREATIVE PRODUCTION



• Manage a two-person video-editing team, including their priorities, workload, deadlines, coverage, development, and performance. 

• Turn approved priorities into clear production plans, briefs, scripts, storytelling direction, B-roll needs, and deliverables.

• Own the production pipeline: capacity, assignments, dependencies, revisions, blockers, asset readiness, and delivery visibility.

• Review short-form, long-form, ads, thumbnails, static assets, carousels, platform versions, and other creative output.

• Evaluate the full story—not only whether one shot matches one line. Check hooks, pacing, B-roll, demonstrations, captions, CTAs, factual accuracy, brand alignment, and viewer flow.

• Give editors clear, prioritized, actionable feedback and verify that required revisions were completed correctly.

• Use performance findings to identify stronger hooks, packaging, formats, V2/V3 opportunities, and creative tests.

• Build and improve SOPs, review standards, production trackers, asset repositories, AI-assisted QA, and backup coverage.

• Coordinate minor corrections and urgent production support when needed, without turning the role into a primary editing position.



PHASE 2: ADD SOCIAL MEDIA OPERATIONS



Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date, once Phase 1 is operating reliably and you have demonstrated readiness for the expanded scope. At that point, you will also:

• Manage the current Social Media Moderator and future social media team members. 

• Own the publishing calendar, content inventory, platform schedules, launch pushes, and publishing verification across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.

• Ensure each platform receives the correct version, copy, CTA, description, tags, products, related content, links, and native-platform setup.

• Oversee community, marketing inboxes, important comments and messages, channel presentation, and routine reputation handling.

• Manage routine creator-partnership and affiliate operations, including communication, records, deliverables, logistics, and escalation.

• Own routine UTM, Bitly, campaign-link, profile-link, and destination-verification workflows.

• Review social performance and turn findings into decisions, tests, and coordinated creative recommendations.

• Build and maintain the social department’s processes, AI workflows, reporting, and continuity systems.



The responsibilities above describe the core scope of the role but are not exhaustive. As Veritas grows, you may also take on related creative-production, social-media, team-management, and marketing-operations responsibilities that are reasonably aligned with the position and approved business priorities.



You're a strong fit if you



• Have at least eight years of professional work experience, including at least three years managing teams and at least two years inside a creative or marketing function.

• Have meaningful corporate, in-house, agency, or field-based operating experience, not only freelance, VA, or task-based remote experience.

• Have managed a creative or video-production pipeline and can lead workload, quality, deadlines, coaching, and accountability.

• Are exceptionally strong at storytelling and can evaluate the complete story and business goal, not only technical editing details.

• Act without waiting for step-by-step direction and continuously improve quality, speed, visibility, and continuity.

• Use performance evidence and AI to improve decisions and execution while checking sources and protecting brand and product accuracy.

• Communicate clearly in conversational American English.

• Can sustain the graveyard schedule and occasional weekend coverage.

• Have reliable primary internet, backup internet, and backup power.

• Want one company to grow with for the long term.



How to apply



Use this subject line and at least 20 AP:

[INSERT REQUIRED WORD] - [X] years of professional experience - [X] years managing teams



Include the following:

• Your resume with company names, employment dates, role titles, team sizes, and whether each role was corporate, in-house, agency, freelance, or VA work.

• Have you directly managed a creative-production or video-production team? Answer Yes or No. If yes, state the team size.

• Can you provide examples of videos, campaigns, or creative projects you directly led if you advance to the next stage? Answer Yes or No. Do not send links or detailed explanations at this stage.

• In one short logistics block, confirm that this would be your only job and that you would complete all work personally. Include your city or province, most recent U.S.-hours role and actual schedule, primary and backup internet, backup power, and occasional weekend availability.



Note: Applications missing any requirement will not be considered.

title: Social Media & Community Manager With ManyChat Automation Expertise
description:
I am a teacher and the creator of an educational company that creates beginning reading and phonics resources for kindergarten, first grade, and second grade teachers.

My mission is to take reading research and turn it into simple classroom routines teachers can use immediately.

I am growing my presence across TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube, Pinterest, and LinkedIn. I plan to publish approximately 14-20 short form videos each week.

I am looking for an experienced Social Media and Community Manager who can help me turn that content into audience growth,
 subscribers, product sales, and meaningful relationships with teachers.

This has the potential to become a consistent, long term position for the right person.



The Main Problem I Need You to Solve

My videos frequently include direct calls to action asking viewers to comment or message me for a free resource, product, or link.Right now, people are commenting and sending direct messages, but I do not have the time or systems to respond consistently. Interested teachers are sometimes left without an answer or without the resource they requested.

Your primary responsibility will be to make sure interested teachers receive timely, accurate, friendly responses and are directed to the correct free resource,
 funnel, product, or support information.

No genuine lead or customer question should be ignored.



Primary Responsibilities

Social Media Scheduling and Publishing

You will:

• Schedule approximately 14-20 short form videos each week

• Publish content across TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube, Pinterest, and LinkedIn

• Write compelling, accurate descriptions that capture attention

• Adapt descriptions and calls to action for each platform

• Create strong titles for YouTube Shorts

• Add appropriate keywords, hashtags, links, and platform settings

• Confirm that every post is published correctly and on schedule

• Check links, tags, captions, thumbnails, and calls to action before publishing

• Track which video, offer, link, and ManyChat keyword are connected

Finished videos will be provided by my video editor. You will not be responsible for editing videos.



ManyChat Setup and Management

You must have proven, hands-on experience with ManyChat.

You will:

• Audit and organize my ManyChat account

• Connect all eligible social media accounts correctly

• Build keyword-triggered comment and direct message automations

• Deliver the correct free resource or product link when someone comments a designated word

• Build Instagram and
 comment-to-message workflows

• Build eligible TikTok direct message workflows

• Create welcome messages and default replies

• Develop simple lead qualification and product recommendation flows

• Use tags, custom fields, and segmentation to organize contacts

• Test every automation before it goes live

• Monitor flows for errors, broken links, and missed messages

• Review performance and recommend improvements

• Document every automation so another team member can understand it

You should understand the difference between simple keyword automations and AI-assisted conversational flows. Automated conversations must sound like my voice: warm and helpful, not robotic, deceptive, or overly aggressive. We can create these together. 



Community Management

You will monitor comments and direct messages across all six platforms.

You will:

• Check new comments and messages consistently

• Respond warmly in the Primary Playdate brand voice

• Answer common questions using approved information

• Send people to the correct free resource or product

• Create & Encourage natural, meaningful conversation in the comments

• Ask thoughtful follow-up questions when appropriate

• Thank teachers who share experiences and success stories

• Identify potential testimonials and user-generated content

• Hide or report spam when appropriate

• Escalate complaints, sensitive messages, legal questions, refund requests, and complicated customer-service issues to me

• Maintain a frequently asked questions and approved-response library

• Never invent an answer when you are unsure



The goal is genuine community engagement. I do not want generic, repetitive, or fake-looking comments posted simply to increase activity.

Copywriting Descriptions

Create descriptions that

• Open with a compelling hook

• Explain the value of the video clearly

• Speak directly to kindergarten, first grade, and second grade teachers

• Include a clear, accurate call to action

• Use keywords teachers are likely to search

• Match my natural, friendly, teacher-to-teacher voice

• Lead viewers to act on the CTA

You may use AI to assist with drafting and organization.



Ideal Candidate

The right person will:

• Have proven experience building and managing ManyChat automations

• Understand Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and LinkedIn

• Have experience scheduling high-volume short form content

• Be an excellent English writer

• Understand the differences between platform audiences

• Write warm, engaging, natural responses

• Be highly organized and detail-oriented

• Check links and workflows carefully

• Meet deadlines consistently

• Communicate clearly and promptly

• Use good judgment when d
 what to answer and what to escalate

• Be comfortable learning education and phonics terminology

• Care about creating an excellent experience for teachers

• Be interested in consistent, long term work

Experience with education brands, teacher creators, digital products, TPT,
 marketing, or online course businesses is highly desirable.



Required ManyChat Experience

Please do not apply if you have only watched tutorials about ManyChat but have not built and managed live automations.



You should be able to demonstrate experience with:

• Comment-to-DM automation

• Keyword triggers

• Tags and segmentation

• Custom fields

•
 collection

• Conditional logic

• Follow-up sequences

• AI-assisted flows

• Testing and troubleshooting

• Meta messaging requirements and communication windows



Brand Voice should always sound:

• Knowledgeable but easy to understand

• Friendly and conversational

• Encouraging and respectful

• Like one experienced teacher helping another teacher

Responses should never feel cold, overly corporate, argumentative, or aggressively sales-focused.



How to Apply

I plan to interview candidates over the next two weeks. 

 me at: 



1. A short introduction explaining your relevant experience

2. Examples or screenshots of ManyChat workflows you personally built

3. A description of your most successful comment-to-DM or lead-generation automation

4. Social media accounts you have managed

5. Your experience with Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and LinkedIn

6. Your availability and preferred working hours

7. Your proposed hourly rate 

8. The number of hours you estimate this position will require each week

9. Confirmation that you can check comments and direct messages consistently

10. An explanation of how you determine when a message should be handled automatically, answered personally, or escalated to the business owner

11. The word “MANYCHAT” in the subject line of your application so I know you read the entire description



Please do not send a generic application. I am specifically looking for someone who combines social media management, community engagement, copywriting, and genuine ManyChat automation expertise.

title: Executive Assistant / Operations Assistant
description:
I am looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to support me across both my businesses and personal life.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant role where you will simply be given a checklist of repetitive tasks. I am looking for someone who can become a trusted extension of me — someone who is thoughtful, highly organized, resourceful, comfortable using AI, and able to take ownership of tasks from beginning to end.



I own and operate multiple learning centers in the United States that keep me very busy. My days move quickly, and I need someone who can help bring structure, follow-through, and can communicate very well across many different areas.



The right person will be trusted with sensitive information and will often communicate directly with parents, employees, vendors, and other stakeholders on my behalf. Judgment, discretion, and written communication are therefore extremely important.



What You Will Help With

1. Executive & Personal Support

Manage and organize my calendar

Schedule appointments, meetings, travel, and personal bookings

Research options and make thoughtful recommendations

Complete forms and administrative paperwork accurately

Track deadlines, follow-ups, renewals, appointments, and important dates

Help manage personal projects and miscellaneous tasks

Maintain organized records and documentation

Follow up with people so things do not fall through the cracks



2. Inbox & Communication Management

Help manage a high-volume
 inbox

Identify what is urgent, what needs my attention, and what can be handled independently

Draft thoughtful
s in my voice

Respond to routine
s on my behalf once trained

Follow up with parents, employees, vendors, leads, and partners

Maintain a professional, warm, and thoughtful tone in every interaction

Ensure important conversations receive timely follow-up



3. Learning Center / Business Operations

You will support several learning centers and may help with:



Parent communication and follow-ups

Enrollment and lead follow-up

Scheduling and appointment coordination

Vendor communication

Staff scheduling and administrative follow-ups

Tracking operational tasks across multiple locations

Updating spreadsheets, documents, and internal trackers

Preparing reports and organizing information

Following up on invoices, payments, contracts, and paperwork

Helping organize marketing initiatives and community outreach

Maintaining confidential student, family, employee, and business information

Identifying problems before they become bigger problems



You do not need previous learning center experience. I care much more about how quickly you learn, how carefully you work, and how much ownership you take.



What I Am Looking For



You will likely be a great fit if you are:



Extremely detail-oriented: you notice names, dates, numbers, attachments, deadlines, and inconsistencies

An excellent written communicator: your English should be polished, natural, warm, and professional

A problem solver: when something is unclear, you investigate and propose a solution rather than immediately asking what to do

Highly trustworthy and discreet: you will have access to sensitive personal and business information

AI-forward: you actively use tools such as ChatGPT or similar AI platforms to research, draft, organize, summarize, and work more efficiently

Organized: you can manage many small moving pieces without losing track of them

Proactive: you follow up without being reminded

Comfortable with ambiguity: not every task will come with perfect instructions

Calm under pressure: you can handle an upset customer or an urgent request thoughtfully

Able to learn someone else's voice: eventually, an
 written by you should sound like it came from me

Comfortable owning mistakes: if something goes wrong, I expect transparency and a proposed solution rather than excuses



Experience with some of these is helpful:

- Gmail

- Google Calendar

- Google Drive / Google Docs / Google Sheets

- ChatGPT and other AI tools

- Canva



Specific software can be taught. Strong judgment and attention to detail are much harder to teach.



Schedule: This position will begin at approximately 4 hours per day, Monday through Friday.



You must be willing to work hours that provide meaningful overlap with the US Eastern Time Zone.



For the right person, this role can become full-time after approximately three months.



I am looking for someone who wants to grow into a long-term role rather than simply pick up a few freelance hours.



Compensation: Compensation will be based on experience and demonstrated capability.



There will be an opportunity for increased responsibility, hours, and compensation for someone who consistently performs at a high level.



IMPORTANT: How to Apply



I receive many applications, so please do not send a generic cover letter.



Instead, include the following in your application:



Task 1 —
 Judgment



A parent
s:



“I’ve called your center twice and nobody got back to me. We came in for an assessment three weeks ago and were promised a call that evening. This feels extremely unprofessional.”



Draft the response you would send on my behalf.



Keep it under 200 words.



Task 2 — Problem Solving



Imagine I send you this message:



“I need to take my mother to a doctor next Thursday afternoon. Find me three well-reviewed options within 20 minutes of my home, check whether they take her insurance, determine their earliest appointment availability, and put everything in a format where I can quickly choose.”



In 5–8 bullet points, explain exactly how you would approach this task from beginning to end.



Do not simply say, “I would research doctors.”



I want to understand how you think.



Task 3 — Attention to Detail



At the very top of your application, write:



Math + Judgment + Ownership



Applications that do not include this line will not be considered.



Task 4 — AI



Tell me:



Which AI tools you currently use

One specific example of how AI has saved you time or improved your work

One situation where you would NOT trust AI's answer without independently verifying it



Task 5 — Your Work Style - Answer these briefly:



What type of manager brings out your best work?

Tell me about a time you caught a mistake before it became a bigger problem.

Tell me about a situation where you were given an unclear task and figured out what to do.

Are you comfortable working with confidential business and personal information?

What hours can you consistently work in US Eastern Time?



Please keep your entire application concise. Being able to communicate clearly without writing unnecessary paragraphs is part of the evaluation.



One Final Note



I care deeply about how people are treated.



Many of the people you will communicate with are parents trusting us with their children, employees relying on us for clear communication, or people with whom I have long-standing professional relationships.



Being fast is important.



Being accurate is important.



But being thoughtful, kind, and exercising good judgment is equally important.



If you are someone who takes pride in doing things exceptionally well, enjoys solving problems, and wants to become an indispensable part of a growing operation, I would love to hear from you.

title: Video Editor
description:
VIDEO EDITOR (Remote, Full-Time)

- Be Part of AEF’s Pioneer Editing Team



Dear Future Team Member,



This isn’t just another editing job.



This is your chance to be part of something special: a heart-driven team that powers cinematic wedding films and premium corporate productions for clients across Asia.



We’re AdvantEdge Films (AEF) — a Singapore-based creative studio behind the brand Memory Makers.



>> Why Memory Makers? Because our work goes beyond cutting clips. 



Every edit we deliver isn’t just a video — 

It's a memory made to last a lifetime.



• A couple relives the laughter, the tears, the vows.



• A business owner sees their brand elevated on screen.



That’s the standard we hold ourselves to, and that’s the kind of impact you’ll create here.



In just under 2 years, we’ve helped 100+ couples relive their wedding stories and supported business owners with high-impact video content.



But we’re just getting started — and we want you to be part of shaping what’s next.



As we grow, we’re opening 1–2 seats for talented editors to join our pioneer team.



>> Get in early. Grow into leadership. Help redefine storytelling.



>> See the kind of beautiful work you’ll get to be part of:




 


 



If you don’t think we’re legit, don’t read further.



But if your heart’s already beating faster — this might just be where you belong.



>> What’s In It For You 



If you’re just looking for another editing gig, where you’re treated like a headcount and your work disappears into a folder, this isn’t for you.



But if you want your edits to move people… to make couples cry happy tears… to see your work truly matter and to know you’re part of something bigger — then you’ll fit right in.



It’s about finally having the stability, recognition and growth path that so many freelancers dream about — but rarely find.



Your family will see that what you’re doing is a real career, 

not just a side hustle.



>> Here’s what you can look forward to when you join us: 



• A Clear Career Path — No more endless freelancing without direction. You’ll grow step by step: Trainee >> Junior Editor >> Senior Editor >> Lead Editor. Your hard work will actually lead somewhere.



•  Stable Monthly Salary (pegged to market rates) — Paid on time, every month. No chasing clients, no dry months. And as you grow, so does your pay.



• Pioneer Team Advantage —  Get in early and grow with us. As we expand, you’ll be first in line for leadership opportunities.



• Onboarding & Training That Sets You Up To Win —  Clear SOPs, style guides and real feedback — no guessing games, no being left alone. You’ll always know how to succeed here.



• Premium Portfolio You’ll Be Proud Of — Work on cinematic wedding films and corporate projects that showcase your craft — projects you’ll be proud to say, “I edited this.”



• Performance Bonuses & Growth Perks — Whether it’s a brand-new laptop, sponsored overseas travel (Company Retreats), or courses to sharpen your skills, we reward commitment and excellence.



>> How Life is Gonna Look Like For you



Joining AEF means stepping into a role where you can do what you love — without the chaos and uncertainty that freelancers often face.



Here’s how your day-to-day will actually look like:



Work From Anywhere (100% Remote)



- No commuting, no traffic, no wasted hours. You’ll have the freedom to work from the comfort of your home (or anywhere with a good connection).



Whether that’s your family home, a quiet café, or even during a brownout with your backup plan — you stay in control of your day.



A Stable Rhythm, Clear Expectations



- You’ll work Mon–Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM (SGT). But we’re not here to micromanage or track your every move. What matters most is that key deliverables are done on task, on time, on target, and to the required standards. Weekends are yours for family, rest, or passion projects.



Stay Connected, Never Isolated



- Even though we’re remote, you’ll never feel like you’re working alone. With quick daily stand-ups and weekly reviews (Mon, Wed, Fri), you’ll always have support, feedback, and a team that’s got your back.



A Team That Values You



- You’ll work with creatives who genuinely care about quality and storytelling — and about each other. Every edit you deliver contributes directly to making couples cry happy tears, or helping businesses shine.



Clarity + Growth Built In



- Your projects will come with clear briefs, SOPs and feedback loops. That means less confusion, fewer revisions and more space for you to focus on doing what you do best — creating edits that move people.



In short: Your days will feel structured, purposeful and supported. You’ll edit amazing stories, grow your skills, and still have time for yourself and your loved ones.



>> What You’ll Actually Do



Craft Wedding Highlight Reels



- Take the most emotional moments of a wedding day and weave them into a cinematic highlight that brings couples to happy tears and rewatch for years to come.



Bring Corporate & Event Stories to Life



- Edit impactful films that help brands connect with their audiences — from events to marketing videos.



Follow Clear SOPs, Add Your Creative Touch



- Use AEF’s editing frameworks and style guides as your foundation — while bringing in your storytelling instincts to make each video feel alive.



Grow Through Feedback Loops



- You’ll collaborate with our Singapore Team using Slack, WhatsApp and GDrive. Over time, as your cuts get sharper, you’ll need fewer revisions — a clear sign of your growth.



Master the Full Editing Flow



- From raw >> first cut >> fine cut>> final cut, you’ll manage projects end to end, sharpening not just your skills but your confidence as an editor.



>> How Your Career Growth is Gonna Look Like



This isn’t a dead-end editing gig. We want you to grow with us.



• 0 - 3 months (Probation): Trainee



Think of this as your warm-up stage. 



You’ll learn our style, workflows and editing frameworks while working on real projects. 



By the end, you’ll already have a feel for what it means to edit stories the AEF way — consistent, on-brief and emotionally powerful.



• 1-2 Years: Junior Editor



Now you can hold your own fort. 



You’ll deliver quality edits with fewer revisions, adapt confidently to our brand styles, and start building a premium portfolio of wedding highlights and corporate projects you’ll be proud to showcase.



• 3-4 Years: Senior Editor



This is where you level up. 



You’ll take on more complex projects with your own cinematic touch, handle edits with minimal supervision, and even begin guiding newer editors. Your work won’t just meet expectations — it’ll inspire.



• 5 Years & Beyond: Lead Editor (Pioneer Team Track)



As part of the founding team, this is the fast track. 



You’ll set standards, refine SOPs, mentor juniors, and lead large or high-profile projects. You’ll have a direct hand in shaping AEF’s editing division as we grow.



Join now, and you won’t just be another editor — 

You’ll be among our founding editors, with the fastest path to leadership and long-term impact.



And years from now, you’ll look back with pride knowing you weren’t just freelancing gig to gig — you were part of the original pioneer team, building a career your family can celebrate.



>> Compensation & Stability



We offer competitive pay pegged to the Philippine market rate for full-time video editors, and will assess fairly based on your portfolio and experience.



No more chasing invoices, no dry months, no waiting games.

Stable monthly income. Paid on time, every time.



No need to worry about clients ghosting you, or waiting until 3 AM for replies from a foreign timezone.



You’ll also have room to grow: as your skills sharpen and your impact increases, so will your pay.



>> In your application, simply share your expected monthly salary range so we can assess fairly.



>> How to Know You’re The Right Fit



This Role Might Not Be For You If…



• You rely only on drag-and-drop templates and avoid learning real storytelling skills.



• You’re juggling multiple clients/ freelance gigs and can’t fully commit to one team.



• You struggle to meet deadlines or need constant hand-holding to finish projects.



• You see editing as “just a job” and don’t care about the emotions or impact behind your work.



• You’re not open to feedback, or you take it personally instead of using it to grow.



This Role IS for You If…



• You don’t just want to edit videos — you want your edits to move people.



• You take ownership. Once trusted with a project, you’ll do your best to deliver, no excuses.



• You’re hungry to learn and grow — not content with being “good enough,” but aiming to be great.



• You thrive on collaboration: you value feedback, respect deadlines, and know communication builds trust.



• You don’t see this as just another gig. You’re looking for a long-term home where your work matters.



>> Must-Have Requirements



3 EXTREMELY IMPORTANT THINGS:



1) Strong Command of Adobe Premiere Pro (After Effects is a bonus!)



You don’t need to be the world’s best yet — but you must already have a solid foundation in Premiere and the drive to sharpen your craft daily. 



If you love refining timelines, syncing audio to emotion, and experimenting with cuts that bring stories alive, you’ll fit right in.



2) Great Storytelling Taste & Attention to Detail



Editing is more than just trimming clips — it’s about shaping moments into memories. 



You need an eye for pacing, music and emotional flow. 



Every detail matters — from transitions to color tones. 



If you find yourself obsessing over whether a cut feels “just right,” you’re our kind of editor.



3) Reliable Setup & Professional Commitment



This is a full-time role, so you’ll need a capable PC/ laptop built for video editing, a stable internet connection, and the discipline to work independently from home. 



Deadlines matter here, and so does communication. 



We value editors who show up, own their work, and consistently deliver on time.



>> Bonus Points If You…



- Have experience editing weddings, events, or cinematic highlights



- Are comfortable working with Google Drive, Slack and WhatsApp for collaboration



- Love experimenting with creative storytelling but can also follow brand guidelines



- Are eager to grow into leadership and mentor other editors down the road



>> I’M IN! HOW DO I BEGIN?



>> If you’ve reached this far and you’re still excited about joining AEF as a full-time Video Editor — and you can see yourself growing with us over the next few years…



Then follow the application steps below, show us your portfolio and let’s see if we’re a perfect match.



TAKE THIS SIMPLE TEST BEFORE YOU APPLY



>>  Before you apply, take this simple 4-step test to see if this role is truly right for you.



1) Check out our work



Our IG: 

Our Gallery: 



If you don’t feel inspired — or don’t have the heart to create edits that make couples cry happy tears or businesses proud to showcase their story… Then this role isn’t for you.



2) Ask yourself this:



“Am I prepared to grow from a trainee editor into a senior or even lead editor — refining my skills, taking feedback and mentoring others along the way?”

 

If the answer is no, don’t apply.



3) Reflect on your work habits.



Do you lose yourself in the craft of editing because you love it — sometimes spending hours without noticing the time?



Or do you just want a gig to clock in, clock out, and collect a paycheck?



If it’s the latter, don’t apply.



4) Think long-term.



Can you see yourself working full-time with AEF for at least the next 3 years, growing with a pioneer team and helping us redefine video storytelling in Asia?



If not, don’t apply.



IF YOU D
 THAT YOU’VE PASSED THE TEST ABOVE



>> Follow These Steps Carefully (we only want serious applicants who can follow instructions):



Step 1: Self-Intro Video (2–3 mins)



Record a short video of yourself answering these key questions:



- What are you currently doing and why are you considering changing?



- Why do you feel you’re the right fit for this role?



- What’s your past experience with video editing? (Wedding / corporate work if any!)



- What are your goals for the next 3 years?



- How do you stay motivated in a remote role?



Step 2: Application Form 



Upload your:

- Link to your best work / portfolio (if any)

- Resume

- Link to your Self-Intro Video



Step 3: Let’s Hop on a Date (Zoom Interview)



Yes, a date — because this is about chemistry too. We want to get to know you, hear your story, and see if we vibe as a team.



P.S. We’re only opening 1–2 seats for editors this year.



Once these are filled, the next intake won’t be for a while — and by then, the fast-track leadership opportunities may already be gone.



>> If you’re serious about building a long-term career in premium editing (not just freelancing from gig to gig), this is your chance.



<< Apply now. Don’t wait >>



[Click on the APPLY button now]

title: AI Static Ad Creative Designer for Meta and Google
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW



We advertise heavily on Meta and Google, and creative volume is our single biggest constraint. Winning ad accounts run on a constant supply of fresh creative, and we need someone producing that supply every day.



AI does the production. You bring the judgment. Anyone can generate images, but tools left on their own produce variations of the same thing, and that is exactly what stops working on Meta. We need someone who studies what other brands are running, pulls ideas apart, combines concepts, and comes back with genuinely different creative. You will work directly with the founder and marketing team.



We pay above market and expect above market work.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Produce high volumes of static ad creative for Meta and Google campaigns, plus organic social and the Shopify store

- Write prompts in Claude, generate in Higgsfield or similar tools, and iterate until the product looks exactly right

- Research what other brands in our space are running, learn from it, adapt it, and combine concepts into something new. This is the part of the job AI cannot do

- Work from product reference photos so every image depicts our product accurately. This is the part most people get wrong

- Create genuine concept variety: different models, backgrounds, settings, formats. We never reuse an image

- Turn written creative briefs into finished, ready-to-run assets

- Support promotions, launches, and seasonal campaigns with dedicated creative

- Light cleanup and text overlay work when an image needs it



ABOUT RUFFROVER



RuffRover is a fast-growing US-based ecommerce pet travel brand. We make premium products that help people travel with their dogs more safely and comfortably. Our flagship product, the RuffRover 2.0, has shipped to thousands of pet owners. Small, fast-moving team with a strong focus on customer experience and long-term growth.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- You already use AI image tools daily. Higgsfield strongly preferred, and we will ask what you use and why

- Strong prompting skill. You can get a specific result on purpose, not by luck

- A real creative eye. You can look at an ad and explain why it works, then build something different that works for the same reason

- Attention to product detail. If a strap or flap is in the wrong place, you should notice before we do

- Speed. Volume-first. We would rather have 20 good images than 2 perfect ones

- Comfortable with hands-on batch production and fast regeneration when something comes out wrong

- Work independently, take ownership, move fast

- Reliable English over Slack and WhatsApp, stable internet, your own computer



NICE TO HAVE



- Direct response ad creative for Meta or Google

- Understanding of hooks, angles, and what makes a scroll-stopping static

- Experience with competitor research or ad library tools

- CapCut or basic video editing

- Photoshop or Canva for retouching and overlays

- Pet, lifestyle, or DTC brand experience



WHY JOIN RUFFROVER



Fully remote with high creative ownership. Direct access to the founder, no layers to work through. Your creative runs on live ad spend and you will see exactly how it performs. Real growth potential as the company scales.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word IMAGEVOLUME so we know you read this.



Then send:



1. A Google Drive link to at least 10 AI images you personally created, noting which tool and model made each one

2. Which AI image tools you currently pay for

3. Send us an ad from any brand you think is strong and tell us in two sentences why it works

4. How many finished images you can realistically produce in one working day



Shortlisted applicants get a small paid test task: 10 statics from our product photos against a written brief. Long-term contractor role with room to grow.

title: Video Editor - AI
description:
Females under 30 preferred.



We’re looking for a hungry, ambitious Video Editor to join our e-commerce creative team long-term.



Experience is preferred, but it is NOT the most important thing we are looking for.



We are open to early-career editors who may not have years of professional experience yet.



If you are honest, reliable, highly coachable, good at following instructions, comfortable learning new tools, and genuinely want to become an excellent editor, we strongly encourage you to apply.



We can teach skills.



What is much harder to teach is attitude, attention to detail, work ethic and honesty.



The Role



You will create short-form video advertisements for e-commerce brands using:



Reference advertisements

Creative briefs

Existing footage

AI-generated visuals

Voiceovers

Product assets

UGC-style content

Animation and B-roll



A big part of our creative process involves studying advertisements that already work and adapting them while preserving the important elements of the original reference.



You should be comfortable following a proven structure rather than unnecessarily reinventing it.



What You’ll Do

Turn creative briefs and reference ads into finished e-commerce video ads

Study references carefully and recreate their hook, pacing, structure and visual rhythm

Edit UGC-style, animated and AI-assisted advertisements

Create AI images, talking-head scenes, product footage, animations and B-roll when required

Learn and use tools such as ChatGPT, Google Flow / Veo, Kling, ElevenLabs, HeyGen and CapCut

Maintain realistic characters, products, hands, movement and continuity

Understand what the advertisement is trying to communicate, not just mechanically edit footage

Check your own work carefully before submitting it

Catch subtitle, audio, product, formatting and export mistakes yourself

Organize your projects, source files and final exports properly

Learn our internal editing systems and workflows



You are not expected to already be an expert in every tool we use.



We will provide training and clear workflows.



However, when we teach you a process, we expect you to follow it.



The Type of Person We Want



We’re looking for someone who is:



Hungry to improve

Honest

Reliable

Highly coachable

Detail-oriented

Comfortable receiving feedback

Able to follow detailed instructions

Willing to learn completely new software and AI tools

Interested in social media, content and advertising

Able to adapt quickly as tools and workflows change

Comfortable working inside an established system

Serious about becoming an excellent video editor



Early-career editors who are ambitious and want an opportunity to learn rapidly and develop their skills are strongly encouraged to apply.



Honesty Is Extremely Important



This deserves its own section.



If you make a mistake, tell us.



If you didn't follow an instruction correctly, tell us.



If you don't know how to do something, tell us.



If you've never used a particular tool before, tell us.



You will never be punished for honestly admitting that you don't know something or that you made a mistake.



What we will not tolerate is lying, hiding mistakes, pretending you followed a process when you didn't, or exaggerating your abilities.



We would rather train an honest beginner than manage an experienced editor we cannot trust.



Our Standard



We care about four things:



1. Correct message

Understand what the advertisement is actually trying to communicate.



2. Believable execution

AI content should look natural and realistic rather than obviously generated.



3. Clean technical quality

Wrong products, incorrect logos, broken anatomy, missing subtitles, bad audio, incorrect aspect ratios and export mistakes should be caught before submission.



4. Following the process

title: REMOTE OPERATIONS & EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT
description:
REMOTE OPERATIONS & EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT  

Operations Coordination • Executive Support • ERP Development Liaison

Work Arrangement: Remote

Position Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Executive Leadership

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, technology-oriented Remote Operations & Executive Assistant to support Executive Leadership while helping coordinate the systems, projects, people, and technology required to operate and scale a growing company.

This is not a traditional administrative assistant position.

The successful candidate will serve as a central point of coordination between Executive Leadership, employees, contractors, and our ERP development team.

A major responsibility of this position will be assisting with the ongoing development and implementation of our ERP system. The Remote Operations & Executive Assistant will help translate business processes into organized information that our ERP developer can use to build and improve the system.

The ideal candidate does not necessarily need to be an ERP developer. However, experience with ERP systems, CRM systems, business process mapping, software implementation, project management, or technology development projects would be a significant advantage.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Executive Support

Provide high-level administrative and operational support to Executive Leadership.

Responsibilities include:

Manage executive calendars, meetings, appointments, and priorities.

Prepare meeting agendas.

Document decisions and action items.

Track commitments made during meetings.

Follow up with team members regarding assignments.

Organize documents, reports, and correspondence.

Help Executive Leadership prioritize projects.

Protect executive time by handling routine administrative and coordination activities.

Ensure important issues are escalated appropriately.

Maintain confidentiality regarding company operations, employees, customers, and financial information.

The objective is to allow Executive Leadership to spend more time on strategy, growth, partnerships, leadership, and major business decisions rather than routine administrative follow-up.



2. ERP DEVELOPMENT & IMPLEMENTATION LIAISON

This is a major responsibility of the position.

The Remote Operations & Executive Assistant will serve as the primary coordination point between Executive Leadership and our ERP developer/development team.

When the ERP developer needs clarification regarding how the company operates, this individual should help obtain, organize, document, and communicate the necessary information.

Responsibilities include:

Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for the ERP developer.

Receive questions and requests from the ERP development team.

Determine which department or executive can provide the required information.

Gather information from Executive Leadership and employees.

Document business requirements.

Communicate approved requirements to the developer.

Schedule ERP development meetings.

Prepare agendas for ERP meetings.

Document decisions made during ERP meetings.

Maintain an ERP development task list.

Track outstanding developer questions.

Track requested system changes.

Track development priorities.

Follow up on incomplete development tasks.

Coordinate user testing.

Document bugs and system issues.

Collect feedback from employees using the system.

Communicate feedback to the developer.

Help coordinate system demonstrations.

Assist with implementation and employee adoption.

Maintain ERP documentation and training materials.

Help ensure that development decisions match actual company operations.

The Communication Flow

The position will help maintain a disciplined communication structure:

ERP Developer → Operations & Executive Assistant → Executive Leadership / Department → Decision or Information → Operations & Executive Assistant → ERP Developer

This prevents developers from having to chase multiple employees for answers and prevents Executive Leadership from becoming the bottleneck for every development question.



3. BUSINESS PROCESS DOCUMENTATION

Before a process can be automated, it must be understood.

The Remote Operations & Executive Assistant will help document how the company operates so that processes can eventually be incorporated into the ERP system.

Examples may include:

Lead management

Customer assessments

Sales processes

Quotations and estimates

Customer approvals

Deposits

Work orders

Project management

Production scheduling

Purchasing

Inventory

Manufacturing

Employee time tracking

Customer communication

Invoicing

Accounts receivable

Accounting

Marketing automation

Appointment scheduling

Customer portals

Reporting and dashboards

The individual should be able to ask:

“How does this process work today?”

“How should it work?”

“Who is responsible?”

“What information is required?”

“What should trigger the next step?”

“What happens if something goes wrong?”

The answers should then be documented clearly enough for management and the ERP development team to understand.



4. ERP PROJECT MANAGEMENT

Help maintain an organized ERP development process.

Maintain a development pipeline such as:

Requested → Requirements Needed → Requirements Approved → Development → Testing → Revision → Approved → Deployed → Training → Completed

Every major ERP request should have:

Description

Business purpose

Requested by

Priority

Assigned developer

Requirements

Due date

Current status

Questions

Testing results

Executive approval

Deployment status

The Remote Operations & Executive Assistant should always be able to answer:

“Where are we on this ERP project?”



5. OPERATIONS COORDINATION

Assist management with the coordination of company operations.

Responsibilities include:

Maintain company task and project management systems.

Track deadlines.

Track responsible team members.

Follow up on incomplete assignments.

Coordinate communication between departments.

Identify recurring operational problems.

Help develop solutions.

Document workflows.

Maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Help improve company systems.

Maintain management dashboards and scorecards.

This position should help create an environment where important responsibilities are tracked rather than dependent upon memory.



6. SOP & SYSTEM DEVELOPMENT

Help transform company knowledge into repeatable systems.

Responsibilities include:

Interview team members about their responsibilities.

Document existing processes.

Create process checklists.

Create Standard Operating Procedures.

Maintain SOP versions.

Identify processes that can be automated.

Work with the ERP developer to convert approved processes into ERP workflows.

Help create training materials.

Assist with employee system training.

Monitor whether employees are following established processes.

Our goal is to build a company that operates through systems rather than individual memory.



7. MEETING & PROJECT FOLLOW-UP

The Remote Operations & Executive Assistant will help turn meetings into action.

After important meetings, the individual should document:

What was d
?

What needs to happen?

Who owns the task?

When is it due?

What information is still needed?

What needs Executive Leadership approval?

Follow-up continues until the issue is resolved or responsibility is formally reassigned.



8. MANAGEMENT REPORTING

Prepare regular management reports covering areas such as:

Operations

Open projects

Completed projects

Overdue tasks

Operational problems

Upcoming deadlines

ERP Development

Features currently being developed

Features awaiting Executive Leadership decisions

Developer questions awaiting answers

Features awaiting testing

Bugs requiring correction

Completed development

Upcoming development priorities

Executive Follow-Up

Decisions required

Documents requiring approval

Employee issues requiring attention

Vendor issues

Major deadlines

The goal is to give Executive Leadership a concise picture of:

What is working, what is behind, what needs a decision, and what happens next.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Candidates should have:

Strong written and verbal English communication.

Excellent organizational skills.

Strong attention to detail.

Experience coordinating multiple projects.

Strong computer skills.

Experience using spreadsheets and business software.

Ability to document processes clearly.

Ability to communicate with both executives and technical personnel.

Ability to learn new technology quickly.

Ability to work independently.

Strong follow-through and accountability.



HIGHLY DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE

Preference will be given to candidates with experience involving one or more of the following:

ERP systems

Odoo

CRM systems

ERP implementation

Software implementation

Business analysis

Business process mapping

Project management

Software development projects

Requirements gathering

User acceptance testing (UAT)

Workflow automation

Accounting systems

Inventory systems

Manufacturing systems

AI and automation tools

Odoo experience would be particularly valuable.

The candidate does not need to be a programmer or software developer.

However, the ability to understand concepts such as modules, workflows, fields, user roles, permissions, automation, integrations, testing, bugs, requirements, and system configuration would be a major asset.



IDEAL CANDIDATE

We are particularly interested in someone who can operate between two different worlds:

Business

They can understand an executive explaining:

“When a customer approves the quote and pays the deposit, production needs to be notified automatically.”

Technology

They can then help organize that request into something the ERP developer can understand:

Approved quotation + required deposit received → create/advance work order → assign responsible department → create production task → notify appropriate users.

You don't necessarily have to write the code.

You need to help make sure the right system gets built.



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Performance will be measured by:

Percentage of executive action items completed on time

Number of overdue assignments

ERP developer questions resolved promptly

Average turnaround time for ERP information requests

ERP development milestones completed

Number of requirements properly documented

User testing completed on schedule

ERP issues properly documented and resolved

SOPs created and maintained

Accuracy of management reports

Reduction in administrative workload for Executive Leadership

Reduction in communication delays between management and developers



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

After becoming established in this position:

Executive Leadership should not have to personally coordinate every ERP development question.

The ERP developer should know exactly who to contact when information is needed.

Employees should have a structured method for reporting ERP problems and requesting improvements.

Management should know the status of every major ERP development initiative.

Business processes should increasingly become documented, standardized, and automated.

Most importantly, the person in this role should help transform management's vision into documented processes, accountable projects, and functioning business systems.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys business operations, technology, organization, problem-solving, and building systems that help companies grow.

title: AI Filmmaker - AI Video Creator
description:
We are looking for an exceptional AI Filmmaker to create cinematic images and videos for premium long-form productions.



This is not a traditional video editing position.



The ideal candidate stays up to date with the latest advances in AI filmmaking, knows the best tools available, and understands professional AI production workflows. We create complex, high-quality productions, not TikTok short videos or social media content. Therefore, the ideal candidate knows how to collaborate on the production of this type of material.



You should have excellent taste and a strong attention to detail. You should love cinema, have watched hundreds of films, and enjoy creating images and videos.



Your main responsibility will be to take a finished script and transform it into high-quality visual storytelling using the best AI image and video generation tools available.



## 1. What you will do



* Read and understand the script.

* Align with the manager on characters, visual style, and overall creative direction.

* D
 what should visually appear during each part of the narration.

* Create cinematic AI images. We create complex, high-quality productions, not TikTok videos or social media content.

* Transform images into high-quality AI video shots.

* Maintain visual, character, and historical consistency throughout the project.

* Review your own generations and reject poor results before submitting them.

* Regenerate shots when there are visual errors, unnatural movement, inconsistencies, or insufficient quality.

* Deliver organized batches of finished, usable shots.



## 2. Tools



You should already have strong experience with several advanced AI filmmaking tools such as:



Nano Banana Pro

GPT Image

Higgsfield

Google Flow / Veo

Kling

Seedance

Magnific

Midjourney

Runway

Photoshop / Premiere or similar tools



We do not expect you to use every tool. We expect you to understand which tool produces the best result for each situation.



## 3. What we care about most



We are looking for someone with:



* Exceptional visual taste

* Strong visual storytelling ability

* Cinematic composition skills

* Realistic AI generation

* Character and scene consistency

* Attention to detail

* Speed without compromising quality

* The ability to recognize when an AI generation is not good enough



## 4. Compensation



$1,500–$2,000 USD per completed project, depending on experience, quality, and complexity.



This is project-based compensation, not hourly compensation.



There will be ongoing work for the right person.



AI generation tools and accounts required for production can be provided or paid for by us.



## 5. How to apply



Start your application with the words:



AI VISUAL



Then send us:



1. A link to your portfolio.

2. Your 3 best AI-generated videos or sequences. We especially value videos of at least 1 minute that demonstrate strong visual storytelling.

3. Briefly explain what you personally did on those 3 examples.

4. Tell us about the most difficult AI video shot you have created and how you solved the problems.

5. Tell us which AI image and video tools you currently use most.



Candidates who do not provide all 5 requested items will not be considered. Please do not apply if your experience is primarily traditional video editing with only basic AI experimentation.



We are looking for someone who is already deeply involved in AI filmmaking: someone with advanced skills who has created complete sequences with visual storytelling and has substantial hands-on experience generating hundreds or thousands of AI video shots.



## 6. Selection process



The strongest candidates will be invited to complete a short paid filmmaking test using a real script.



Selected candidates will then have an interview so we can get to know each other, discuss the role, and assess whether there is a good fit. You will also have the opportunity to ask any questions about the job or the selection process.

title: **HIRING: Temporary Housing Placement Coordinator – Insurance Relocation**
description:
ReloCovered is a U.S.-based temporary housing company that helps families find furnished housing when they are displaced from their homes due to fire, water damage, insurance claims, renovations, and other covered losses.



We are looking for an **experienced Temporary Housing Placement Coordinator** who understands the insurance relocation and corporate housing industry.



**This position is specifically for candidates with temporary housing, corporate housing, insurance relocation, ALE, leasing, or similar housing-placement experience.**



### Responsibilities

* Review each family's housing requirements, location, budget, move-in date, pets, bedrooms, school needs, and other requirements

* Source appropriate furnished and unfurnished properties

* Contact landlords, property managers, real estate agents, and property owners

* Verify availability and property details

* Negotiate rental rates, deposits, lease terms, utilities, furnishings, and extensions

* Present housing options for approval

* Communicate with insurance relocation companies, adjusters, policyholders, landlords, and agents

* Follow up consistently until the housing placement is approved and secured

* Coordinate rental applications and screening through approved secure systems

* Prepare and coordinate lease documentation

* Coordinate move-in details

* Manage lease extensions when additional temporary housing is required

* Maintain accurate notes and status updates for every housing case

* Protect confidential company pricing, negotiated rates, client information, and business margins

* Work closely with ReloCovered management to successfully complete placements



### Experience We Are Looking For



**Strong preference will be given to applicants who have previously worked for:**



* Temporary housing companies

* Insurance relocation companies

* Corporate housing companies

* ALE / Additional Living Expense housing providers

* Property insurance claims organizations

* Furnished housing companies

* Relocation companies

* Mid-term rental companies



Experience working with insurance adjusters, displaced policyholders, landlords, real estate agents, and property managers is highly preferred.



Existing experience or relationships within the **insurance temporary-housing industry** is a major advantage.



### You Should Be Able To:



* Understand how an insurance temporary-housing placement works from beginning to end

* Speak confidently with U.S. landlords, agents, adjusters, and clients

* Negotiate rental terms professionally

* Search quickly for properties that meet specific housing requirements

* Manage multiple active housing placements simultaneously

* Follow up aggressively and professionally

* Keep every case organized and documented

* Work independently and solve problems

* Communicate clearly in written and spoken English

* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding pricing and client information



### Ideal Candidate



We are especially interested in someone who has **already worked inside the temporary housing / insurance relocation industry** and can bring real-world knowledge of how placements are handled.



We do not want to train someone from zero on what temporary housing is.



We want someone who understands the industry and can help ReloCovered grow its housing-placement operation.



### Compensation



Competitive compensation based on experience.



**Performance and placement bonuses available for successfully completed housing placements.**



### HOW TO APPLY



Please provide:



1. Your resume

2. A short voice introduction

3. The names or types of temporary housing, corporate housing, insurance, relocation, or property companies you have worked for

4. How many years of temporary-housing or relocation experience you have

7. Tell us whether you have existing industry relationships

8. Your expected compensation



**Please apply only if you have relevant housing, relocation, corporate housing, leasing, or insurance-industry experience.**

title: Immigration Documentation & Evidence Admin

• Reliable & Responsible: You take ownership of your work and ensure tasks are completed accurately and on time.

• Precision-Obsessed: You carefully review your work to ensure names, dates, and documents are accurate before submission.

• Proactive Problem Solver: If a piece of evidence is missing or a screenshot is blurry, you flag it immediately.

• Highly Communicative: You provide brief, daily "End of Day" (EOD) reports so I always know the status of pending files.
