title: META MEDIA BUYER | LOCAL LEAD GENERATION | FULL-TIME
description:
SENIOR META MEDIA BUYER | LOCAL LEAD GENERATION | FULL-TIME



Remote | Full-time and exclusive | Long-term role



$2,000 to $2,500 USD per month, based on experience and demonstrated capability.



ABOUT MOMENTMARKETING.CO



MomentMarketing.co is an Australian marketing agency that helps boutique real estate agencies across Australia and New Zealand generate listing opportunities, grow their databases and build stronger local brands.



THE ROLE



We are hiring an experienced Meta media buyer to take ownership of campaign performance across a portfolio of real estate clients. The accounts focus on local lead generation, awareness and retargeting.



You will review performance, d
 what needs attention, make routine optimisation decisions independently and carry the work through to completion. You should be comfortable working from established campaign structures while using your judgement when an account or client request calls for a different approach.



Accounts will be handed over gradually. Once fully ramped, you are expected to manage roughly 25 to 35 accounts that follow repeatable campaign structures.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- Review every assigned Meta ad account several times per week and identify risks, opportunities and required actions.

- Own routine optimisation decisions, including pausing underperforming ads, testing new variations and making appropriate budget changes.

- Diagnose underperformance using campaign, funnel, lead-quality, creative and account-history data.

- Build, launch and QA local lead-generation and awareness/retargeting campaigns.

- Handle and troubleshoot GoHighLevel and Zapier setup, lead routing, forms, landing pages, automations, test leads and tracking.

- Make sound creative decisions and confidently adapt or QA static ads using existing Canva templates when needed.

- Develop occasional non-standard campaign tests from a clear brief, then assess the results and identify useful learnings for other accounts.



SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



- At least two years of hands-on Meta lead-generation experience, with clear examples of decisions you personally made.

- Proven local-service lead-generation experience. This is required.

- Agency or equivalent multi-account experience. Managing at least 15 active client accounts at once is preferred.

- A strong understanding of campaign structure, optimisation, testing, creative fatigue, lead quality and performance diagnosis.

- Practical GoHighLevel and Zapier experience. You should be comfortable working with landing pages, forms, workflows, automations, lead routing and tracking issues.

- A good eye for static ad creative and confidence adapting and QAing existing Canva templates.

- Clear written and spoken English, strong organisation and reliable follow-through.

- AI-forward, with practical experience using AI tools in your day-to-day media-buying workflow. You should be able to use them to analyse performance, investigate problems and develop test ideas while checking the output and applying your own judgement.

- Comfort making routine decisions independently and explaining larger recommendations with evidence.

- Real estate experience is preferred, but not required. E-commerce-only experience will not be suitable for this role.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



- Full-time and exclusive from the agreed start date, 40 hours per week.

- Monday to Friday. Working hours have some flexibility, but you must be available for scheduled meetings and maintain reasonable overlap with Melbourne business hours.

- $2,000 to $2,500 USD per month, based on experience and demonstrated capability.

- After three months of continuous service, you will become eligible for a prorated thirteenth-month payment.



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject line: Senior Media Buyer | [Your Name]



Please send the following:

- Your current CV or resume.

- A three to five-minute Loom video using the prompts below.

- One or two relevant campaign examples, screenshots or case studies. Remove or blur confidential client details where necessary.

- Short written answers to the application details below.



LOOM PROMPTS



Walk us through one local lead-generation campaign you personally managed. Include the offer, budget, result, your decisions and the part you directly owned.



Describe an account that underperformed or deteriorated. Explain how you diagnosed it, what you changed and what happened afterwards.



WRITTEN APPLICATION DETAILS



- Your current location and time zone.

- Your years of hands-on Meta Ads experience and the highest number of active client accounts you managed simultaneously.

- The local-service industries and markets you have run lead-generation campaigns for.

- Briefly describe your hands-on GoHighLevel and Zapier experience. What have you personally built, maintained or troubleshot?

- Briefly describe how you currently use AI in your day-to-day workflow. Include one practical example and explain what you still check yourself.

- Your current employment, freelance clients or recurring commitments. Confirm whether you can move into a full-time exclusive role, your notice period and your earliest realistic start date.

- Your expected monthly compensation in USD.



Shortlisted candidates will complete an initial interview, a paid skills assessment and a final interview.

Excellent organizational and time management skills.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Experience with project management platforms such as Trello, ClickUp, Asana, 
, or similar software.

title: Meta Ads Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced and data-driven Full-Time Meta Ads Specialist to lead the strategy, execution, and optimization of all paid social advertising campaigns across Meta platforms 
, Instagram, Messenger) for a portfolio of diverse agency clients. This is a highly strategic, client-facing role that requires a mastery of performance marketing fundamentals combined with a strong creative intuition and a dedication to staying ahead of platform algorithm shifts.



The ideal candidate not only knows how to execute, but is also fluent in the latest AI-driven delivery systems, such as the Andromeda update, and understands the new imperative of creative diversification over hyper-specific audience targeting.



Key Responsibilities



I. Campaign Strategy & Optimization (The Science)



Client Performance Ownership: Plan, launch, manage, and scale high-performing campaigns across multiple client accounts and the entire marketing funnel (TOFU, MOFU, BOFU) to meet aggressive ROAS/CPA targets.



Advanced Targeting: Utilize a deep understanding of audience segmentation, including Custom Audiences, Lookalikes (LALs), and Advantage+ Audience parameters, to maximize signal density and conversion efficiency tailored to each client's unique target demographic.



Platform Expertise (Post-Andromeda): Structure campaigns for success in Meta’s evolving AI-driven environment. This includes consolidating campaign structures, embracing broad targeting, and leveraging Advantage+ automation tools for budget and placement optimization.



Tracking & Data Health: Ensure flawless implementation and maintenance of the Meta Pixel and Conversions API to ensure clean, high-quality data reporting and optimal ad delivery signals for every client property.



Budget Management: Rigorously monitor campaign spend, perform daily optimizations, and manage bids and budget allocations (CBO/Advantage+ Budget) to maximize efficiency and scale across your assigned client portfolio.



II. Creative Strategy & Storyboarding (The Art)



Creative as the New Targeting: Proactively lead the creative strategy, recognizing that ad creative is the primary lever for performance in the current Meta landscape.



Storyboarding & Visual Planning: Suggest, plan, and formalize storyboards and visual concepts for new ad creatives, focusing on mobile-first, vertical video (Reels/Stories) formats.



A/B Testing Discipline: Implement a rigorous, continuous creative testing framework (e.g., 8-15 distinct creative concepts per campaign) to consistently refresh the ad library and combat ad fatigue.



Collaboration: Serve as the critical bridge between the Media Buying team and the Content/Design teams, ensuring all visual and copy assets are briefed correctly, align with platform best practices, and address specific audience angles.



III. Reporting & Platform Intelligence



Client Analysis & Reporting: Analyze performance data daily, weekly, and monthly, translating complex metrics (e.g., CPM, CTR, ROAS, New Customer Ratio) into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations for client presentations and internal stakeholders.



Innovation & Updates: Stay current with all major platform updates, policy changes, and algorithmic shifts (e.g., Andromeda, iOS updates). Implement necessary changes immediately to maintain account performance and compliance.



Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of all campaign setups, testing results, and optimization protocols.



Required Skills & Qualifications



3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience managing and scaling high-budget paid advertising campaigns on Meta platforms 
 and Instagram).



Proven ability to manage and prioritize multiple client accounts and diverse campaign objectives simultaneously, ideally within an agency setting.



Expert-level proficiency in Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager, including deep knowledge of setting up Conversion Tracking, Catalog Feeds, and Dynamic Ads.



Demonstrable understanding of AI-driven ad delivery changes and how to adapt strategy to new automated systems (e.g., the importance of creative density and broad targeting in the current ad auction environment).



Proven visual aptitude and creative thinking with experience outlining and briefing impactful ad concepts/storyboards for video and static formats.



Exceptional analytical skills, highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets, and the ability to interpret data beyond surface-level metrics.



Strong communication skills, capable of presenting complex performance data and creative rationale to stakeholders.



Meta Blueprint certification(s) strongly preferred.

title: Part-Time YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator
description:
Part-Time YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator



ROLE SUMMARY



This is a highly focused, part-time content creation and social media management role supporting two distinct brands:



1. A travel-focused YouTube channel

2. The Instagram account for a new podcast brand



The primary skill needed for this role is strong video editing and content creation, particularly for YouTube Shorts and long-form YouTube content.



The ideal candidate should also have strong visual judgment, understand social media content strategy, and be able to adapt their creative approach to two very different brands.



This is not a general virtual assistant role. Administrative work,
 management, unrelated social media accounts, and other business tasks are outside the scope of this position.



HOURS AND COMPENSATION



Starting rate: $5 USD per hour



Maximum: 8 hours per week



There is a hard weekly cap of 8 hours unless additional hours are approved in advance.



There is potential to increase the rate to $6-$7 per hour for a candidate who demonstrates exceptional editing, content judgment, and brand execution through the paid test and actual work.



This is a part-time, ongoing opportunity based on performance.



The candidate must accurately track their working time and work efficiently within the allotted weekly hours.



TOOLS AND ACCESS



The business will provide:



* SocialPilot access

* Canva access, if needed

* Approved brand materials and brand guidelines

* Access to source content and footage

* YouTube Studio access at the appropriate manager permission level



The contractor must provide their own video editing tools and software, such as CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or another professional editing platform.



The contractor is responsible for maintaining their own computer, reliable internet connection, editing software, and any other equipment necessary to perform the role.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY 1: TRAVEL YOUTUBE CHANNEL



CONTENT STRATEGY



Before beginning regular content production, develop a proposed YouTube content strategy based on:



* Existing travel footage

* Available long-form videos

* Previous trips and destinations

* Target audience

* Channel positioning

* Opportunities for Shorts

* Opportunities for long-form content

* YouTube Community content

* Relevant content themes and recurring series

* Recommended posting cadence

* Opportunities to repurpose existing content



The strategy should identify what content should be created first and explain why.



Regular content production should not begin until the initial strategy has been reviewed and approved.



YOUTUBE SHORTS



Review existing travel footage and identify moments with strong potential for short-form content.



Responsibilities include:



* Selecting strong clips or stories

* Developing hooks

* Editing high-retention YouTube Shorts

* Adding appropriate text, captions, transitions, music, graphics, and visual elements

* Maintaining good pacing

* Writing titles and descriptions

* Recommending appropriate calls to action

* Scheduling approved content through SocialPilot



Content should feel intentional and platform-native rather than overly templated.



LONG-FORM YOUTUBE CONTENT



Create or repurpose long-form YouTube content from available source material, including:



* Travel footage

* Existing YouTube videos

* Recorded meetings

* Webinars

* Presentations

* Educational content

* Other approved recordings



Responsibilities may include:



* Identifying the strongest content

* Structuring the story or educational narrative

* Removing unnecessary portions

* Improving pacing

* Adding B-roll where appropriate

* Adding text or graphics

* Creating clean transitions

* Adding intros and outros when appropriate

* Creating or recommending thumbnails

* Writing titles and descriptions



YOUTUBE COMMUNITY



Create and publish YouTube Community content such as:



* Questions

* Polls

* Travel photos

* Conversation starters

* Travel recommendations

* Behind-the-scenes content

* Promotional posts tied to new videos



YOUTUBE ENGAGEMENT



Monitor routine audience engagement and:



* Respond to appropriate comments in the established brand voice

* Like or acknowledge relevant comments

* Identify useful audience questions

* Flag sensitive, unusual, negative, partnership, sales, or business-related inquiries for review



The contractor should not make commitments on behalf of the business without approval.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY 2: PODCAST INSTAGRAM



The podcast has a separate editor who will edit full podcast episodes and produce video clips.



This role is not responsible for editing full podcast episodes from raw footage.



Instead, this person will take approved podcast clips and package them appropriately for Instagram.



PODCAST REELS



For finished clips provided by the podcast editor:



* Create branded Reel covers

* Ensure the visual presentation follows the podcast brand guidelines

* Write compelling captions

* Add appropriate calls to action

* Schedule content through SocialPilot

* Maintain consistency across the Instagram feed



PODCAST CAROUSELS



Identify ideas from podcast clips or related episode material that can be turned into standalone educational or thought-provoking carousel posts.



Examples may include:



* Key lessons

* Quotes

* Frameworks

* Questions

* Mindset shifts

* Lists

* Episode takeaways

* Discussion-provoking ideas



Create the carousel in Canva using the approved podcast visual identity.



The candidate must be able to distinguish between the travel brand and podcast brand.



The same templates, visual style, editing approach, and tone should not simply be reused across both brands.



FIRST 30-DAY DELIVERABLES



The first month will function as both an onboarding period and a working trial.



WEEK 1: STRATEGY AND BRAND FAMILIARIZATION



Complete the following:



* Review the existing travel content library

* Review the travel YouTube channel

* Review the podcast brand guidelines

* Review the existing podcast Instagram presence, if applicable

* Become familiar with SocialPilot

* Become familiar with Canva templates and brand assets



Deliver a concise 30-60 day content strategy.



The Travel YouTube strategy should include:



* Recommended target audience

* 3-5 primary content pillars

* Recommended Shorts strategy

* Recommended long-form strategy

* Community post strategy

* Proposed recurring content series

* Suggested posting cadence

* At least 10 initial content ideas

* Recommended priorities based on the existing footage library



The Podcast Instagram strategy should include:



* Recommended Reel posting approach

* Recommended carousel approach

* Suggested content categories

* Recommended posting cadence

* Suggestions for maintaining a cohesive branded feed



The strategy must be approved before regular production begins.



WEEKS 2-4: CONTENT PRODUCTION



Travel YouTube:



* Create approximately 6 YouTube Shorts

* Create approximately 3 YouTube Community posts

* Create approximately 1 long-form YouTube video

* Create titles and descriptions as needed

* Create or recommend thumbnails

* Schedule approved content

* Monitor and respond to comments at least twice per week



Podcast Instagram:



* Prepare approximately 6 Instagram Reels using clips supplied by the podcast editor

* Create 6 branded Reel covers

* Create approximately 3 Instagram carousel posts

* Write captions for approved posts

* Schedule approved content through SocialPilot



END-OF-MONTH REVIEW



Provide a short 30-day performance summary that includes:



* Content published

* Views and reach

* Engagement

* Strongest-performing content

* Weakest-performing content

* Observations about hooks, topics, and editing styles

* Audience questions or recurring themes

* Recommendations for the next 30 days

* Any recommended changes to the original content strategy



The goal is not simply to publish content. The contractor should learn from content performance and use those insights to improve future content.



SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE



After the initial onboarding period, the ideal contractor should be able to:



* Independently identify promising content from existing footage

* Make good editorial decisions without excessive direction

* Create polished, engaging videos

* Understand what makes a strong hook

* Maintain two clearly differentiated brands

* Follow brand guidelines

* Work efficiently within an 8-hour weekly cap

* Meet deadlines consistently

* Communicate clearly when clarification is actually needed

* Schedule content correctly

* Use analytics to improve future content

* Reduce the amount of content-production work requiring the owner's direct involvement



Creativity, judgment, attention to detail, reliability, and editing ability are more important than simply having years of virtual assistant experience.

You're tired of being underpaid for it, or of doing it somewhere the culture drains you.



This is a real job, with real authority, for that person.



I'm Hunter Garnett, a personal injury lawyer and the owner of Garnett Patterson Injury Lawyers in Huntsville, Alabama. We're a growing firm with dozens of team members. I work around the clock and on weekends when a case demands it, and I need a right hand who can keep pace. I respect my team's time. But the simplest way to earn my trust is responsiveness, and I'll never pretend otherwise.



Here's the honest version of the job.



You'll be the gatekeeper for my inbox and the keeper of my commitments. You'll take the notes in every meeting I'm in and turn my thinking into action items with owners and deadlines. You'll own my to-do list: delegate what should be delegated, complete what you can, and ruthlessly protect my focus for the things that actually move the firm. You'll monitor our dashboards and KPIs and bring me the story behind the numbers.



And then the part that makes this a senior role: you'll help me oversee several mid-level managers and track performance across dozens of team members. When something's slipping, you'll know before I do, and you'll already have a plan.

I'm looking for someone well-rounded. Operations and management experience is essential. Project management and digital marketing experience are strongly preferred. A background in personal injury law is a huge plus, because you'll understand the rhythm of the work without a long ramp-up. You need to be tech-forward: comfortable in Filevine, Microsoft 365, and Asana, and quick to pick up whatever we adopt next.



We run on a daily check-in and a weekly tag-up. Beyond that, you operate independently. If you need direction to function, this isn't your role. If you've been waiting for someone to hand you the keys, it is.



A word on culture, because I know that's part of why you're reading. Our Christian faith is central to why this firm exists and how we treat people. We're not going to make it a job requirement, but if you've wanted to work somewhere your values aren't checked at the door, you'll find that here.



The details. Full-time. Remote. Flexible schedule with meaningful overlap with US Central business hours, and reachable when it counts. Pay: $12.50–$17.50/hour, and I'm willing to pay for experience. Target start: as soon as we find the right person.



HOW TO APPLY



Use the Apply button on this page. Please do not
 us. Applications sent

by
 will not be reviewed.



BEFORE YOU APPLY, TWO THINGS HAVE TO BE TRUE.



1. YOUR PROFILE MUST SHOW YOUR DISC PROFILE AND YOUR IQ TEST RESULTS.

Both are free through OnlineJobs.PH and take about twenty minutes between them. We will not review an application without both showing on your profile.



2. THIS HAS TO BE YOUR ONLY JOB.

Full time, and we mean it. We are not looking for someone to fit us around other clients or a second job. If you are working somewhere else right now, that is fine. Just tell us when you could start.



WHAT TO INCLUDE

Begin your application with the words: RIGHT HAND and then answer all five questions below. Applications missing a section will not be reviewed.



1. THE QUESTION

Tell us about the hardest team or executive you have ever had to keep on track. What did you do, and what would you do differently now? We are not looking for a perfect answer. We are looking for a real one.



2. PERSONAL INJURY EXPERIENCE

How long, and what did you actually handle? Be specific. Intake, medical records, demand packages, liens, provider follow up, litigation support. Write NONE if you have none. It is not a disqualifier.



3. CONTENT WRITING EXPERIENCE

What have you written, who was it for, and where can we read it? Write NONE if you have none.



4. TASK RANKING

Give us your top five from this list, most comfortable first.



   1  Inbox and calendar ownership for an attorney

   2  Task and follow up tracking in Asana or similar

   3  Meeting notes, turned into action items someone can work from

   4  Case file management in Filevine or similar

   5  Medical records requests and provider follow up

   6  Client communication and intake follow up

   7  Content writing for blog,
 and social

   8  Reporting and dashboards

   9  Overseeing other assistants

   10 Billing and finance admin

My top five, best first:



5. AVAILABILITY

Confirm you can work a full day with meaningful overlap with US Central time, and tell us the earliest date you could start.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

We read every application. After the deadline we reach out to schedule short conversations with the people we want to talk to. Either way, you will hear back from us. You will not be left wondering.

title: HEAD OF E-COMMERCE & DIGITAL OPERATIONS Shopify | E-Commerce | Retail | AI & Automation | Direct to CEO
description:
HEAD OF E-COMMERCE & DIGITAL OPERATIONS

Shopify | E-Commerce | Retail | AI & Automation | Direct to CEO



FULL-TIME | LONG-TERM | AUSTRALIAN E-COMMERCE + RETAIL BUSINESS



IMPORTANT: THIS IS NOT A VA ROLE.



This is not an assistant position.



This is not a role where you wait every morning for someone to send you a list of tasks.



We are looking for an exceptional e-commerce operator who wants the opportunity to eventually take ownership of the digital side of a serious Australian retail business.



We operate an established e-commerce store together with two physical retail stores.



We have customers.



We have products.



We have infrastructure.



We have an established business.



Now we want to build something significantly better.



And we’re looking for someone exceptional to help us do it.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We want to find someone who thinks differently.



Someone who doesn’t simply ask:



“What do you want me to do today?”



Instead, they ask:



“Why are we doing it this way?”



“Where are we losing customers?”



“Why did conversion fall?”



“Which products should we be pushing harder?”



“Where are we leaving money on the table?”



“Why are people still doing this manually?”



“What can we automate?”



“What are our agencies actually achieving?”



“What would I change if this were my own business?”



That is the mentality we’re looking for.



We don’t want another pair of hands.



We want a brain.



We want an operator.



And, over time, we want a leader.



THE MISSION



Your mission is simple:



MAKE OUR E-COMMERCE BUSINESS BETTER EVERY MONTH.



Better conversion.



Better merchandising.



Better customer experience.



Better retention.



Better inventory visibility.



Better systems.



Better reporting.



Better automation.



Better execution.



More profitable growth.



Less unnecessary complexity.



You will work directly with the CEO.



Initially, your job will be to learn the business.



Then improve it.



Then take increasing ownership of it.



Our long-term goal is for you to become the person responsible for the performance and operation of our entire digital business.



We want to eventually reach the point where the CEO can ask:



“What’s happening with digital?”



And within five minutes you can explain:



Here’s what happened.



Here’s why it happened.



Here’s what the numbers are telling us.



Here’s what’s going wrong.



Here’s what we’re fixing.



Here’s what we’re testing.



Here’s the opportunity I’ve found.



And here’s what I need from you.



That’s ownership.



That’s the standard.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



You will progressively take responsibility for the operation and performance of our e-commerce business.



This will include:



SHOPIFY & E-COMMERCE



You should be extremely comfortable operating inside Shopify.



You will manage and improve areas including:



• Products

• Collections

• Navigation

• Online merchandising

• Promotions

• Discounting

• Landing pages

• Product launches

• Website content

• Search and filtering

• Product recommendations

• Upsells

• Cross-sells

• Bundles

• Shopify apps

• Integrations

• Mobile experience

• Site usability

• Website performance



You do NOT necessarily need to be a developer.



We can use developers when required.



But you need to understand e-commerce and technology well enough to identify problems, propose solutions, write clear briefs and manage developers or agencies to get things done properly.



CONVERSION RATE OPTIMISATION



We don’t want someone who simply maintains a website.



We want someone constantly asking:



“HOW DO WE MAKE THIS PERFORM BETTER?”



You should understand or be eager to master:



• Conversion rate

• Funnel analysis

• Product page optimisation

• Collection page optimisation

• Cart abandonment

• Checkout behaviour

• Mobile UX

• Landing page performance

• A/B testing

• Customer behaviour

• Heatmaps

• Session recordings

• Offers

• Bundling

• Upselling

• Cross-selling

• Promotional strategy



We want hypotheses.



We want experiments.



We want measurement.



Opinions are useful.



DATA IS BETTER.



COMMERCIAL THINKING



This is one of the most important parts of this role.



E-commerce is not about making a website look pretty.



It is about building a profitable business.



You should understand, or be capable of quickly mastering:



• Revenue

• Gross margin

• Contribution margin

• Conversion rate

• Average order value

• Customer acquisition cost

• ROAS

• MER

• Repeat purchase rate

• Customer lifetime value

• Returning customer rate

• Refund and return rates

• Discount performance

• Product profitability

• Category profitability

• Inventory availability

• Stock-outs



You should be comfortable working with Shopify Analytics and ideally GA4.



Eventually, we want you maintaining a simple CEO-level dashboard showing us exactly what matters.



We do NOT want 50-page reports filled with numbers nobody uses.



We want clarity.



We want insights.



We want the truth.



And then we want action.



, SMS & CUSTOMER RETENTION



Acquiring customers is expensive.



Keeping good customers is extremely valuable.



You should understand platforms such as Klaviyo or equivalent and be able to analyse and improve:



• Welcome flows

• Abandoned cart

• Browse abandonment

• Post-purchase communication

• Win-back campaigns

• Customer segmentation

• Product recommendations

• Promotional campaigns

• Customer retention

•
 deliverability

• Campaign performance

• Testing and optimisation



If an agency or specialist manages some of these areas, that’s fine.



But you will still need to understand the numbers.



You should be capable of challenging an agency when performance isn’t good enough.



DIGITAL MARKETING



You do NOT necessarily need to personally operate every advertising campaign.



We would rather have an excellent operator who knows how to manage specialists than someone mediocre at everything.



However, you need to understand digital marketing well enough to recognise when something is working and when someone is wasting our money.



Knowledge of the following is highly desirable:



• Meta Ads

• Google Ads

• Google Shopping

• Google Merchant Center

• Product feeds

• SEO

• Retargeting

• Attribution

• Landing pages

• Creative testing

•
 marketing

• SMS

• Organic acquisition



You may manage external agencies, freelancers and specialists.



Their performance becomes part of your responsibility.



RETAIL + E-COMMERCE



We are not purely an online business.



We also operate two physical retail stores.



We believe online and offline retail should work together.



You will help us identify opportunities involving:



• Inventory visibility

• Product availability

• Stock-outs

• Promotions

• Customer databases

• Click & collect

• Store-to-online opportunities

• Online-to-store opportunities

• Customer experience

• Product launches

• Returns

• Stock movement

• Reporting



We want ONE BUSINESS.



Not an e-commerce business and two disconnected stores.



AI, AUTOMATION & TECHNOLOGY



This is extremely important to us.



We believe exceptional operators in 2026 should be using AI and automation as leverage.



We want someone genuinely curious about technology.



You should already be experimenting with, or be excited to master, tools such as:



• ChatGPT

• Claude

• AI agents

• Workflow automation

• Zapier

• Make

• Shopify automation

• Reporting automation

• AI-assisted analytics

• AI-assisted merchandising

• AI-assisted customer service

• AI-assisted content creation



But we’re not interested in using AI simply because AI is fashionable.



We want you asking:



“WHY IS A HUMAN STILL DOING THIS MANUALLY?”



If something takes five hours every week and can safely be automated, we want you to identify it.



If three systems should be communicating but aren’t, we want you to notice.



If information is being copied manually from one spreadsheet to another, question it.



Technology should create leverage.



YOUR RELATIONSHIP WITH THE CEO



You will report directly to the CEO.



We don’t want endless meetings.



We don’t want bureaucracy.



We don’t want activity reports telling us how busy everyone was.



We care about outcomes.



Your weekly CEO update should eventually answer six questions:



1. What happened?

2. What are the numbers telling us?

3. What’s going wrong?

4. What opportunities have you discovered?

5. What are you changing or testing?

6. What decisions do you need from the CEO?



Simple.



Clear.



Commercial.



Actionable.



THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Experience matters.



But HOW YOU THINK matters more.



We are looking for someone who is:



EXTREMELY CURIOUS



You investigate things without being asked.



COMMERCIALLY MINDED



You understand that revenue without profit isn’t necessarily success.



DATA DRIVEN



You don’t hide behind opinions when evidence is available.



RESOURCEFUL



When you don’t know something, your first instinct is to figure it out.



TECHNICALLY CONFIDENT



New software doesn’t intimidate you.



OBSESSED WITH IMPROVEMENT



“That’s how we’ve always done it” is not an acceptable explanation.



HIGHLY ORGANISED



You can manage multiple projects without creating chaos.



AN EXCELLENT COMMUNICATOR



You can explain complicated problems simply.



ACCOUNTABLE



When something goes wrong, you don’t disappear or blame someone else.



You investigate it.



You solve it.



And you build a system to reduce the chance of it happening again.



PROACTIVE



You bring opportunities to us instead of waiting for instructions.



MOST IMPORTANTLY:



YOU TAKE OWNERSHIP.



WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY



Please do NOT apply if:



• You need someone to create a daily task list for you.



• You routinely miss deadlines.



• You disappear when something goes wrong.



• You are uncomfortable being measured against results.



• You exaggerate your skills on job applications.



• You are secretly planning to work several full-time jobs simultaneously.



• You think being busy is the same as being productive.



• You dislike numbers.



• You aren’t interested in learning new technology.



• You need permission before investigating obvious problems.



• You are looking for the easiest job you can find.



• You want a comfortable position where nothing changes.



There are plenty of jobs like that.



THIS ISN’T ONE OF THEM.



WHO SHOULD APPLY



Apply if reading this job description makes you EXCITED rather than nervous.



Maybe you’ve spent several years working on Shopify stores and realised you’re capable of contributing far more than your current employer allows.



Maybe you’re already the person everyone turns to when something goes wrong.



Maybe you’ve independently taught yourself analytics, CRO, automation, AI or digital marketing because you wanted to understand it.



Maybe you’ve worked inside businesses and repeatedly thought:



“IF SOMEONE GAVE ME THE AUTHORITY, I COULD MAKE THIS SO MUCH BETTER.”



If that’s you, we want to meet you.



EXPERIENCE WE VALUE



Ideally, you have strong experience with several of the following:



• Shopify

• E-commerce operations

• E-commerce management

• Conversion rate optimisation

• GA4

• Shopify Analytics

• Klaviyo

• Google Merchant Center

• Meta Ads

• Google Ads

• SEO

• Inventory management

• Retail operations

• Project management

• Automation

• AI tools

• Managing agencies

• Managing freelancers

• Managing developers



You do NOT need to tick every box.



An exceptional person who learns incredibly quickly is more interesting to us than someone with 15 certificates and no initiative.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS — UNDERSTAND



Learn the business.



Understand our products.



Understand our customers.



Understand the website.



Understand the numbers.



Understand our physical stores.



Understand our marketing.



Understand our inventory.



Understand our systems.



Understand our problems.



Identify quick wins.



But don’t change things just to prove you’re doing something.



Understand first.



Then act.



DAYS 30–90 — IMPROVE



Establish useful reporting.



Prioritise opportunities.



Fix obvious problems.



Start CRO testing.



Improve merchandising.



Improve retention.



Improve workflows.



Introduce useful automation.



Document important systems.



Start making measurable improvements.



MONTHS 3–6 — OWN



Take increasing ownership.



You should increasingly become the person who understands our digital operation better than anyone else.



Problems should begin reaching you before they reach the CEO.



Opportunities should be identified before the CEO asks about them.



MONTHS 6–12 — LEAD



Become indispensable.



Not because information is trapped inside your head.



Quite the opposite.



Become indispensable because you’ve built such good systems, reporting, processes and standards that the entire business operates better because you’re here.



COMPENSATION & CAREER



This is intended to be a FULL-TIME, LONG-TERM position.



We are NOT looking for the cheapest person in the Philippines.



Read that again.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR THE CHEAPEST PERSON.



We’re looking for the best person we can find.



Compensation will reflect your capability, experience and the value you can create.



For an exceptional candidate, we are prepared to pay exceptional compensation relative to the market.



We also believe exceptional performance deserves exceptional rewards.



For the right person, there will be opportunities for:



• Salary progression

• Performance bonuses

• Increasing responsibility

• Leadership

• Professional development

• Greater decision-making authority

• Long-term career progression



If you help us grow the business, we want your career and compensation to grow with it.



This is not intended to be a 12-month stepping stone.



For the right person, this could become a major chapter of your career.



HOW TO APPLY



READ THIS SECTION VERY CAREFULLY.



We expect to receive many applications.



We are deliberately making our application process different.



DO NOT SEND US A GENERIC COVER LETTER.



Please don’t tell us you’re:



“Hard-working.”



“Detail-oriented.”



“A fast learner.”



“A team player.”



Almost everyone says these things.



SHOW US.



At the VERY BEGINNING of your application, write:



BUILD, MEASURE, IMPROVE.



Applications that don’t contain those exact words at the beginning will not progress.



Why?



Because attention to detail matters.



Then answer ALL of the following questions.



QUESTION 1



Why does THIS particular role interest you?



Maximum 200 words.



QUESTION 2



Tell us about the e-commerce business you’re most proud of working on.



What was your responsibility?



What did YOU personally change?



What measurable result occurred?



Be specific.



QUESTION 3



Tell us about something you improved without being asked to improve it.



What did you notice?



What did you do?



What happened?



QUESTION 4



Tell us about a mistake you made that cost a business money or caused a significant problem.



We don’t expect perfection.



We do expect honesty.



What happened?



What did you learn?



What system did you introduce to reduce the chance of it happening again?



QUESTION 5



Give us an example where DATA changed your opinion.



What did you originally believe?



What did the numbers show?



What did you do differently?



QUESTION 6



What is one repetitive e-commerce task you believe businesses should no longer be doing manually in 2026?



Explain exactly how you would automate it.



QUESTION 7



What AI tools are you currently using?



Tell us specifically HOW you use them.



We’re not interested in simply hearing:



“I use ChatGPT.”



Tell us what you’ve actually built, automated, analysed or improved.



QUESTION 8



SCENARIO:



You become responsible for our Shopify business tomorrow.



You discover:



Traffic is increasing.



Revenue is flat.



Advertising spend is increasing.



Conversion rate has fallen.



Customers are complaining that popular products are frequently unavailable.



What are the FIRST FIVE THINGS you investigate?



Put them in order.



Explain WHY you chose that order.



QUESTION 9



What is something you taught yourself during the last 12 months that your employer never asked you to learn?



Why did you learn it?



How have you used it?



QUESTION 10



Complete this sentence:



“If I owned this business, the first thing I would want to understand is __________ because __________.”



BONUS QUESTION



You have 15 minutes with our Shopify store, without access to the backend or our internal data.



What would you investigate before speaking with the CEO?



Tell us exactly what you would look at and why.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION RULES



Do NOT use AI to manufacture impressive answers that aren’t true.



We expect good candidates to use AI.



In fact, we encourage it.



But there is a difference between using AI to communicate clearly and using AI to pretend you have experience you don’t have.



We will test the claims made in your application during the interview and practical assessment.



If you say you improved conversion by 40%, expect us to ask exactly how.



If you say you’ve built AI automations, expect us to ask you to explain them.



If you say you’re advanced in Shopify, expect us to test that.



We aren’t looking for perfect answers.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR REAL THINKING.



OUR SELECTION PROCESS



Candidates who impress us will progress through several stages.



STAGE 1 — APPLICATION



We assess your experience, communication, attention to detail and, most importantly, how you think.



STAGE 2 — INTERVIEW



We will discuss your experience and give you real business scenarios.



We may challenge your answers.



That’s deliberate.



STAGE 3 — PRACTICAL ASSESSMENT



Final candidates may be given a PAID practical project using realistic e-commerce information.



We want to see how you:



• Analyse

• Prioritise

• Communicate

• Solve problems

• Make commercial decisions



We care far more about what you can actually do than how impressive your résumé looks.



STAGE 4 — FINAL CEO INTERVIEW



The final candidates will speak directly with the CEO.



THE CHALLENGE



If you’re looking for another job where someone tells you exactly what to do every day:



PLEASE DON’T APPLY.



But if you’re looking for an opportunity where you can eventually say:



“I RUN THE DIGITAL SIDE OF THIS BUSINESS.”



Then we want to hear from you.



We will give the right person responsibility.



We will give them access to the numbers.



We will listen to good ideas.



We will invest in useful technology.



We will challenge them.



We will expect a lot from them.



And when they demonstrate that they can handle more:



WE WILL GIVE THEM MORE.



We are not trying to hire another pair of hands.



WE ARE TRYING TO FIND A FUTURE LEADER.



If you believe that could be you:



PROVE IT.



Start your application with:



BUILD, MEASURE, IMPROVE.

title: Dispatcher & Administrative Assistant Role
description:
About the Company



Atlanta Fitness Solutions is a growing fitness equipment repair and preventive maintenance company serving residential and commercial customers throughout Metro Atlanta.



We work with homeowners, apartment communities, gyms, hotels, fitness studios, and other commercial facilities.



We are looking for a dependable, organized Virtual Assistant who can help manage our day-to-day office operations and provide an excellent experience for our customers.



This is not just a data-entry position. We need someone who can communicate professionally, solve basic problems independently, stay organized, and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Your responsibilities will include:



* Answering and returning customer phone calls

* Responding to customer
s and text messages

* Scheduling and rescheduling service appointments

* Confirming appointments with customers

* Managing technician schedules and communicating schedule changes

* Creating and updating jobs inside our field-service software

* Following up on estimates and proposals

* Following up with customers who have not responded

* Tracking ordered parts and updating customers on part status

* Contacting manufacturers and vendors regarding parts when necessary

* Maintaining accurate customer and job information

* Monitoring outstanding jobs and making sure nothing falls through the cracks

* Assisting with commercial preventive-maintenance scheduling

* Updating internal spreadsheets, databases, and CRM records

* Completing other administrative and operations tasks as needed



Systems We Use



We currently use tools including:



* Service Fusion

* Microsoft Outlook

* Airtable

* Google Workspace

* AI and automation tools



You do not need experience with every system. We can train the right person.



Experience with field-service software such as ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber, Service Fusion, or similar software is a major plus.



What We’re Looking For



You should have:



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong phone communication skills

* Experience communicating with U.S.-based customers

* Strong organizational skills

* Good attention to detail

* Reliable internet and computer equipment

* Ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

* Ability to follow written SOPs and processes

* Confidence making outbound customer calls

* Ability to learn new software quickly

* Good judgment and problem-solving skills



Most importantly, we need someone who takes ownership.



If you notice that an estimate has not been followed up on, a customer has been waiting for a part update, or a job has been sitting incomplete, we want you to recognize it and take the appropriate next step rather than waiting to be told.

title: Assistant Strata Manager - Meetings
description:
Yaran Property Group (
) is a property development and investment company established in 1996. To date the company has completed over 1100 dwellings across 60+ projects in WA focusing on affordable housing, and housing for those with a disability.



The mission of Yaran is “to be a blessing to others through housing which is affordable, fit-for-purpose, and environmentally conscious”.



Yaran Strata Management, a subsidiary of Yaran Property Group, is dedicated to providing exceptional strata management services to strata companies around Perth.



Role Purpose:



The Assistant Strata Manager — Meetings owns the general meeting function across the whole strata portfolio. The role exists to ensure that every Annual General Meeting, Extraordinary General Meeting and Special General Meeting is convened, run and recorded compliantly, professionally and on time — for every scheme, every year, without exception.



This is a specialist role, not a scheme management role. This role does not carry a portfolio of schemes and does not manage day-to-day property matters. The single measure of the role is that meetings happen properly.



Meetings carry the highest concentration of statutory risk in strata management. A missed notice period, an improperly constituted meeting or an unrecorded resolution can invalidate decisions and expose both the scheme and the business. Consolidating the function into one accountable role is a deliberate risk control.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Meeting Planning and Scheduling

-Maintain a rolling 12-month general meeting calendar for every scheme in the portfolio

-Track each scheme's financial year end and statutory AGM deadline

-Schedule meetings, confirm dates with councils, and book venues or virtual meeting facilities

-Provide advance visibility of the meeting pipeline to the Senior Strata Manager and the wider team

-Convene Extraordinary and Special General Meetings as requested or required



2. Meeting Preparation

-Prepare and issue notices of meeting and agendas within statutory notice periods

-Draft motions clearly and in a form capable of being validly passed

-Request and incorporate the financial pack — budget, financial statements, levy recommendation — from the Strata Manager — Finance

-Obtain scheme-level input from the Assistant Strata Manager responsible for each scheme ahead of each meeting

-Issue, receive, record and validate proxies and voting papers

-Confirm the strata roll and voting entitlements are current before each meeting



3. Running Meetings

-Chair or facilitate general meetings, or support the chairperson to do so

-Confirm quorum and ensure the meeting is validly constituted

-Manage the order of business, motions, debate and voting

-Ensure procedural compliance with the Strata Titles Act 1985 (WA) and the scheme's by-laws

-Manage difficult or contested meetings calmly and impartially

-Attend meetings outside standard business hours where scheme requirements demand it



4. Minutes, Records and Follow-Through

-Prepare accurate minutes recording motions, votes and resolutions

-Distribute minutes to all owners within statutory and service timeframes

-Maintain a resolution register tracking every decision made at every meeting

-Refer financial resolutions to the Strata Manager — Finance and operational resolutions to the Assistant Strata Manager responsible for the scheme

-Follow up to confirm resolutions have been actioned, and report exceptions

-Ensure meeting records are filed correctly and are audit-ready in Urbanise



5. Governance and Compliance

-Maintain current working knowledge of meeting requirements under the Strata Titles Act 1985 (WA)

-Ensure by-law motions are correctly drafted, passed and referred for lodgement

-Identify and escalate any meeting-related compliance risk to the Senior Strata Manager promptly

-Maintain the evidence trail demonstrating each meeting was validly held



6. Process and Owner Engagement

-Maintain and improve standard templates for notices, agendas, motions and minutes

-Document the end-to-end meeting process so it can be followed consistently

-Work to improve owner attendance, proxy return rates and quorum reliability

-Recommend improvements to meeting practice to the Senior Strata Manager



7. General Support and Flexibility

-Assist the portfolio Assistant Strata Managers with maintenance coordination where required — logging jobs, obtaining quotes, following up contractors

-Assist with owner correspondence and enquiry overflow during busy periods

-Provide cover for team members during leave, absence or peak workload

-Support the Strata Manager — Finance with levy distribution and administrative tasks where capacity allows

-Assist with the onboarding of new schemes as directed

-Undertake other reasonable duties within the strata division as directed by the Senior Strata Manager



Skills and Attributes:

-Experience in strata, body corporate, community title or a comparable governance or meetings environment

-Working knowledge of the Strata Titles Act 1985 (WA), or demonstrated ability to acquire it quickly

-Confident running a formal meeting — quorum, motions, procedure and voting

-Calm and impartial when meetings become contested or emotional

-Precise, clear written English; able to draft motions and minutes that stand up to scrutiny

-Highly organised, with the discipline to work to fixed statutory deadlines across many schemes

-Available to attend meetings outside standard business hours, with time off in lieu by arrangement

-Flexible and willing to assist across the wider strata team between meeting cycles

-SCA (WA) training or certification is well regarded; the business will support relevant training and any applicable regulatory or continuing education requirements



Employment Salary and Benefits:

-Immediate Start

-Full-time, Monday-Friday 9:00AM to 5:30PM PH Time

-Salary: $230 AUD per week

-Benefit: 13th Month Pay



**Working hours note: General meetings in strata are frequently held in the evening to suit owner availability. This role therefore requires regular attendance outside standard business hours, particularly during peak meeting periods. Time off in lieu or equivalent arrangements apply by agreement with the Senior Strata Manager.

title: Google Ads Manager
description:
Role Overview

This role owns Google Ads end to end, across a full portfolio of client accounts. You are the only Google Ads person on the team, and you are trusted to make the strategic calls yourself. Nobody hands you a campaign structure or finished ad copy to load in. You build it!



When a new client comes on board, you take it from kickoff to launch. You get them fully set up and you make every technical and strategic decision along the way. You work directly inside the accounts yourself. You are the point of contact for any question about an account you own.



This role does not own client meetings or client reporting. Another team member handles the client relationship and report delivery. You are the strategic and technical engine behind the account, not the face of it.



Core Responsibilities



New Client Setup & Onboarding

- Own full setup of new Google Ads clients from kickoff to launch, including CallRail tracking numbers, call forwarding and recording configuration, GA4, Search Console, Google Ads conversion tracking, and linking Google Business Profile(s)

- Diagnose and fix conversion tracking issues yourself

- Build campaign and ad group structure from a client kickoff, including keyword research and targeting strategy

- Set up or coordinate landing pages for campaigns where a dedicated page will outperform sending traffic to the main site, thinking in terms of the full customer journey from ad click through conversion, not just the ad itself



Hands-On Execution

- Work directly inside Google Ads accounts yourself

- Write original ad copy, headlines, and descriptions from scratch for new campaigns

- Manage bids, budgets, and targeting adjustments based on your own read of the performance data

- Proactively flag and act on optimization opportunities you notice, rather than waiting to be asked



Other Platforms & Account Administration

- Set up and manage campaigns on Microsoft Ads

- Meta Ads and ChatGPT Ads may come up for specific clients. It's a plus if you're comfortable picking up a new ad platform's setup process on your own, without needing a step-by-step guide, but this is not required

- Handle advertiser and business verification requirements across platforms

- Take on adjacent account administration tasks as they come up. This role is not limited to a fixed task list



Being the Point of Contact

- Field questions about any account you own, from teammates or from the client directly over
, and give a clear, direct answer

- Flag anything that genuinely needs escalation, but the default expectation is that you can answer the question yourself



What This Role Does Not Own

- Client meetings and report delivery stay with the founder and the client success lead. You are not expected to lead calls

- Report automation is a separate, ongoing project. You are not building or maintaining the reporting system



What We Offer

- A real team, not a vendor relationship. You'll work directly with the people making decisions, not kept at arm's length because of where you're located

- Real ownership. You're trusted to make the strategic calls yourself, not handed a task list to execute

- Deep focus on one niche: home service and local service businesses, so you build real expertise instead of relearning a new industry with every account

- A real standard for the work. We chase the 80/20 that actually drives results and stay current on where paid search is headed, not the same playbook we ran two years ago

- A long-term, full-time seat on the team, not a per-project gig, with flexible, async-first hours

- Competitive pay, with room to grow as your ownership grows



Required Skills & Experience

- 3+ years managing Google Ads independently, including a specific account where you changed strategy based on your own read of the data

- Experience managing $5,000 to $20,000/month in combined ad spend across 5+ accounts, including setting up an account from scratch with conversion tracking

- Comfortable writing ad copy from a blank page and picking up new ad platforms on your own

- Hands-on with Google Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, and CallRail, plus landing page setup and full-funnel thinking

- Willing to push back on requests that aren't worth the effort, backed by data or reasoning

- Strong written English for clear async communication

- Home services experience and/or Meta Ads experience is a plus, though not required



How This Role Will Be Measured

- New clients launch on time, with conversion tracking validated before going live

- You make optimization decisions proactively, not just when told to

- Account questions get a clear, direct answer without needing to be escalated

- You push back on weak ideas or requests, backed by reasoning

- Multiple accounts run at once without missed deadlines or dropped issues

Black Swan Media Co is a US-based AI automation and SEO agency. We work with local service businesses — HVAC, plumbing, auto body — and help them rank and generate leads using proven on-page systems. We run lean, move fast, and hold high standards. This is not a generic content mill role.



What this role actually is

This is a leadership role first, SEO role second. If you've never managed other VAs or reviewed someone else's work before publishing, this is not the right fit yet.



Your responsibilities

Lead and supervise a small team of on-page SEO specialists

Review and approve all on-page deliverables before they go to clients

Develop and maintain SOPs for meta titles, H-tag structures, schema markup, and internal linking

Perform technical on-page audits and deliver clear, actionable findings

Write optimized meta titles and descriptions that actually get clicks

Implement and validate schema markup (LocalBusiness, FAQ, Service types)

Conduct keyword research and map terms to page intent correctly

Communicate clearly with the agency owner via async updates (Loom + Slack)

Flag problems before they become client issues

Work hours are M-F 5 am EST - 12 pm EST



What you need to have

Experience with wordpress sites

Familiarity with local SEO ranking factors and GBP optimization



?? Read this before applying

title: Marketing Director
description:
About Starbond



Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand specializing in high-quality adhesives and related products. We sell through Shopify, Amazon, and other e-commerce and B2B channels.



We are building a more disciplined, data-driven Marketing function and are looking for a Marketing Director who can turn customer insight, strong execution, and sound unit economics into profitable, scalable growth.



About the Role



The Marketing Director will own the design, performance, and continuous improvement of Starbond’s Marketing function. This leader will establish the strategy, team structure, systems, decision rights, reporting, and cross-functional cadence required to drive profitable growth.



This is not a high-level advisory role. Starbond is still developing its marketing infrastructure, so the Marketing Director must be comfortable moving between strategy and execution. You must be able to personally calculate, validate, and explain the numbers behind marketing performance—not rely solely on dashboards, agencies, or reports prepared by others.



You will oversee DTC growth across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion rate optimization, brand, and agency performance.



Key Responsibilities



Marketing Strategy and Leadership

Set annual and quarterly Marketing strategies, priorities, resource plans, and measurable outcomes.

Build a scalable Marketing operating model with clear workflows, decision rights, quality standards, and accountability.

Assess and improve the team’s structure, capabilities, tools, data, agencies, and cross-functional handoffs.

Develop capable leaders and owners beneath the role so execution does not depend on constant intervention.

Set team KPIs, coaching cadences, performance standards, succession plans, and corrective actions.

Provide the CEO with concise, financially grounded updates on results, risks, constraints, and recommended decisions.



Profitable DTC Growth

Own integrated DTC growth across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify,
, SEO, AEO, social media, content, CRO, and other relevant channels.

Establish acceptable acquisition thresholds by product, channel, campaign, customer segment, and cohort.

Determine when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue marketing investments.

Connect marketing plans with inventory, operational capacity, product readiness, and financial objectives.

Ensure marketing decisions prioritize profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone.



Marketing Analytics and Unit Economics

Personally calculate and validate CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, CAC payback, MER, ROAS, gross margin, contribution margin, conversion rates, retention, cohort performance, and other funnel metrics.

Audit formulas, source data, assumptions, attribution methods, and agency reports for accuracy.

Identify incorrect calculations, inconsistent definitions, unsupported assumptions, and material data gaps.

Translate findings into specific decisions involving budgets, channels, campaigns, offers, creative, landing pages, retention, and resource allocation.

Ensure all material recommendations are financially grounded, traceable to source data, and ready for executive decision-making.



Agency and Channel Management

Manage agencies supporting paid media, lifecycle marketing, SEO/AEO, content, creative, and related functions.

Define agency scopes, KPIs, service-level expectations, reporting requirements, ownership, and escalation paths.

Independently validate agency recommendations and hold partners accountable for results and deadlines.

Address underperformance promptly through documented corrective actions.

Ensure Starbond retains ownership and access to advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property.



Brand, Customer Insight, and Execution

Own customer insight, positioning, messaging architecture, and brand standards.

Govern creative testing, content production, lifecycle campaigns, landing pages, attribution, and conversion optimization.

Ensure campaigns and product launches have clear briefs, readiness checks, QA processes, measurement plans, and post-launch learning reviews.

Remain close enough to execution to inspect work, resolve critical blockers, and improve quality when needed.



Cross-Functional Leadership

Build a consistent planning cadence across Marketing, Product/R&D, Amazon, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Web Development, HR, and the CEO.

Anticipate inventory, capacity, staffing, technical, and operational constraints before they affect launches or marketing commitments.

Surface risks and difficult issues early, supported by evidence, tradeoffs, and a clear recommendation.

Challenge assumptions constructively and redirect resources when customer or financial evidence supports a different decision.



What We’re Looking For

Proven experience leading a DTC or e-commerce Marketing function with accountability for profitable growth.

Strong hands-on knowledge of paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, CRO, content, SEO, and brand strategy.

Advanced understanding of unit economics, including CAC, LTV, CAC payback, MER, gross margin, contribution margin, retention, and cohort analysis.

Ability to independently recreate, audit, and explain marketing calculations using underlying source data.

Experience managing internal Marketing teams and developing accountable leaders.

Strong experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to defined KPIs, deadlines, and commercial expectations.

Ability to connect marketing performance with profitability, customer quality, retention, inventory, and operational capacity.

Experience building processes and systems within a growing or developing Marketing organization.

Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to clearly present evidence, financial impact, tradeoffs, and recommendations.

Willingness to challenge weak assumptions, confront underperformance, and make difficult decisions.

Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where strategy and hands-on execution are both required.



Tools and Platforms

Experience with several of the following is expected:

Shopify

Meta Ads Manager

Google Ads

Google Analytics 4

Google Search Console

 and lifecycle marketing platforms

Amazon reporting

Looker, Power BI, or similar business intelligence tools

Google Workspace

ClickUp or similar project-management platforms

Agency reporting and attribution systems



What Success Looks Like

Marketing generates profitable DTC revenue and contribution-margin growth.

CAC and CAC payback remain within approved thresholds by channel, product, and cohort.

At least 90% of committed strategic milestones are delivered or formally replanned.

Agencies consistently meet deadlines and receive timely performance reviews and corrective actions.

Core unit-economics and funnel calculations are accurate, consistent, and traceable to source data.

The Marketing function has clear ownership, capable leaders, reliable reporting, and a scalable operating cadence.

Risks, performance misses, and resource constraints are communicated early with recommended actions.



This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If You

Prefer to operate only as a strategist or advisor.

Depend entirely on analysts, agencies, or dashboards to explain marketing performance.

Present revenue or ROAS as proof of success without considering margin, retention, or customer quality.

Avoid challenging agencies, team members, or leadership when the evidence supports a different decision.

Are uncomfortable entering the details, auditing calculations, or personally unblocking critical work.

Require a fully developed marketing infrastructure before you can perform effectively.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and briefly answer the following questions:

Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced.

Explain how you calculate CAC, LTV, CAC payback, and contribution margin. Include an example of how these metrics influenced a budget or channel decision.

Share an example of a marketing report, dashboard, or agency recommendation you found to be inaccurate. How did you validate the data, and what did you change?

Describe your experience building or restructuring a Marketing team or operating model.

Share an example of how you held an underperforming agency or team accountable.

List the advertising, analytics, e-commerce, lifecycle marketing, and business intelligence platforms you have used.





We are looking for a Marketing Director who can build the function, develop strong owners, confront difficult issues, and stay close enough to the numbers and execution to drive measurable, profitable growth.

title: Executive Virtual Assistant / Operations Executor - U.S. Company (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
**About the Role**



We're a U.S.-based consulting firm and we're hiring a sharp, reliable operations VA to take repetitive work off the plates of the Founder and our most senior Partner. This is an internal operations role - you'll be the person who makes sure the routine machinery of the business runs without anyone having to think about it.



You will be given a lot of responsibility quickly. We use AI tools heavily, and a big part of what makes this role different is that you'll have AI systems and pre-built task guides to lean on - so you'll ramp faster and second-guess less than in a typical VA job. But you have to be the kind of person who takes real ownership and gets things done without being chased.



If you're a serial executor who's relentlessly online, obsessed with detail, and quick to learn new software, this is a role you can grow in for years.



Salary: $800/month to start (full-time), with room to grow for the right person

Hours: Full-time, Monday-Friday, must overlap U.S. Eastern hours (approx. 9:00am–7:00pm ET / 9:00pm–7:00am PHT)



**What you'll do**



- Run recurring daily tasks (payment reminders, confirmations, calendar management) using our existing AI-assisted systems

- Monitor account balances and keep internal trackers accurate and up to date

- Send templated
s to clients on our behalf (copy-paste from approved templates)

- Support the team when a client signs (document handling, sending standard
s and instructions)

- Prepare and distribute our weekly podcast materials to the team

- Handle YouTube upload details (titles, descriptions, metadata) with AI assistance, and send the corresponding
 blast

- Monthly reconciliation of advertising data into our tracker

- Basic bookkeeping entries (training provided)

- A wide variety of ad hoc tasks - whatever repetitive work needs doing



**Who we're looking for**



- A true jack of all trades - comfortable with many different software tools and, more importantly, able to learn new ones fast

- Obsessive attention to detail - this is the single most important trait. Small mistakes matter in this role

- Excellent written and spoken English - clear, professional, error-free

- Relentlessly responsive - you reply to
 and Slack in a minute or less during working hours. You're online and reachable

- High accountability and trustworthiness - you own your work, you don't need chasing, and you flag problems early

- Fast learner - you can be handed something new and figure it out, using AI and the guides we give you

- Hard worker - you're not afraid to work late, put in extra hours, or handle something on a weekend when it genuinely matters

- Comfortable with AI tools - or eager to become comfortable fast. We use them everywhere

- Basic video editing skills (primarily pulling short clips from longer videos and basic long-form video editing)

- Any experience supporting a U.S. company

You won't be flying blind. We've built AI-assisted systems and task guides for most of what you'll do, so you'll have support at every step instead of guessing. You'll work directly with the Founder and our most senior Partner - no layers, no bureaucracy. And there's genuine long-term growth here for someone who proves they can be trusted with more.



**How to Apply**



To apply, do the following exactly:

**Applications that don't follow these steps exactly will not be reviewed. Attention to detail starts here.**

title: AI Content Production & Systems Virtual Assistant
description:
### Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity | 30-Day Paid Trial



I’m looking for a creative, organized, tech-savvy Virtual Assistant to help me build and manage multiple faceless social media content channels.



This is **not a traditional administrative VA position**.



I’m looking for someone who genuinely enjoys AI, social media, storytelling, content creation, and figuring out better ways to get things done.



You’ll initially work closely with me to learn my content style and production process. Over time, my goal is for you to independently take a content idea from **research → script → visual creation → video → final organized deliverable**.



An important part of this role will also be helping me **develop, document, and improve our content-production systems and SOPs** so that we can produce content efficiently and consistently.



## What You'll Help With



Your responsibilities may include:



* Researching interesting, viral, evergreen, and trending content ideas

* Researching competitors and successful content formats

* Writing and improving hooks and scripts using AI

* Fact-checking information before it is used in content

* Creating AI image prompts

* Generating AI images and video assets

* Turning images into AI video clips

* Creating AI voiceovers

* Editing short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

* Adding captions, sound effects, music, B-roll, and other retention-focused editing

* Creating thumbnails, covers, and simple graphics

* Organizing content files and assets

* Maintaining a content calendar

* Tracking content through the production process

* Repurposing content across platforms

* Documenting repeatable workflows and creating SOPs

* Testing new AI tools and recommending ways to improve our workflow



Eventually, I would like to be able to give you a topic or content direction and have you manage most of the production process independently.



## Tools



Experience with some of the following is strongly preferred:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Higgsfield

* OpenArt

* Kling

* Google Veo

* Runway

* ElevenLabs or other AI voice tools

* Google Drive

* Google Docs/Sheets

* Notion, ClickUp, Trello, or similar project-management tools



**You do NOT need experience with every tool listed above.**



I'm much more interested in someone who understands AI-assisted content creation and can quickly learn new tools.



## The Person I'm Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



* Have excellent written English

* Have strong visual judgment

* Understand what makes short-form content engaging

* Are comfortable experimenting with AI tools

* Can follow detailed instructions

* Can also figure things out independently

* Are highly organized

* Pay close attention to details

* Communicate clearly when something isn't working

* Can research solutions before immediately asking for help

* Are comfortable receiving constructive feedback

* Can reproduce an established visual/content style consistently

* Enjoy documenting processes and improving systems

* Are dependable with deadlines



I'm especially interested in candidates who have experience with **faceless TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, AI storytelling, YouTube automation, or AI-generated video content.**



## Hours



We will begin at approximately **10–15 hours per week**.



There is potential for additional hours and a long-term position as our content channels grow.



The schedule can be reasonably flexible, but communication and meeting agreed-upon deadlines are important.



## 30-Day Paid Trial



The position will begin with a **30-day paid trial period**.



During the trial, we'll evaluate:



* Quality of work

* Reliability

* Communication

* Attention to detail

* Creativity

* Ability to follow instructions

* Ability to learn new tools

* Ability to work independently

* Speed and efficiency

* Ability to document and improve workflows

Compensation

title: Marketing, Content and Administration Assistant

 and YouTube Shorts

s for approval
