title: Executive Assistant + Research VA for NY Holding Company (Long-term, 10-15 hrs/wk to start)
description:
ABOUT US

I'm the founder of Kordel Holdings, a New York holding company that acquires small businesses. I also run a busy retail logistics store in Brooklyn. I'm looking for ONE reliable, detail-obsessed person to grow with me long-term — starting part-time (10-15 hrs/week) with a path to full-time as we acquire companies.



THE WORK (in priority order)

1. RESEARCH & LIST-BUILDING (biggest part): Build clean prospect lists from public government license registries and directories (I'll show you exactly which). For each company: business name, owner name, address, phone, years in business, license type — into Google Sheets/Notion with zero errors. This is careful manual research, not automated scraping.

2. CRM & PIPELINE UPKEEP: Log every contact and touchpoint in our Notion CRM. Flag follow-ups due. Keep the pipeline board current.

3. INBOX & CALENDAR: Triage my 
 — label, file attachments to Google Drive, draft simple replies for my approval, schedule calls into my calendar.

4. OUTREACH SUPPORT: Prepare mail-merge letters, coordinate printing/mailing of letters and postcards, track responses.

5. PERSONAL EA TASKS: Book appointments (medical, car service), order items online, research purchases, manage reminders. I have a family and two businesses — you keep the machine organized.



REQUIREMENTS

• Excellent written English (you will draft
s Americans read)

• 2+ years VA/EA experience with US clients (references required)

• Expert in Google Sheets + Gmail/Calendar; Notion experience a big plus (or willing to learn fast — I have guides)

• Available at least 3 hours overlapping 9am-6pm US Eastern

• Reliable internet + backup, own computer

• Obsessive attention to detail — one wrong phone number on a list matters here

• Discretion: you'll see confidential business information; an NDA is required



PAY & STRUCTURE

$5-7/hr depending on experience, paid weekly via Wise. 10-15 hrs/week to start, growing with performance. 13th month pay after 1 year. Long-term role — I promote from within as the company grows.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — this is the first test)

1. Start your application with the word BRASS so I know you read this.

2. Tell me in 3-4 sentences about the most detail-heavy research or data project you've done.

title: AI Short-Form Video Editor & Affiliate Operations Assistant
description:
I run a growing affiliate-content business producing short-form product videos and organized product-recommendation content.



I am looking for a sharp, reliable assistant who already understands how social-media content sells products. This is not a customer-service, chat-support or generic administrative position.



You should already understand concepts such as:



Hooks

Problems and desires

Product benefits

Proof and demonstrations

Objections

The main selling content or “meat”

Calls to action

TOF versus BOF content



Marc will select the main opportunities, approve creative direction, handle protected generation tasks and publish final TikTok content. Your role will be researching, organizing, editing and turning approved ideas and assets into excellent finished work.



Compensation

Starting budget: $4 USD per hour

Include your requested hourly rate when applying

Initial paid trial of up to 20 hours

Approximately 10–20 hours per week after a successful trial

Compensation review after 30 days, with the opportunity to grow to $5+ per hour

Performance bonuses available as the business grows

Proven team members may become eligible for a bonus tied to net affiliate commissions generated by tracked work they helped produce

Primary Responsibilities

Short-Form Video Editing



You will:



Edit supplied images, video clips and voiceovers into polished short-form videos

Follow reference videos, scripts, storyboards and creative briefs

Create strong pacing, readable on-screen text and clean transitions

Add captions, sound effects and music when appropriate

Prepare captions, on-screen text and relevant hashtags

Create alternative hooks or variations from the same assets

Proof every finished video for visual errors, incorrect labels, awkward motion, spelling mistakes and bad timing

Export and organize finished videos correctly

Prepare complete posting packages for Marc to review and publish



You will not initially post directly to TikTok.



Viral Format and Competitor Research



You will:



Find successful current videos for adjacent products

Identify repeatable structures rather than simply copying footage

Break down the hook, pacing, shots, selling angle, proof, offer and CTA

Explain why a video is likely converting

Suggest how the format could be adapted to another product

Organize strong references for future production



We do not rely on guessing what social platforms will like. We study current evidence, create variations and allow performance to determine what gets scaled.



Affiliate Product Content



You will also help produce organized product-recommendation content using internal templates and processes.



Tasks may include:



Researching relevant products

Creating list titles and descriptions

Organizing products into logical sections

Writing concise section descriptions

Verifying exact product URLs

Selecting accurate product images

Writing a useful note for every recommendation

Catching duplicates, irrelevant products and broken or incorrect links

Completing a final quality-control checklist



Accuracy is more important than rushing.



AI Production



As training progresses, the role may expand to include:



AI image-generation workflows

Kling or similar AI video-generation tools

Avatar-video production

Organizing approved voiceovers

Prompt execution and refinement

Producing multiple creative variations

Managing tasks and assets inside our private production system



Business software and generation credits will be provided. You will not be expected to purchase software personally.



Non-Negotiable Requirements



You must have:



Strong spoken English

Strong written English

Real understanding of short-form social-media selling

Experience creating, editing or analyzing content intended to generate clicks or sales

The ability to recognize a strong hook and sales structure

Strong attention to detail

Good visual judgment

The ability to follow detailed references and instructions

Reliable communication

A dependable computer and internet connection

The judgment to ask questions instead of silently guessing

Respect for confidential business information and unreleased content



Please do not apply if your experience is limited to customer service, chat support, appointment setting or general administrative work without relevant content experience.



Abilities We Value



Strong candidates will be able to demonstrate several of the following:



Short-form video editing

Direct-response content

TikTok or Reels performance content

Ad or affiliate-content editing

Recreating the structure of a reference video

AI image or video generation

Prompt execution

Product and competitor research

Affiliate or e-commerce experience

Strong file and task organization

Independent work from a detailed brief

Helpful Experience



Experience with any of these is helpful but not required:



TikTok Shop affiliate content

CapCut

Kling

ChatGPT

HeyGen

ElevenLabs

AI image generation

DTC or e-commerce advertising

Beauty, haircare, pet, home or consumer products

Affiliate-product research



You do not need experience with every tool. You do need to understand content and selling psychology.



Schedule

Part-time

Approximately 10–20 hours per week

Flexible and primarily asynchronous

Occasional training calls during U.S. Eastern Time

Consistent communication and dependable turnaround times required

How to Apply



Use this exact subject line:



MAKE MAGIC – [Your Full Name]



Include:



A short introduction.

Your requested hourly rate and weekly availability.

The editing and AI tools you have personally used.

One example of your most relevant work.

A 45–60 second video introduction so I can hear your spoken English.

A link to one product video or advertisement you believe sells effectively.

Answer these three questions about that video:

What is the hook?

Why do you believe it sells?

What would you improve?



Please do not create free sample work.



Shortlisted applicants will receive a brief interview. The strongest candidates will then be offered a small paid skills test before one person is selected for the larger paid trial.



I am looking for someone who wants to become exceptionally good at this work, take responsibility for important processes and grow alongside the business.

title: Maintenance Coordinator
description:
Maintenance Coordinator (Remote, Independent Contractor)



5 Seasons Homestays | Remote | Independent Contractor | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST (with flexibility as needed)



About Us



5 Seasons Homestays manages a growing portfolio of vacation rental properties (~30 properties today, expanding to 50+). We're looking for a detail-oriented, proactive Maintenance Coordinator to keep our properties in excellent condition and our vendor network running smoothly.



About the Role



As Maintenance Coordinator, you'll be the hub connecting vendors, property owners, guests, and our internal team. You'll manage all maintenance scheduling and vendor relationships across our portfolio, respond quickly to emergencies, and keep everything organized so nothing falls through the cracks. This is a great fit for someone who thrives on solving problems, staying organized under pressure, and building strong vendor relationships.



What You'll Do



Vendor Management

Build and maintain relationships with reliable vendors (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, landscaping, pool service, etc.)

Negotiate pricing and service agreements; maintain backup vendor lists for every category

Track vendor performance, service history, and quality ratings



Maintenance Coordination

Schedule and prioritize maintenance tasks across the property portfolio based on urgency and guest impact

Handle same-day emergencies with speed and resourcefulness

Coordinate preventive maintenance and verify quality of completed work before approving payments



Emergency Response

Respond to urgent maintenance issues during business hours and make quick decisions to protect guest satisfaction and property condition

Coordinate with the Guest Experience team during guest-facing emergencies



Communication & Documentation

Keep property owners updated on maintenance issues, costs, and timelines

Communicate clearly with vendors and, occasionally, directly with guests

Track all maintenance activity, vendor contacts, and expenses using Breezeway, Google Sheets, and Notion



What We're Looking For

-Prior experience in maintenance coordination, property management, facilities, or a related field

- Strong vendor negotiation and relationship-management skills

- Excellent written and verbal communication

- Ability to stay calm and organized while juggling multiple priorities and occasional after-hours emergencies

- Comfortable working independently and remotely with tools like Breezeway, Notion, Google Workspace, and VoIP/WhatsApp

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet home workspace, and a backup plan for outages



What We Offer

- Base pay: $
/month

- Additional hourly pay for work beyond the standard 40-hour week, shift coverage, or weekend/holiday coverage

- Performance-based incentives tied to response times, vendor cost savings, and owner/guest satisfaction

- Paid time off and holiday pay

- Comprehensive 2-week onboarding with mentorship from our Operations Manager

- A collaborative, supportive remote team environment



Schedule

Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST preferred, with flexibility for occasional after-hours or weekend emergency coverage.



How to Apply

Please send us the following:



1. Resume



2. Loom Video (Answer the questions below)

a. Short introduction



b. Imagine your primary vendor for an urgent repair (e.g., a broken AC unit at an occupied property) becomes unavailable last minute. Walk us through how you'd find and coordinate a backup solution



c. If you received these four maintenance requests at the same time, how would you prioritize them and why:

1) a guest reports the AC is out at a property they check into today

2) an owner requests a quote for a kitchen remodel

3) a smoke detector is chirping at a vacant property

4) a leaking faucet was reported at an occupied property with guests checking out tomorrow?

title: Lead List Building & Operations Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



FlowLead runs cold
 and LinkedIn outbound campaigns for a growing group of clients. We are hiring a detail-oriented, technically comfortable person to take ownership of our lead-list-building operation.



Your main responsibility will be building accurate B2B lead lists. You will learn each client's target market, create different search approaches, review lead quality, and prepare lists for our outbound campaigns. As you master the process, the role may expand into other marketing and operational responsibilities.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE



We need someone who can think independently and critically.



After training, you should be able to understand the goal, test possible solutions, troubleshoot problems, and make reasonable decisions without needing every task broken into exact steps. You should ask questions when something genuinely needs clarification, but first make a real effort to investigate and solve the problem yourself.



This role is not a good fit for someone who needs to be repeatedly reminded what to do or who waits for detailed instructions whenever something changes.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Learn the targeting rules for each client.

- Build cold
 and LinkedIn lead lists using AI Ark, Apollo, and approved supporting tools.

- Turn a client's target market into multiple useful search strategies.

- Use different combinations of filters and signals instead of blindly copying one search.

- Review samples to make sure the companies and contacts fit the client.

- Export, combine, organize, and deliver completed lists accurately.

- Run the required lead-history checks and AI-personalization steps.

- Track completed work and communicate genuine blockers early.

- Troubleshoot tools and processes before asking for help.

- Gradually take on additional marketing or operational responsibilities as the role develops.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- B2B lead-generation, prospecting, research, or list-building experience.

- Strong critical thinking and independent problem-solving.

- Comfortable learning new software and technical workflows.

- Experience with tools such as Apollo, Sales Navigator, Clay, AI tools, spreadsheets, CSV files, or similar platforms.

- Able to explain why a search or lead matches the client's target market.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Honest about errors and willing to correct them.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and backup plan.

- Interested in a long-term position.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



- Full time, Monday-Friday.

- 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time.

- Starting pay: $500 USD per month, paid as two $250 payments.

- Compensation reviews after 90 days, six months, and annually.

- Disclose any current jobs, clients, businesses, school, or recurring commitments before hiring. They must not interfere with this schedule or your work for FlowLead.



HOW TO APPLY - STEP 1



Do not send a video yet. Start by sending a short written application that answers these questions:



1. What country and time zone are you located in?

2. Can you consistently work Monday-Friday from 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time?

3. What experience do you have building B2B lead lists or performing prospect research?

4. Which prospecting, spreadsheet, AI, and other technical tools have you used?

5. How do you determine whether a company and a contact match a client's target market?

6. Tell me about a time you had to solve a work problem independently. What did you do before asking for help?

7. Is the $500 USD monthly starting pay acceptable?

8. Attach your resume or provide a link to it.



Please give specific, honest answers. Generic or copied answers will not help us evaluate you.



HIRING PROCESS



1. We review your written answers.

2. Selected applicants receive more detailed questions to answer in a short video.

3. Applicants who pass the video step complete a practical list-building assignment.

4. Final candidates join a video call with us.



You will not receive client data or production access during the hiring process.

THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE



We need someone who can think independently and critically.



After training, you should be able to understand the goal, test possible solutions, troubleshoot problems, and make reasonable decisions without needing every task broken into exact steps. You should ask questions when something genuinely needs clarification, but first make a real effort to investigate and solve the problem yourself.



This role is not a good fit for someone who needs to be repeatedly reminded what to do or who waits for detailed instructions whenever something changes.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Learn the targeting rules for each client.

- Build cold
 and LinkedIn lead lists using AI Ark, Apollo, and approved supporting tools.

- Turn a client's target market into multiple useful search strategies.

- Use different combinations of filters and signals instead of blindly copying one search.

- Review samples to make sure the companies and contacts fit the client.

- Export, combine, organize, and deliver completed lists accurately.

- Run the required lead-history checks and AI-personalization steps.

- Track completed work and communicate genuine blockers early.

- Troubleshoot tools and processes before asking for help.

- Gradually take on additional marketing or operational responsibilities as the role develops.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- B2B lead-generation, prospecting, research, or list-building experience.

- Strong critical thinking and independent problem-solving.

- Comfortable learning new software and technical workflows.

- Experience with tools such as Apollo, Sales Navigator, Clay, AI tools, spreadsheets, CSV files, or similar platforms.

- Able to explain why a search or lead matches the client's target market.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Honest about errors and willing to correct them.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and backup plan.

- Interested in a long-term position.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



- Full time, Monday-Friday.

- 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time.

- Starting pay: $500 USD per month, paid as two $250 payments.

- Compensation reviews after 90 days, six months, and annually.

- Disclose any current jobs, clients, businesses, school, or recurring commitments before hiring. They must not interfere with this schedule or your work for FlowLead.



HOW TO APPLY - STEP 1



Do not send a video yet. Start by sending a short written application that answers these questions:



1. What country and time zone are you located in?

2. Can you consistently work Monday-Friday from 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time?

3. What experience do you have building B2B lead lists or performing prospect research?

4. Which prospecting, spreadsheet, AI, and other technical tools have you used?

5. How do you determine whether a company and a contact match a client's target market?

6. Tell me about a time you had to solve a work problem independently. What did you do before asking for help?

7. Is the $500 USD monthly starting pay acceptable?

8. Attach your resume or provide a link to it.



Please give specific, honest answers. Generic or copied answers will not help us evaluate you.



HIRING PROCESS



1. We review your written answers.

2. Selected applicants receive more detailed questions to answer in a short video.

3. Applicants who pass the video step complete a practical list-building assignment.

4. Final candidates join a video call with us.



You will not receive client data or production access during the hiring process.

title: Senior Recruiter (RPO) – Full-Cycle Recruiting & Candidate Sourcing
description:
Senior Recruiter (RPO) – Full-Cycle Recruiting & Candidate Sourcing



Company: Contact Marketers LLC

Experience: 3–5+ Years

Position Type: Full-Time, Hands-On Individual Contributor



ABOUT THE ROLE



Contact Marketers LLC is seeking an experienced Senior Recruiter to support our Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) clients.



This is a hands-on recruiting and headhunting position—not a people-management role. You will not have direct reports.



We need someone who knows how to proactively find great candidates, including passive candidates who aren't actively applying for jobs. You will personally manage searches from initial client intake and candidate sourcing through interviews, offers, and successful placement.



If you are a recruiter who enjoys hunting for talent, building candidate pipelines, and filling difficult positions, we want to hear from you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Proactively source active and passive candidates for client openings.



• Use LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, resume databases, job boards, Boolean search, professional networks, referrals, Google, and other sourcing methods.



• Conduct direct outreach through LinkedIn,
, phone, text, and other appropriate channels.



• Develop sourcing strategies for specialized and difficult-to-fill positions.



• Conduct phone and video candidate screenings.



• Evaluate candidates for experience, skills, compensation, availability, communication, and overall fit.



• Present qualified candidates to clients with clear candidate summaries.



• Conduct job-intake meetings with clients and hiring managers.



• Translate hiring requirements into effective sourcing and recruiting strategies.



• Manage multiple open positions and candidate pipelines simultaneously.



• Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.



• Maintain consistent candidate and client follow-up throughout the hiring process.



• Coordinate background checks and required pre-employment documentation.



• Support offer preparation, candidate negotiations, and offer acceptance.



• Maintain accurate candidate and recruiting activity in the ATS/CRM.



• Take ownership of each search from intake through successful placement.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• 3–5+ years of professional recruiting or talent acquisition experience.



• Strong full-cycle recruiting experience.



• Demonstrated success sourcing and headhunting passive candidates.



• Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, resume databases, job boards, Boolean search, and direct candidate outreach.



• Experience conducting candidate screens and interviews.



• Experience managing multiple job requisitions simultaneously.



• Experience working directly with hiring managers and/or external recruiting clients.



• Strong written and verbal communication skills.



• Excellent organization, follow-up, and candidate-management skills.



• Experience using ATS and recruiting CRM platforms.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), staffing agencies, executive search, direct-hire recruiting, agency recruiting, corporate talent acquisition, or difficult-to-fill professional positions is strongly preferred.  We offer monthly performance bonuses.  



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE?



You're a recruiter and headhunter first.



When you're given a difficult position, your first thought isn't:



"Where should I post this job?"



It's:



"Where are these people working right now, and how do I reach them?"



You know how to research a market, identify potential candidates, build a target list, conduct outreach, generate interest, qualify candidates, and keep the recruiting process moving.



You don't depend solely on inbound applicants. You're comfortable approaching passive candidates and persistent about follow-up.



Most importantly, you take ownership of getting positions filled.



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



Success will be based on qualified candidates sourced and submitted, interviews generated, candidate response rates, time-to-fill, offer acceptance, successful placements, hiring manager satisfaction, and overall candidate experience.



IMPORTANT: HOW TO APPLY



We want candidates who pay attention to details.



When submitting your application, include the word HEADHUNTER in the subject line or at the top of your application.



Applications that include HEADHUNTER will receive priority consideration.



ABOUT CONTACT MARKETERS



Contact Marketers LLC provides specialized staffing and Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) solutions to businesses that need experienced recruiting support.



Our RPO team helps clients keep their candidate pipelines full and their hiring processes moving—from candidate sourcing and screening through interviews, background checks, offers, and hiring.

title: Business Development Coordinator
description:

US Mountain Time (Flexible, but overlap is key).

APPLY TODAY!

title: Business Development Manager – BPO, Call Center & Outsourcing Sales
description:
Business Development Manager – BPO, Call Center & Outsourcing Sales



**Remote | Full-Time | Base Salary + Commission & Performance Bonuses | Long-Term Opportunity**



About the Role



Contact Marketers LLC is seeking an experienced Business Development Manager / B2B Sales Manager to drive new client acquisition for our call center, BPO, virtual staffing, and outsourced workforce solutions**.



This is a hunter-focused sales role for someone who knows the BPO, call center, outsourcing, or virtual staffing industry and has experience developing relationships with business owners and senior decision-makers.



The ideal candidate brings an **existing network or book of business** and a proven ability to turn relationships and outbound prospecting into signed clients.



If you have successfully sold call center services, BPO solutions, virtual assistants, outsourced staffing, customer support, sales support, or back-office services, we want to hear from you.



About Contact Marketers



Contact Marketers has more than 20 years of experience providing marketing, call center, credentialed staffing, and BPO solutions to businesses across the United States.



We help organizations reduce operating costs, improve efficiency, and scale by providing reliable, specialized support teams tailored to their business needs.



What You'll Do



New Business Development



* Generate new B2B sales opportunities for our call center, BPO, virtual staffing, and outsourcing services.

* Activate your existing professional network and industry relationships to open conversations with prospective clients.

Prospecting & Pipeline Generation

, cold calling, referrals, networking, and other outbound channels.

**Important:** This is a self-generated business development role. Contact Marketers does not provide a lead list or established inbound pipeline. You will be responsible for creating opportunities through your existing network and your own outbound prospecting.



Sales & Closing

title: Social Media Marketing + Graphic Design Associate
description:
We're building the in-house creative function for a Japan-based fintech platform, and we're looking for someone we can grow from the ground up — not just a designer who fills briefs, but someone who takes genuine pride in how our brand shows up in public. This role blends design with judgment: you won't just produce assets; you'll read what's actually landing with our audience and adjust.



This is not a template-filling role. You'll be shaping how a financial product presents itself to real users — where a sloppy asset or a careless caption costs us trust, not just engagement. Our audience is discerning, and much of it is Japanese. Quality is the only standard. We train every associate to think critically and reach the right creative call on their own, using AI as a support tool rather than a substitute for taste. Once you've proven you can consistently get it right, you'll be trusted to move fast — real speed is earned through skill, not shortcuts.



We're a growing team, and we mean that literally — the brand guidelines, content calendar, and asset library you'll work with are still being shaped, and we actively want someone who takes initiative to help build them. The culture here is built on mutual trust, shared accountability, and a genuine respect for doing things well. If that resonates with you, keep reading.



Responsibilities:



• Design static creative for social, community channels, and campaigns — posts, banners, announcement cards, event graphics, presentation assets

• Own the content calendar: plan it, keep it filled, and keep it shipping on schedule

• Publish and monitor posts across our channels, and track how each one actually performs

• Recognize what's working and bring that back into the next round of creative — not just produce volume

• Report on performance in numbers, not impressions of impressions — you should be comfortable saying which post did what, and why

• Maintain and extend our brand system — colors, type, templates, asset library — so the whole team can move faster

• Use AI tools to sharpen your own well-considered concepts, not to generate work you haven't thought through

• Keep organized, accessible files — versioned, named properly, findable by someone who isn't you

• Escalate anything involving financial claims, promotions, or numbers to your Lead before it goes out — nothing about money publishes unreviewed

• Follow team rules, protocols, and brand guidelines diligently — structure exists for a reason and will be respected

• We believe every public post is a first impression for someone, and deserves your full presence and care



What We're Looking For:



Non-negotiables — read these carefully:



• Real graphic design experience. Not "I've used Canva." You should have designed for a brand or client with an actual audience, and be able to walk us through your choices.

• A social account you personally ran, with the numbers to show for it. This is the core of your portfolio. We want to see accounts you managed — the graphics you made for them, and the performance behind those posts: impressions, likes, retweets/shares, follower growth over a stated period. Screenshots of your analytics are exactly what we're asking for. A portfolio of pretty graphics with no audience data attached will not get you through this stage.

• Japanese market experience is highly preferred. If you've designed or run social for a Japanese brand, a Japan-facing account, or a JP audience — say so early and show it. This is the single biggest differentiator in this search.



Also required:



• Strong with Figma, Canva, or Adobe — whichever you use, you should be genuinely fluent in it

• A body of work that shows range and taste — we care far more about what you've actually made than where you studied

• High energy and quick on your feet — comfortable with fast, informal communication (voice notes, memes, Slack chaos included) and unfazed by a startup's rough edges

• Confident — you can explain why you made a design choice, and defend it or drop it without going quiet

• Understands hierarchy — you know what you can ship yourself and what needs your Lead's eyes, and you act without being told

• Conscientious — deadlines hold, files are clean, nothing gets published with a typo in it

• Audience-minded — you can tell the difference between a post that looks nice and a post that works

• Follows rules diligently — brand guidelines aren't suggestions

• Strong written English — clear, warm, and professional, and able to write a caption that doesn't sound like a press release

• Sharp critical thinking — you can reason through a brief yourself, not just execute the literal request

• Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, or similar) as an aid, not a crutch

• High discretion — you'll see campaign plans and product information before they're public

• Startup mindset — adaptable, steady, and not easily rattled



Bonus Points (not required, but we will prioritize you):



• JLPT N2/N1 or business-level Japanese — especially if you can review Japanese-language creative for tone, not just accuracy

• Short-form video or motion graphics ability (Reels, TikTok, CapCut, After Effects)

• Experience running paid social or reading analytics beyond surface-level metrics

• Familiar with crypto, DeFi, or fintech products — and the visual language that comes with them

• Google AI Essentials or equivalent AI literacy certificate

• Meta Blueprint, HubSpot Marketing, or similar certification

• Has grown an account from zero to a real audience

• Illustration, 3D, or photography skills



Reporting to: Growth Operations Lead and CMO



Setup:



• 100% WFH from day one

• Flexible hours, output-based — you'll need meaningful overlap with Philippine business hours (JST business hours) for team syncs and reviews, but we're not counting the hours you spend at your desk

• No time tracker

• Deadlines are firm; how you get there is yours to manage

• Team communication via Slack

• BYOD — your own machine capable of running your design tools, plus stable fiber internet

• Confidentiality/NDA agreement required before you see any campaign or product information

• Paid training and evaluation period — Part-Time status running through the 30th of the month you're hired (this lines up with our salary reporting cycle)

• Promotion to Full-Time is based on your evaluation — if your work is clearly solid early on, that promotion can happen before the 30th too

• Initiative is welcomed — stepping up when it's needed is part of the culture here

• Internal growth and promotions for top performers



To Apply:



Start your message with the subject line:

[Social + Design] – [Your Name] – [City]



Then send the following. We read every response personally — take your time with these.



1. Your portfolio, which must include:



The social account(s) you personally ran — handle or link, and what your actual role was (you ran it solo, you handled design only, you shared it with a team — just be honest)

The numbers. Impressions, likes, retweets/shares, follower growth, over a period you state clearly. Analytics screenshots are ideal. If an account was small, show it anyway — we'd rather see 3,000 real followers you grew than a vague claim about a big one.

The graphics you made for those accounts — so we can connect the design work to the results it produced

Any Japanese-market work, called out specifically



If your best work is under NDA or on an account you no longer have access to, tell us what you can and show what you have. We're reasonable about this — we're not reasonable about people who skip the numbers entirely.



2. Answer all three questions:



Pick your best-performing post and your worst-performing post from the same account. What was different about them? (Numbers, then your read on why.)

If we give you a chance at this role, what is the one thing you can promise us?

Think of a time you were part of a startup, org, or company — what's one initiative you personally established that's still in use today (or was used before you left), and became part of how that company actually operates?



A note on AI: using it to help you write or ideate is fine — we use it ourselves. But we can tell when an answer wasn't reviewed by the person sending it, and we can tell when a portfolio piece was generated rather than made. Edit before you submit.



Important: Do not use any of the following words anywhere in your application — passionate, dedicated, hardworking, committed, team player, fast learner, creative, or go-getter. Applications containing these words will not be reviewed. We want your real voice, not resume language.



Applications without the correct subject line, a portfolio with performance numbers, and all three answers will not be reviewed.

title: Graphic Designer / Social Media Content Designer
description:
Essence Marketing & Design is a Hawaii-based creative marketing agency looking for a talented Graphic Designer / Social Media Content Designer to join our growing team.



We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of graphic design fundamentals, typography, layout, branding, and visual hierarchy, not simply someone who knows how to use Canva.



You’ll work directly with our Creative Director to bring established brand strategies and creative concepts to life across multiple client accounts.



What You’ll Be Creating



* Social media graphics and carousel posts

* Editorial-style layouts

* Branded marketing materials

* Reel covers and supporting social assets

* Client-specific content following established brand guidelines

* Occasional AI-assisted creative assets and imagery



What We’re Looking For



You should have a strong understanding of:



* Graphic design principles

* Typography and font pairing

* Visual hierarchy

* Composition, balance, spacing, and alignment

* Branding and maintaining visual consistency

* Designing within an established brand identity

* Translating a creative strategy into thoughtful visual design

* Creating polished, modern social media content

AI Experience



We are looking for someone comfortable using modern AI creative tools, particularly AI image generation.



However, AI should be used intentionally as a creative tool, not as a replacement for good design.



You should understand when AI-generated imagery can strengthen a concept and when traditional photography, typography, layout, or graphic design is the better solution.



The Right Person



We’re looking for someone who:

* Can follow creative direction closely

* Can work across different client brand identities without making everything look the same

* Understands that good design has reasoning behind it

* Can receive feedback and make thoughtful revisions

* Is reliable and communicative

* Can work independently once a direction has been established

This position will begin at approximately 10 hours per week at $4 USD/hour, with the opportunity for additional hours and responsibilities as our agency and client roster grows.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your graphic design experience.

2. A link to your portfolio.

3. Examples of social media or brand design work you’ve personally created.

4. The design programs you are most comfortable using.

5. Any experience you have with AI image-generation tools.

6. Your current availability and preferred working hours.



Please begin your application with the word “ESSENCE” so we know you’ve read the full job posting.



We care much more about strong design fundamentals, attention to detail, and willingness to learn than a long list of software skills.



If you’re looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow alongside a creative agency and work on a variety of brands, we’d love to see your work.

title: Senior Technical Product Content Specialist (Offshore / Fully Remote)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a senior, highly autonomous Product Content Specialist to fully own how our products are explained across marketing, consumer education, and internal training.



This is not a general copywriting or social media marketing role. You will not receive detailed design briefs or step-by-step instructions. Instead, you will be given a one-line prompt and will be expected to gather raw technical details, write the copy, choose the visuals, and deliver a finished product.



All product knowledge currently sits with our leadership. Your job is to extract that knowledge from factory managers, suppliers, and technical documents, and translate it into a single source of truth for our brand.



What You Will Own



Product Knowledge Library: Build and maintain the master reference database covering what we sell, how it is made, technical specs, and key selling points.



Website Product Pages (~40 Pages): Write compelling copy and build visually resolved page mocks using our library of approved design blocks. Hand off complete designs to our web developer (no coding or WordPress management required).



Print Collateral: Write copy, select images, and create photo shot lists for product brochures, sales inserts, and look-books.



 Campaigns: Design transactional templates in Figma for our dev team, create marketing EDMs in Mailchimp using block libraries, and write short-form drip campaign copy.



Sample Presentation Kits: Select product samples, design layout concepts, source supplier quotes for physical cases, and prep printed assets.



Requirements



Experience: 5+ years in technical product marketing, technical content strategy, or brand content ownership (preferably in building products, manufacturing, home improvement, or technical consumer goods).



High Autonomy & Initiative: Ability to chase down information from factory managers, suppliers, and installers across time zones without being reminded.



Visual & Verbal Skill: Strong copywriter with an eye for visual hierarchy, image selection, and layout flow.

title: Video Editor — TikTok / Short-Form Ads (AI video) | US Brand | $1,700/mo + 20% commission
description:
We need one video editor to own our short-form ad output long term. $1,700/month plus 20% commission on every sale your videos generate. We supply the AI video account (Higgsfield), so you are not burning your own credits.



This is direct-response editing for TikTok and Reels, not video production. If your reel is weddings, corporate work, or long-form YouTube, we will not be a good client for you.



WHO WE ARE



VNG Labs. We are a US-based ecommerce brand selling research compounds and lab supplies, shipping from the US, with a live storefront and repeat customers. Creative is the lever that moves our number, which is why this role exists and why it is paid the way it is.



WHAT YOU'D BE DOING



- Producing 8-12 short vertical ads per week, 15-30 seconds, 9:16

- Generating the visuals yourself with AI - we do not have a warehouse of product footage, so a large share of every ad is something you generate, not something you cut

- Writing your own hooks and on-screen text, and building multiple hook variants of anything that works

- Re-cutting winners into new angles instead of starting from zero

- Captions, pattern interrupts, retention pacing, end cards

- Exporting to spec with captions burned in



TOOLS



Premiere Pro, CapCut or After Effects, and real fluency in Veo 3 and Seedance through Higgsfield - including the higher-end models, not the cheap tiers. Second nature, not "I have tried it once." We pay for the account.



THE CATEGORY, SO NOBODY IS SURPRISED



Our products are research compounds sold for laboratory research use only. It is a regulated category with hard creative rules: no health claims, no before-and-after, no promising results, no implying a person takes these. Every ad has to sell on brand, proof and testing instead. If you have worked in a restricted category before, you already know this shape.



WHAT WE OFFER



- $1,700 per month, full-time, 40 hours

- 20% commission on every sale your videos generate, tracked through your own link, for as long as you work with us. This is the real upside and it is uncapped.

- We pay for the AI tools

- Loom feedback on every batch, and we show you exactly how your ads performed

- Work when you work best - deadlines, not fixed hours, with some overlap with US Eastern

- Long-term. We want someone for years, not a project.



HOW TO APPLY



Message us here with the subject line in exactly this format:



VIAL | [your name] | [years editing short-form ads] | [months using Veo 3 or Seedance]



Example: VIAL | Anna Cruz | 3 | 7



Then in the body, exactly these six lines. Links only. No CV, no attachments, no cover letter.



1. Best short-form ad you edited (link):

2. What it sold and how it did (numbers if you have them - "I don't have the numbers" is a fine answer):

3. Best video you made with Veo 3 or Seedance (link):

4. Tools used, and which parts are AI vs filmed:

5. One editing decision in the ad from line 1 - timestamp (mm:ss) and why, max 2 sentences:

6. Loom link, 90 seconds max, camera on:



For line 6: open one of your own videos on screen and talk us through one editing decision and why you made it. We want to hear how you think, not just what you can cut.



You will be skipped for: wrong subject format, a CV instead of links, attachments, weddings or corporate work, invented numbers, or anything that could have been sent to any company.



We reply to everyone who follows the format.

title: Experienced Corporate Legal Operations Specialist
description:
Corporate Focus | Independent Contractor | Remote



We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Corporate Legal Operations Specialist to provide remote legal support to our growing business law firm. The role will focus on business entity formations, corporate governance, annual reports and other corporate filings, business transactions and maintenance, corporate governance, annual reports and other corporate filings, and support for business transactions. 



Candidates with direct corporate or business-transaction experience is strongly preferred and will receive priority consideration. Experienced paralegals from other practice areas may also be considered if they  can demonstrate relevant transferable skills, independent matter management, and the ability to learn new areas quickly. The engagement is expected to begin at approximately 5 to 10 hours per week. As our firm's needs evolve and additional projects become available, there may be opportunities to take on additional work and increased hours. Applicants should be available for regular overlap with Pacific Time business hours for training, meetings, and collaboration with our team.



About Bend Law Group, PC



Bend Law Group is a boutique law firm that helps entrepreneurs and small businesses build, protect, and grow what they have created. From forming companies and raising capital to negotiating contracts and protecting intellectual property, we combine big-firm skill with small-firm humanity.



Our team is collaborative, responsive, and fully remote. We are built for people who want meaningful work, professional growth, and the flexibility of working remotely.



We believe exceptional client service begins with exceptional people. If you're looking for meaningful work, enjoy improving systems and processes, and want the flexibility of working remotely with a collaborative team, we'd love to hear from you.



About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and tech-savvy experienced paralegal who can take ownership of assignments, independently handle routine corporate work after focused onboarding, and grow into more complex matters while supporting the day-to-day legal operations of our growing business law firm.



This position is intended to add experienced paralegal capacity to our team, not simply administrative support.  We are particularly interested in candidates who understand how individual assignments fit within the broader lifecycle of a legal matter and who can review a matter, determine its current status, identify outstanding tasks or missing information, and help move it toward completion.



You will receive onboarding and training in the firm's systems, procedures, templates, and workflows, along with targeted training in unfamiliar substantive areas. You should already have a solid foundation in paralegal work, including managing deadlines, handling detailed legal documents, communicating professionally, and independently managing established assignments, and recognizing when attorney guidance is required. 



Your initial responsibilities will focus primarily on entity formations and maintenance, corporate governance, compliance filings, corporate records, and business-transaction support. You will be expected to gather information from clients and attorneys, maintain complete and organized records, track deadlines, identify missing or inconsistent information, communicate proactively, and escalate substantive legal questions appropriately. As you become proficient with our systems and procedures, there will be opportunities to take ownership of more complex corporate, governance, and business-transaction projects. We value team members who take ownership of their work, communicate proactively, and consistently produce accurate, high-quality results. We are looking for someone who enjoys learning new technology, improving systems and processes, solving problems, and providing exceptional client service.



Key Responsibilities



• Prepare and submit government filings related to the formation and maintenance of corporations, limited liability companies, and other business entities. 



• Prepare and file articles of incorporation, articles of organization, annual reports, California Statements of Information, foreign qualifications, amendments, dissolutions, and other entity maintenance filings. 



• Assist attorneys with corporate governance and business-transaction matters, including written consents, resolutions, stock issuances, minute books, due diligence, closing checklists, signature packets, and post-closing organization.



• Review corporate records and supporting documents for completeness and consistency, identify potential issues, and escalate substantive legal questions to the supervising attorney.



• Review filing requirements and verify that all submissions are complete, accurate, and timely. 



• Identify opportunities to improve the firm's systems, workflows, templates, and internal processes.



• Gather information and supporting documentation from attorneys, staff members, clients, government agencies, and online resources. 



• Track filing deadlines, renewal dates, annual reports, and other corporate compliance requirements using the firm's calendaring and workflow systems. 



• Obtain business licenses and other government registrations as needed. 



• Maintain organized electronic corporate records, minute books, and other legal documentation. 



• Monitor the status of pending filings and communicate with government agencies, registered agents, clients, and attorneys regarding entity maintenance matters. 



• Enter and update information in the firm's practice management, document management, and workflow systems, including Microsoft 365, Clio, and other cloud-based legal technology platforms. 



• Assist with special projects and additional legal operations or administrative responsibilities as the firm's needs evolve.



• Maintain and improve written procedures, checklists, and training materials for recurring legal operations, helping ensure that the firm's institutional knowledge is documented and easily transferable across the team.



• As proficiency grows, serve as an additional experienced resource for the paralegal and support team by answering routine process questions, reviewing work when appropriate, reinforcing documented procedures, and escalating substantive legal issues to an attorney.



You Will Thrive Here If You Are



• Detail-Oriented and Reliable: You carefully review your work, follow instructions, and take ownership of deadlines.



• Highly Organized: You can manage multiple tasks and responsibilities without losing track of important details.



• Tech-Savvy: You learn new technology quickly and are comfortable working in cloud-based systems.



• A Strong Communicator: You have professional English verbal and written communication skills.



• Proactive: You anticipate needs, identify potential issues, and ask thoughtful questions.



• Team-Oriented: You enjoy collaborating with others and contributing to a supportive work environment.



• Self-Sufficient: You can independently complete established corporate paralegal assignments in a remote environment, exercise sound judgment, and know when to request attorney guidance.



• Service-Minded: You have a genuine passion for helping clients and colleagues.



• Positive and Resourceful: You bring a can-do attitude and look for solutions rather than dwelling on problems.



• Adaptable: You are willing to take on new responsibilities as the position and firm continue to grow.

Qualifications



• A minimum of two years of experience working in a paralegal role at a law firm or in-house legal department is required.



• Hands-on experience supporting corporate or business-transaction legal matters, including business entity formations, corporate governance, ongoing entity maintenance, or transactional closings, is strongly preferred and will be weighted heavily during candidate review.



• Experience with corporations, limited liability companies, and related formation, governance, maintenance, or compliance requirements is preferred.



• Experience preparing or supporting corporate governance documents and business transactions, such as board, stockholder, member, or manager consents; equity issuances; due diligence; closing checklists; and closing sets, is a plus.



• Demonstrated ability to manage paralegal assignments from intake through completion with limited supervision, learn new substantive areas efficiently, and recognize when to seek attorney input.



• Demonstrated ability to understand how individual tasks fit within the lifecycle of a legal matter, maintain continuity across multiple workstreams, and apply documented procedures consistently.



• Professional fluency in written and spoken English.



• Strong organizational and time-management skills.



• Careful attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate work.



• Ability to manage multiple assignments and shifting priorities.



• Ability to follow written procedures and document recurring processes.



• Comfort learning and using cloud-based legal, communication, and productivity systems.



• Ability to work effectively and communicate consistently in a fully remote environment.



• Experience supporting attorneys, executives, or professional-services firms is a plus.



• Availability for regular working-hour overlap with the Pacific Time Zone.



• Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote-work environment.



• Experience with Clio and Microsoft 365 is preferred.



• Demonstrated ability to learn new software and technology quickly.



Schedule and Engagement



• Independent contractor position.



• Approximately five to 10 hours per week initially.



• Hours may increase as the candidate demonstrates proficiency and assumes additional responsibilities.



• Potential to transition into a substantially expanded or full-time role.



• Fully remote.



• Regular availability during Pacific Time business hours will be required.



Compensation and Benefits



• We anticipate paying $6 to $10 USD per hour, depending on experience.



• Flexible remote-work arrangement.



• Opportunity for increased hours and responsibilities.



• Long-term collaboration with a supportive, values-driven team.



• Meaningful work helping entrepreneurs and small businesses.



• A culture built on kindness, clarity, teamwork, and zero tolerance for “law firm jerkiness.”



How to Apply



Please
 the following to 



• Resume (PDF) 



• A video introduction (maximum two minutes) 



• Your current location 



• Your desired hourly rate 



• Your general availability and the number of hours you are currently seeking 



• A brief list of the types of corporate or transactional matters you have personally worked on, if applicable



Video Introduction



In your video, please tell us:



• about your paralegal background and a complex matter you handled with limited supervision; 



• If you have corporate or business-transaction experience, please describe the types of matters and specific tasks you supported, and if your experience is in another practice area, please explain how your skills would transfer and how you would approach learning this work;



• which Bend Law Group value resonates with you most after reviewing our About Us page, and why; 



• about a technology, AI tool, or software platform you learned quickly and how it improved your work; and 



• what you believe would make you a valuable addition to our team?



Please use the subject line:



Responding to Job Advertisement - Corporate Legal Operations Specialist

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
ABOUT US



We install whole-home water filtration and softening systems for homeowners across South Florida. We do around 30 installs a month at an average of $3,400 per job. We are the honest-pricing company in an industry full of $10,000 kitchen-table sales pitches — we publish our prices, we install fast, and we back everything in writing.



That promise only works if someone takes care of the customer after the sale. That's this role.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



You are the voice of the company after the install. Your job is to make sure every customer feels taken care of, and to solve problems before they turn into bad reviews.



Call and text customers after installation to confirm everything is working and answer questions

Handle service issues — take the call, understand the problem, d
 if it's a real defect or a misunderstanding, and coordinate the fix with our field team



Manage our Biscayne Care maintenance plan — schedule salt deliveries, annual filter replacements, and follow-ups

Turn happy customers into reviews and referrals — ask for the Google review at the right moment

Save cancellations — when someone wants to cancel their plan, find out why and fix the real reason

Keep the CRM clean — every call logged, every issue tracked to closed

Escalate properly — you'll know what you can solve and what needs the owner



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required:



Excellent spoken English. Clear, natural, easy for an American homeowner to understand. This is non-negotiable — you will be on the phone with US customers every day.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
Anything Supplies Global is looking for an organised, confident and results-focused Sales Team Administrator to help us build and support our growing network of Independent Sales Partners.



This is more than a general administration role. You will work closely with our sales partners, help train and onboard them, monitor their opportunities, maintain accurate CRM records and support them as they move leads through to RFQs, quotations and successful sales.



Your Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Onboarding and training new Independent Sales Partners.

* Teaching partners how to use our CRM and follow our sales process.

* Maintaining partner records, agreements and documents.

* Monitoring leads, RFQs, quotations and follow-ups.

Experience in B2B sales, business development, quotations, RFQs, logistics or procurement will be highly regarded.



Employment Details



* Full-time position.

* Monthly salary of 35,000 to 45,000, depending on experience.

* Remote Philippines-based role.

* Opportunity for future salary growth and performance incentives.

We are looking for someone who can keep the sales team organised, supported and focused on moving genuine opportunities toward successful and profitable sales.

Help us build a strong sales network, support great people and turn opportunities into results.

title: AI Creative & Shopify Landing Page Designer
description:
Job Description



We’re hiring a full-time AI Creative & Shopify Landing Page Designer to work across a handful of DTC brands in the fashion, fitness, and beauty niches selling in Scandinavia.



This role is for someone who is highly competent, fast, independent, and deeply fluent with AI tools. You should be able to take concepts, references, product details, brand direction, and rough ideas — then turn them into polished static ad creatives and Shopify landing pages without needing constant hand-holding.



We are not looking for a basic Canva designer or someone who only follows templates. We are looking for a sharp ecommerce creative who understands Shopify design, can build directly inside Shopify, and knows how to use AI tools daily to move faster and produce better work.



What You’ll Be Doing



You will create static ad concepts in a wide range of styles for our DTC brands. This includes AI-generated product visuals, lifestyle concepts, comparison ads, testimonial-style creatives, problem-solution graphics, product benefit visuals, and other ecommerce-focused static ads.



You will also build landing pages directly inside regular Shopify, based on concepts, references, and direction provided by us. You should be comfortable working inside the Shopify theme editor, building page sections, adjusting layouts, improving visual presentation, and solving small design or code-related issues when they come up.



This is a hands-on execution role, but you should also be able to think creatively and suggest better ways to execute a concept when needed.



Tools & Skills We Care About



You should be highly comfortable using AI tools every day, especially for image generation, prompt refinement, creative problem-solving, and Shopify troubleshooting.



Experience with the following is highly relevant:



* Higgsfield

* ChatGPT / GPT

* Claude

* Nano Banana

* Canva or another strong visual editing platform

* Shopify theme editor

* Basic Liquid/CSS troubleshooting with the help of AI

* AI prompt refinement and image-generation iteration



Higgsfield understanding is especially important. You should know how to troubleshoot AI-generated visuals, refine prompts, fix weak outputs, and keep iterating until the final result looks strong enough for ecommerce use.



Requirements



You should have at least **1–2 years of ecommerce, Shopify, design, or AI creative experience**.



You must be able to:



* Create strong static ad concepts using AI

* Build landing pages directly inside Shopify

* Work quickly without sacrificing quality

* Follow references and brand direction closely

* Use AI tools daily as part of your workflow

* Troubleshoot problems independently

* Work with copy provided by our copywriters

* Handle Scandinavian-language copy carefully, even if you do not speak the language

* Communicate clearly and directly

* Manage tasks through Notion

* Work full-time with high availability and high output expectations



You do not need to be fluent in Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish. Our copywriters handle the copy. However, you need to be careful when placing Scandinavian text into designs and landing pages.



Who This Role Is For



This role is for someone who is brutally competent, resourceful, and AI-native.



You should enjoy figuring things out. When something breaks in Shopify, you should be able to use AI, documentation, and your own judgment to solve it. When an AI image output looks bad, you should know how to refine the prompt, change the direction, or manually polish the asset until it works.



You should be comfortable being given a reference and a goal, then independently producing something usable.



Who This Role Is Not For



This is not for someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every task.



This is not for someone who only makes generic Canva templates.



This is not for someone who claims to “know AI” but cannot consistently generate high-quality visuals.



This is not for someone who only designs pages but cannot build them inside Shopify.



This is not for someone who works slowly, waits around, or gives up when a tool produces a bad result.



Work Setup



This is a full-time remote role. You can work from anywhere in the world.



Tasks will be assigned through **Notion**, and you will communicate directly with us.



Compensation is a **competitive salary based on experience, skill level, and output quality.



To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Examples of AI-generated static ad creatives you have made

3. Examples of Shopify landing pages or ecommerce pages you have built

4. A quick explanation of which AI tools you use most and how you use them in your workflow

5. Your availability and expected monthly salary



We care much more about output quality, speed, taste, and problem-solving ability than formal credentials.

title: TRUST ACCOUNTANT - SHORT TERM ACCOMODATION AGENCY
description:
We are an Australian property business in the Blue Mountains, west of Sydney. We a short-stay holiday letting business that manages 25 properties for their owners.



We are looking for one careful, reliable bookkeeper to take over the day-to-day accounts work for the holiday letting business.



Here is the part that matters. Every week, guests pay money that belongs to our property owners, not to us. It arrives from Airbnb, 
 and direct bookings, in lump sums that do not match the individual bookings. Your job is to take those payouts apart, match every dollar — to the right booking and the right property, and make sure each owner gets paid exactly what they are owed at the end of the month.



If a number does not balance, we need to know about it that day. We do not want it smoothed over.



What you will do every week



Match platform payouts (Airbnb, 
, Stripe) against individual bookings in Guesty, allowing for platform commission, processing fees, refunds and chargebacks

Enter and code supplier invoices in Xero — cleaners, linen, gardeners, tradespeople

Keep each property's ledger up to date so we always know what it has earned and what it has cost

Chase missing invoices and unmatched payments

Flag anything that does not reconcile

What you will do every month



Prepare the bank reconciliation for review

Prepare owner statements: gross revenue, less our commission, less cleaning, linen, consumables and maintenance

Prepare the supplier payment run

Prepare a summary report by property: revenue, costs, occupancy

Prepare GST figures for our Australian accountant

What you will NOT do



You will not have authority to move money. You will not approve payments or be a bank signatory. Under Australian law those responsibilities stay with our licensed staff in Sydney. You prepare the work, we review and release it. This is not a limitation on you — it is how the regulation works here.



SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Essential



At least 2 years bookkeeping experience, including work for Australian or other international clients

Strong Xero skills — you should be comfortable with bank rules, manual journals, and reconciling accounts that do not balance easily

Confident with spreadsheets. You will be matching hundreds of line items and you need to be fast and accurate with lookups and pivots

Excellent written English. You will be writing owner statements and
s that Australian property owners will read

A stable internet connection and a working computer

Available to start within 4 weeks

Nice to have, not required



Experience with Guesty, Hostaway, Uplisting or another short-stay platform

Experience with Australian real estate trust accounting

Understanding of Australian GST

Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, or CPA

WHAT WE OFFER

Steady, long-term work. We are not looking for a short project — we want someone who is still here in five years

Paid Philippine public holidays and paid leave after 6 months

Genuine training on our systems, and a documented process for everything

A small team. You will work directly with our General Manager and with our existing VA, and you will hear directly from the business owner

Annual review and increase for good work

HOW TO APPLY

Please follow these instructions exactly. Applications that do not follow them will not be read.



Start your message with the word RECONCILE so we know you read the whole ad.

Tell us, in your own words, how you would handle this situation: a payout of AUD 4,820 lands in the bank account. Your system says the bookings in that payout period total AUD 5,110. What do you do?

Tell us how long you have used Xero and what kind of clients you used it for.

Tell us your internet speed and your available hours in Philippine time.

Attach your CV.

We read every application that follows the steps. We will reply to shortlisted applicants within one week, and there will be a short paid test task before we make an offer.

title: Elite Acquisitions Closer U.S. Real Estate | Remote | USD Pay
description:
We run a high margin U.S. real estate niche most investors can't touch: partial deeds and title problems. We help families untangle complicated ownership and unlock properties nobody else knows how to close. The deals are unusual, the margins are strong, and the best closer on our team is closing roughly one deal a week.



We're hiring one more sharp closer. The bar is high on purpose.





What This Is





A real sales seat. You research families, get on the phone every day, and build trust with people in hard situations.

This is not a VA role. Not admin. Not "manage a pipeline quietly." You dial, you talk, you move deals.

You'll own leads inside Lofty (our CRM), dial through Dialpad, and pull contacts with SmartSkip.





Your Day





Daily huddle, 10:00 AM ET, cameras on, no exceptions. We review numbers, wins, and blockers together.

75 dials per day minimum, tracked. Your dials, contacts, and conversion are visible to the team every day.

Roughly 40 to 50% research (obituaries, court and tax records, identifying heirs and the real decision maker) and 50 to 60% outreach (calls, texts, voi
s, follow up).

We run a two call close structure. You'll learn it cold.





How We Operate (so you know before you apply)





We track activity daily. If you go dark for a day with no heads up, you won't last here.

We coach hard and expect you to be coachable. B+ players who show up beat A players who don't.

Full training from day one. Clear path to Senior Closer and team lead as you prove out.







What You Need





English at C1/C2 only. Families need to trust your voice on the phone.

5+ years sales experience. Real estate (acquisitions, wholesaling, probate, title) strongly preferred.

Total comfort with daily outbound calling, voi
s, and relentless follow up.

Sharp judgment on who the real decision maker is inside a family.

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, quality headset. Non negotiable.





Schedule





Full time, Monday to Friday

10:00 AM to 7:30 PM Eastern Time





Pay





Base: $1,000 to $1,500 USD per month based on experience

Commission: 10 to 15% depending on deal revenue. Our average deal is over $30,000, so a single close pays well.

Realistic total once ramped: $8,000 per month

Be clear eyed on timing: most reps lock their first deal within 30 days, and commission on that deal pays out around 100 days later once it closes and funds. This niche pays big, but it is not instant money. If you need a paycheck next week, this isn't the seat.







How to Apply



Send a 1 to 2 minute video covering:





Your sales and real estate background

How comfortable you truly are with heavy daily outbound calling

Why you're great at finding and speaking to the right decision maker in a family

Your location and availability

title: Shopify Store Manager and Landing Page / CRO Builder
description:
Role overview:



You will own our Shopify storefront: building and optimizing landing pages, supporting launches and promotions, and keeping the store running well day to day. Our site takes heavy traffic from Meta and Google paid ads, so every page you build has real spend behind it and conversion rate is the number that matters.



We will often hand you a rough idea rather than a finished spec. You take it and build the page to the standard of the rest of the site. You will work directly with the founder and marketing team.



Look at our store before applying. That will tell you most of what this job is.



What you'll do:



- Build and optimize high-converting Shopify landing pages and product pages

- Turn rough concepts into finished, on-brand pages without needing every detail specified

- Build comparison pages, advertorials, and prelanders for paid traffic campaigns

- Build page variants for testing, since we test landing pages continuously against live ad spend

- Support product launches, promotions, and seasonal campaigns, including banners, hero sections, and announcement bars

- Implement CRO features: sticky add-to-cart, upsells and bundles, review and trust sections, FAQs, mobile-first optimizations

- Keep listings, collections, images, and copy accurate and current

- General store upkeep: broken links, mobile rendering issues, app settings, page speed



About RuffRover:



RuffRover is a fast-growing US-based ecommerce pet travel brand. We make premium products that help people travel with their dogs more safely and comfortably. Our flagship product, the RuffRover 2.0, has shipped to thousands of pet owners. Small, fast-moving team with a strong focus on customer experience and long-term growth.



What we're looking for:



- Real hands-on Shopify experience. You have built pages, not just watched someone else do it

- Comfortable in a premium theme with a page builder, and able to go into HTML, CSS, or Liquid when a section needs it

- CRO mindset. You think about what a page is supposed to do, not just how it looks

- Speed. Campaigns wait on pages, so turnaround matters as much as polish

- Strong eye for modern ecommerce design and UX

- Mobile-first thinking. Most of our traffic is on phones and most mistakes show up there first

- You catch your own errors before we do

- Work independently, take ownership, move fast

- Reliable English over Slack and WhatsApp, stable internet, your own computer



Nice to have:



- Landing pages built for Meta or Google paid traffic

- Upsells, bundles, and AOV optimization

- A/B testing, basic copywriting

- Canva, Figma, or Photoshop

- Pet, lifestyle, or DTC brand experience



Why join RuffRover:



Fully remote with high ownership. Direct access to the founder, no layers to work through. Your work shows up in revenue quickly and you will see the results. Real growth potential as the company scales.



How to apply:



Start your application with the word STOREBUILD so we know you read this.



Then send:



Links to 3 Shopify pages you built

Any conversion results or metrics from past work, if you have them

One sentence on what you would change first on our product page and why



Shortlisted applicants get a small paid test task: build one landing page from a wireframe and copy doc. Long-term contractor role with room to grow.
