title: Sales Manager
description:
Apollo & Rose Capital, Inc. is seeking driven, polished, and results-oriented Sales Representatives to join our growing sales organization. This role is designed for professionals who know how to build trust, develop a pipeline, convert qualified prospects, and maintain strong client relationships in a financial-services environment.



Our Sales Representatives will sale 3 key products to prospective clients (1) Credit Repair services, (2) Personal Loans, (3) Business Loans solutions. The ideal candidate combines a strong sales mentality with professionalism, disciplined follow-up, excellent communication, and an understanding that financial products must be presented accurately and responsibly.



Key Responsibilities:



Develop and maintain a consistent pipeline of prospective clients through outbound prospecting, referrals, networking, follow-up, and company-generated opportunities.

Conduct professional consultations to understand each prospective client’s objectives, financial needs, and interest in ARC’s available products and services.

Educate prospective clients regarding ARC’s credit restoration, personal loan, and business loan solutions using approved company materials and representations.

Convert qualified prospects into clients while maintaining a consultative, relationship-driven sales approach.

Assist prospective borrowers with the initial application and intake process and coordinate appropriately with ARC’s intake and loan-processing personnel.

Maintain accurate and timely records of leads, communications, consultations, applications, follow-up activity, and sales results within ARC’s CRM.

Consistently follow up with prospective clients throughout the sales cycle and maintain an organized pipeline.

Develop referral relationships and identify opportunities to generate new business.

Meet or exceed established individual sales, activity, conversion, and client-acquisition objectives.

Protect confidential client and company information and comply with ARC policies, procedures, scripts, disclosures, and applicable compliance requirements.

Represent ARC with professionalism, discretion, integrity, and sound judgment in every client interaction.

Avoid unauthorized representations concerning credit-score increases, deletion of accurate information, loan approval, interest rates, funding amounts, funding timelines, or other outcomes that ARC or its lending partners have not expressly authorized.



Qualifications & Experience:



Prior sales experience is strongly preferred, (1) Credit Repair, (2) Personal Loans, (3) Consumer Loans, (4) Bookkeeping and Financial Planning, or (5) another performance-driven sales environment. Candidates should possess excellent verbal and written communication skills, confidence conducting telephone and virtual consultations, strong closing and follow-up abilities, and the discipline necessary to succeed in a fully remote environment. Experience using a CRM, managing a sales pipeline, conducting outbound prospecting, and developing referral relationships is highly desirable.

Candidates with an existing professional network, referral base, book of business, or demonstrated ability to independently generate qualified prospects will receive particular consideration.



What Success Looks Like:

ARC is looking for sales professionals who understand that exceptional sales performance is not merely about closing a transaction. It is about establishing credibility, identifying a legitimate client need, presenting the appropriate solution accurately, and building a relationship that reflects positively on the Company.

Successful representatives will be expected to maintain a healthy pipeline, communicate consistently, demonstrate strong conversion discipline, and contribute meaningfully to ARC’s client-acquisition and revenue objectives.

Compensation



Target Pay: $600 to #$3,200 USD per month.



Compensation within this range will depend on the applicable compensation structure, individual production, and other terms established by Apollo & Rose Capital. Any commission, incentive, or performance-based compensation terms will be governed by the representative’s written compensation agreement or plan.



Work Location: Remote — (United States - Clients). 

Positions Available: 3 spots. 

MUST BE ABLE TO START September 7, 2026.

MUST BE ABLE TO ACQUIRE: 30 Clients per month with warm leads. 



About Apollo & Rose Capital Inc:

Apollo & Rose Capital is a financial-services organization focused on helping clients move forward through credit restoration and access to personal and business financing solutions. Our approach is built around professionalism, responsible client service, disciplined execution, and long-term relationships.

Apollo & Rose Capital, Inc. - Bridging Clients Forward. 



Equal Opportunity: Apollo & Rose Capital, Inc. is committed to providing equal employment opportunities consistent with applicable law. Employment decisions are based on legitimate business considerations, qualifications, performance, and organizational needs.

title: Project Manager - Practice Management Platform
description:
Healthcare practice management platform

Employment type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Fully remote (any location)

Working hours: 9:00am – 6:00pm Sydney time (AEST/AEDT), Mon–Fri

Team size: 8+ developers plus QA



About us

We are a healthcare organisation. Alongside our clinical and operational business, we build and run our own

software — the platforms our practices, partners and customers use every day, spanning both B2B and B2C use

cases. Our development, QA and product teams work remotely across multiple time zones, anchored to Sydney

business hours.

We are a small, hands-on technology group. Decisions get made quickly, the approval chain is short, and the

person managing a project is genuinely the person who owns it.



About the role

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to take end-to-end ownership of our Australian healthcare

practice management platform.



The platform runs live healthcare practices. Appointments, patient records, clinical workflow and billing all

depend on it, which makes release quality and regression discipline the defining features of this role. A bad

release is not an inconvenience for our customers — it stops them seeing patients.

You will own the delivery of a substantial roadmap with a team of 8+ developers plus QA, and you will also be

pulled onto adjacent initiatives — device integrations, support tooling, partner projects — at short notice. Being

able to switch context quickly and come back without losing the thread is essential.





The product

Practice Management Platform

An Australian healthcare practice management system used day-to-day by healthcare practices. Ongoing work

spans clinical workflow, patient data, third-party device and imaging integrations, customer support tooling, and

platform modernisation.





What you will do

• Own end-to-end delivery of the platform roadmap — scope, plan, schedule, dependencies, risk, budget and

release.

• Run the day-to-day delivery cadence in Jira: backlog grooming, sprint planning, stand-ups, velocity and

burndown reporting, and honest status reporting to stakeholders.

• Keep Confluence current and authoritative — requirements, functional specs, clinical workflow

documentation, architecture decisions, runbooks and release notes.

• Lead a delivery team of 8+ developers alongside QA, working with tech leads on sequencing, capacity and

technical dependencies.

• Own the QA/QC gate with particular rigour. Practices depend on this system: regression coverage, staged

rollouts, UAT with real practice users, defect triage and a defensible go/no-go on every release are all

yours.

• Plan releases against AWS-hosted environments (EC2, RDS) with the engineering team — environment

readiness, release windows, data migrations, backup verification and rollback plans.

• Coordinate third-party and device integrations, and manage the vendor relationships that come with them.

• Work closely with customer support and practice-facing teams so that production issues, escalations and

customer feedback feed back into the backlog properly.

Manage stakeholders across clinical, operations and executive; give them a clear, regular, unvarnished

picture of where delivery stands.

• Pick up adjacent projects at short notice and integrate them into the delivery plan without derailing the core

roadmap.

• Continuously improve how we deliver — process, tooling, documentation and release safety.

What you must bring

• 5+ years' experience as a Project Manager or Delivery Manager on commercial software products (not

internal IT projects alone).

• Proven track record managing large delivery efforts with development teams of 8 or more engineers, plus

dedicated QA.

• Expert-level Jira — epics and stories, boards, sprints, workflows, JQL, dashboards and delivery reporting.

You should be comfortable configuring, not just using.

• Expert-level Confluence — you treat it as the single source of truth and you keep it that way: specs,

decision logs, runbooks, release notes, meeting outcomes.

• Working knowledge of AWS, specifically EC2 and RDS. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must

be able to plan releases, environments, migrations, backups and rollbacks with engineers and understand

what you are agreeing to.

• Hands-on oversight of QA/QC — test planning, UAT coordination, defect triage and prioritisation, and

release sign-off.

• Comfortable running Agile (Scrum or Kanban) with the pragmatism to bend it when the work calls for it.

• Genuinely adaptable and fast-moving. You will switch between projects inside the same week and be

expected to pick each one back up without losing the thread.

• Excellent written English and a written-first communication habit — this is non-negotiable in a distributed

team.

• Self-managing and highly organised, with the confidence to escalate risks early rather than hope they

resolve themselves.

• Available 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time, Monday to Friday.

Desirable

• Experience delivering practice management, EMR/EHR, clinical or other healthcare software.

• Understanding of Australian health data privacy obligations and the care that patient data demands.

• Experience with software that is deployed into live customer sites, including staged rollout and hotfix

processes.

• Familiarity with PHP/Laravel back-ends and modern JavaScript front-ends — enough to follow a technical

conversation.

• Bitbucket or Git branching, pull request and release workflows.

• Awareness of CI/CD and deployment tooling (Laravel Forge or similar).

• Experience managing device, imaging or third-party API integrations and the vendors behind them.

• PMP, PRINCE2 or Certified Scrum Master certification.





Remote work and hours

This role is fully remote — you can be based anywhere — but you must be online and available during Sydney

business hours, 9:00am to 6:00pm (AEST/AEDT), Monday to Friday. Sydney observes daylight saving, so the

UTC offset shifts between +10 and +11 through the year. Please only apply if that overlap works for you long

term.





What we offer

• Fully remote work, with the autonomy that comes with it.

• Real ownership of named products, not a slice of someone else's roadmap.

Direct access to decision makers — short approval chains, fast answers.

• A small, capable team where your delivery process choices actually stick.





How to apply

Send your CV and a short cover letter. In your note,

please tell us: the largest development team you have personally run, how you kept its QA cycle honest, and the

last time you had to pick up an unfamiliar project at short notice.



We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

title: Growth Lead (SEO + Content + Paid Acquisition)
description:
Australian Consumer Health Platform



We are launching a content-led platform in the Australian consumer health and wellness space. The platform

educates a broad consumer audience and connects them with a network of trusted independent practitioners.

The category is large, the corporate competitors are well-funded, and our edge is content depth, clinical

credibility, local relevance, and a unified voice across the independent side of the industry.

We are looking for a growth operator who can help take this platform from early-stage to a dominant digital

presence over the next 12–24 months, with strong emphasis on organic search, AI search visibility, and

performance-driven acquisition strategy.



The Ambition

We want to build one of the strongest organic and search-driven consumer health platforms in Australia.



Our goals include:

• Ranking on page one of Google for 100–300 Australian search terms within 3–6 months

• Building long-term topical authority across multiple health categories

• Becoming visible and cited within AI search experiences (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity,

Claude, etc.)

• Establishing suburb-level local search visibility across multiple Australian markets

• Using paid acquisition strategically to accelerate learning, validate search intent, and support growth while

organic authority compounds



We know these targets are ambitious. They reflect our level of commitment and the scale of what we are

building.



We are looking for someone who finds that exciting rather than intimidating.



What You Will Own

Organic Search & SEO

• Keyword strategy across the full funnel (informational, commercial, navigational, transactional)

• Technical SEO for a content-heavy platform

• On-page optimisation and content structure

• Internal linking and topical clustering

• Schema implementation and structured data

• Crawl health, indexing, and Core Web Vitals

• Local SEO across multiple Australian suburbs and regions

• Entity optimisation and AI-search readiness

• llms.txt and AI-search visibility initiatives

• Search Console, Ahrefs/SEMrush, and ongoing SEO reporting



Content Growth

• Content planning and editorial strategy

• AI-assisted content workflow optimisation

• Content briefing, editing, quality control, and uplift

• Building citation-worthy, authoritative content structures

• Identifying scalable content opportunities and search gaps

• Improving EEAT signals and topical authority



Growth & Performance

• Work alongside the paid acquisition team across Google Ads and Meta

Use PPC insights to validate keyword intent and conversion opportunities

• Support landing page optimisation and CRO thinking

• Identify growth opportunities through analytics and user behaviour

• Contribute to acquisition strategy beyond pure SEO

• Help connect paid and organic insights into a unified growth approach



Analytics & Reporting

• Weekly reporting on rankings, visibility, traffic, and growth opportunities

• Clear progress tracking against agreed search and growth targets

• Identification of wins, bottlenecks, and next actions

• Data-driven iteration and experimentation



Who You Are

• 4+ years in hands-on SEO and growth-focused digital marketing

• Strong portfolio of page-one rankings in competitive English-language markets

• Demonstrable before/after SEO case studies with screenshots from Ahrefs, SEMrush, GSC, or equivalent

• Comfortable operating in the Australian market specifically (.
 domains, AU spelling, AU search

behaviour)

• Strong understanding of how AI search engines surface and cite content

• Commercially minded and growth-oriented, not just technically strong

• Comfortable working across SEO, content, analytics, and paid acquisition collaboration

• Strong operator mindset — you ship, test, measure, and iterate

• Excellent written English at near-native level

• Able to overlap with Australian business hours (AEST) for at least 4 hours per day



Bonus If You Have Experience In

• Health, wellness, medical, or practitioner-led categories

• Local SEO at scale

• High-volume content operations

• Programmatic SEO

• CRO and landing page optimisation

• Performance marketing strategy

• AI-assisted publishing workflows

• GEO/AEO (Generative Engine Optimisation / Answer Engine Optimisation)



Engagement

• Full-time contractor

• 40 hours per week

• Initial 30-day paid trial period, then ongoing

• Works alongside an existing in-house team

• Reports to the Marketing Manager / Marketing Leadership Team



To Apply

In your cover letter, please answer the following:

1. Walk us through one SEO or growth project you led where you took a site from low or no visibility to

meaningful search traction and business growth.

Please include:

• the niche,

• the timeframe,

• the tactics,

• the results,

• and screenshots from Ahrefs, SEMrush, GSC, or equivalent.

2. What is your current view on optimising for AI search engines (GEO/AEO)?

What is:

• genuinely working,

• overhyped,

• misunderstood,

• and what would you actually prioritise in the first 90 days?

3. What is the single biggest mistake businesses make when trying to scale content output using AI tools?

4. How do you think paid acquisition and SEO should work together in an early-stage growth environment?

Applications without specific answers to these questions will not be reviewed.

title: Virtual Bookkeeper & CRM Support
description:
About Us



Safe Haven Operators runs a growing portfolio of Residential Care Facilities for the Elderly (RCFEs) in California, currently 8 locations. We are a fast moving, hands on operation looking for a remote Accounting VA who can bring precision to our numbers and speed to our processes through smart use of AI and automation.



Position Summary



We're looking for a Virtual Assistant specializing in Accounting who is comfortable using AI tools day to day to work faster and smarter, someone who doesn't need everything spelled out in a rigid process and can use AI to help figure things out, draft reports, or speed up repetitive tasks. This role owns day to day financial operations across multiple RCFE locations and supports our affiliated placement agency. You'll work closely with the owner and leadership team, communicating daily over Slack/email and video calls during overlapping hours.



Key Responsibilities



Core Accounting



Manage full cycle bookkeeping (AP, AR, payroll support, reconciliations) across multiple facility locations

Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements per location and consolidated

Calculate and process partner distributions according to ownership agreements

Track resident billing, private pay and applicable subsidy revenue, and rent/refund proration

Maintain clean books for tax preparation and work directly with outside CPAs

Support budgeting, cash flow forecasting, and cost analysis per home



General AI Comfort



Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in day to day work, for drafting, research, summarizing, or problem solving

Willing to use AI to speed up repetitive tasks like report formatting, data organization, and written communication

Quick to learn new tools and workflows without needing everything spelled out step by step



CRM Support



Comfortable working inside a CRM system for tracking leads, resident inquiries, and follow ups

Keep CRM records accurate and up to date as part of daily workflow

Help set up, organize, or improve CRM structure (pipelines, fields, tags) as needs come up

Qualifications

3+ years of accounting experience, healthcare, senior living, or multi-location small business a strong plus

QuickBooks experience is required

Comfortable and confident using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in general day to day work, does not need to be accounting specific

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, including formulas and basic automation

Familiarity with CRM systems (HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, or similar)

Comfortable working across multiple entities/locations with different ownership structures

High attention to detail and comfortable with confidential financial data

Self starter who can work independently and manage priorities with minimal supervision

Prior experience working as a VA for a US based company, ideally supporting US GAAP style bookkeeping

Reliable internet connection and backup power/internet setup

Available to overlap several hours with US Pacific Time for calls and real time coordination

Strong written and spoken English

Nice to Have

Experience in senior living, healthcare, or licensed care facility accounting

Familiarity with RCFE or similar regulatory/compliance driven environments

Experience using AI tools to build simple templates, checklists, or written communications

Position Type



Full time, 40 hours per week. This is a salaried position, not hourly or project based.



What We Offer

Long term, stable full time remote position with a growing US based company

Direct access to ownership and real influence over how the finance function is built

Opportunity to shape and modernize accounting operations as the company continues to grow beyond 8 locations

About Us

Before You Apply:

You have cruise guest services experience or strong travel booking experience 



You have supported luxury or high-touch clients 



You enjoy detailed administrative work 



You want a stable, long-term remote position 



You can confidently communicate with senior clients

DO NOT Apply If: 



Your experience is limited to general hospitality roles such as bartending, serving, retail, or unrelated customer service positions

You are looking for freelance, temporary, or part-time work

You submit generic applications without reviewing the requirements (we can always tell which is AI--all cover letters have the same phrases! Just be yourself).

 



Role Snapshot 



As our Virtual Assistant, you'll be responsible for: 



Speaking with clients on the phone 



Drafting client
s (hold reminders, confirmation, follow-ups, courtesy responses, answer inquiries) 



Updating HubSpot CRM and internal trackers — keeping booking statuses, contact details, and notes current 



Calling Viking Cruises and clients to verify information, request itineraries, or resolve booking questions 



Supporting the CEO and team with high-level administrative tasks 



Managing booking coordination from inquiry through post-travel follow-up 



Expectation:  



You'll work directly with our staff as internal support — not as an independent agent. 



Guest/client
s are drafts for review.

Who We're Looking For

Experience in cruise guest services, travel bookings, or itinerary  



Excellent spoken and written English with a warm, polished, professional tone 



Comfortable speaking with clients on the phone

title: Payroll Coordinator (Australian Payroll)
description:
Astute Early Years Specialists is an Australian early childhood education consultancy based in Brisbane, supporting childcare providers across Australia. We're hiring a full-time, remote Payroll Coordinator to run our payroll end-to-end using Employment Hero — someone who knows Australian payroll inside out and wants to own it, not just process it.

This is a direct-hire role (not through an agency) — you'll work closely with our Finance, Operations & People & Culture team.



We are based in Australia (AEST), so your timezone lines up well with ours — that is a genuine plus for us.



What You'll do:



● Process payroll in Employment Hero for multiple centres and their  staff each pay cycle — new starters, terminations, leave, timesheets, allowances, overtime, salary changes



● Lodge Single Touch Payroll (STP2) each pay run 



● Calculate and process superannuation guarantee contributions (SuperStream)



● Handle PAYG withholding and end-of-financial-year finalisation



● Apply correct award interpretation (Children's Services Award 2010 and others) under the Fair Work Act



● Keep on top of Fair Work Commission wage reviews and award updates



● Maintain accurate employee records and keep Employment Hero configured properly (pay rules, leave rules, reporting)



● Prepare payroll reports — labour cost, leave liability, payroll tax reconciliations



● Be the first point of contact for staff payroll questions



Skills, Qualifications & Experience:



● 4+ years running end-to-end payroll for an Australian business

● Hands-on Employment Hero experience — this is essential, not a “nice to have”

● Strong knowledge of Australian payroll compliance: PAYG, STP2, super guarantee, NES, modern awards

● Confidence interpreting and applying Modern Awards

● High attention to detail and comfortable owning deadlines

● Excellent written and spoken English

● Ability to work a shift with real-time overlap into Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT)

● Reliable high-speed internet and a proper home-office setup



Nice to Have:

● Payroll experience in the Australian childcare/ECEC sector, including the Children's Services Award

● Experience working remotely for an Australian employer

● Certificate IV in Payroll Administration or similar



HOW TO APPLY:



To show you've read the entire job advertisement, start your application with the word "ALL SET"



Please also include:



A brief summary of your payroll experience (Australian experience is a PLUS)

A Google Drive link containing your updated resume / cover letter

Your expected monthly salary in PHP

Your notice period and earliest available start date



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: YouTube Content Writer
description:
the Creator Lane is looking for experienced YouTube and content scriptwriters to write and review scripts for client channels in business, marketing, technology, and documentary. Scripts typically run 3,500 to 4,000 words. The core skill is turning a complex topic into something a general audience understands immediately, without losing accuracy or the thread of the story.



You'll take assigned topics and research-backed outlines, build them into full drafts, and refine each one to match a specific channel's voice and audience.



Our scripts are AI-assisted, not AI-generated. You should be able to fold AI into your process to fact-check, catch grammar issues, and move quickly, while holding a high bar for creative storytelling and accuracy. The writing has to carry a story; the AI supports it, never replaces it.



What you'll do

- Turn assigned topics and research outlines into full 3,500 to 4,000 word drafts

- Break down dense business, tech, and marketing material so a general viewer follows it easily

- Edit and adapt drafts to fit each channel's voice, pacing, and audience

- Use AI in your workflow to fact-check and tighten grammar without copy-pasting output blindly

- Review and revise scripts against a high standard for retention, clarity, and storytelling

- Keep a clean filing system for drafts and deliverables

- Improve the process as you go, not just execute it



What you bring

- The ability to break down complex business, marketing, and technical topics so a general audience understands them immediately

- The ability to say the most with the least, keeping stories moving without filler

- Strong command of English grammar and mechanics

- A real understanding of retention and pacing

Department: Marketing

Direct reports: Marketing Agents (social media comments & inquiries)



ROLE SUMMARY

The Social Marketing Virtual Assistant Supervisor owns the day to day performance of the Marketing Agent team responsible for social media comments and private inquiries. This role keeps the review process efficient, the SOPs current, and the Hootsuite environment properly configured, while acting as the first point of escalation for agents and the connective tissue between Marketing and other departments. The supervisor is both a process owner and a hands on operator, stepping into the queue whenever coverage is needed.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Process & SOP Ownership

- Optimize review process efficiency and identify bottlenecks in agent workflows.

- Recommend, document, and roll out SOP improvements as processes evolve.

- Develop response and coverage strategies, then cascade them across the full team, including Sydney, to keep processes consistent across locations.



Team Leadership & Coaching

- Run weekly meetings with Marketing Agents when there are updates to communicate or coaching is needed to improve response quality.

- Assist agents with process questions and guideline clarification via Teams, with a standard response time of 20 to 30 minutes.

- Provide feedback on response tone, accuracy, and adherence to brand voice.



Platform Administration & Monitoring

- Manage Hootsuite settings to maintain automation and keep configurations aligned across all agents.

- Monitor Hootsuite activity to confirm agents are performing to expectation and flag gaps early.

- Monitor the waiting message queue on Hootsuite and respond as needed throughout the day, through end of day.



Coverage

- Step in to cover extra hours when a Marketing Agent is unavailable, handling social media comments and private inquiries directly.

- When your core workload is light, pick up standing backlog work assigned by your supervisor. Downtime is expected to be filled with company work, and you note what you worked on in your end of shift report.



Reporting & Cross-Functional Alignment

- Prepare weekly reports on team activities, volume, response times, and progress against goals.

- Send a short end of shift report every working day: messages resolved, the time the queue was cleared, and what you worked on after that.

- Ensure cross departmental alignment so escalations, product questions, and campaign changes flow smoothly between Marketing and other teams.



QUALIFICATIONS

- 2+ years in social media management, community management, or customer support operations, with at least 1 year supervising or coordinating a team.

- Experience administering Hootsuite (or a comparable platform such as Sprout Social or Agorapulse), including inbox routing, automation rules, and permissions. If you have only used it as an agent, say so in your application. We still want to hear from you.

- Demonstrated experience writing or improving SOPs and documentation.

- Comfortable working across time zones and coordinating with distributed teammates.

- Strong written English and sound judgment on brand voice and escalation calls.

- Proficient with Microsoft Teams and standard reporting tools.



ATTRIBUTES FOR SUCCESS

- Responsive without being reactive. Holds a 20 to 30 minute support SLA while protecting focus time for process work.

- Willing to work the queue personally. No task is beneath the role.

- Spots patterns in recurring inquiries and turns them into documented guidance.

- Communicates clearly enough that a strategy set at HQ lands the same way in Sydney.



SUCCESS METRICS (FIRST 90 DAYS)

- Response time and resolution time on social inquiries at or below target.

- SOP library reviewed, with at least two documented process improvements implemented.

- Weekly reporting cadence established and consistently delivered.

- End of shift report sent every working day.

- No waiting item in the Hootsuite queue left unhandled past end of day.



HOW TO APPLY

Platform administration

title: Apparel Graphic Designer (Hand Illustration) for US Coastal Lifestyle Brand. Paid Test Project, Then Ongoing Work.
description:
I run ATEOTD, a coastal lifestyle apparel brand in the US. Think of brands like Vuori, Faherty, and Quicksilver: quiet, premium, restrained. Small placements, limited ink colors, nothing loud.



The brand has a second layer. Our phrases come from scripture, but they are chosen so that a stranger with no faith background would read them as simply well written. We never print verse citations on garments. If a design feels "churchy," it has failed. If it feels like a great vintage surf graphic that happens to carry weight, it has succeeded.



I am hiring one illustrator, starting with a single paid test design. If the work is strong, this becomes ongoing per-design work. I only run one design at a time, and I am honest with you up front: I am picky. What I offer in return is clear briefs, fast decisions, and steady work if we fit.



The Work



Hand-illustrated graphic tees. Surf, and minimal coastal styles. Designs print DTG on garment-dyed tees, so:



Maximum 2 to 3 ink colors per design

No fine details below roughly 1.5mm (they will not print reliably)

Designs must work on muted garment colors (dusty blue, khaki, seafoam)



Hard Requirements



No AI-generated artwork. None. Not as a base, not "cleaned up," not for reference compositing. Original illustration only. I will ask to see process work (sketches, WIP screenshots) and I check.



Editable source files. Layered Adobe Illustrator files (vector, with both outlined and live-text versions where type is used), plus print-ready PNG at 300 DPI on transparent background.



You must be comfortable working from written briefs in English.



Sample Brief (this is the actual test design)



Phrase: "Let the sea roar"



Direction: A contained emblem in the retro surf style: an ocean scene built from flat, layered organic shapes inside an arch frame. A breaking wave as the focal point, a low sun, and a simple horizon. Four flat ink colors maximum, drawn from a muted coastal palette (dusty blue, sage, ochre, cream). No gradients, no outlines doing heavy lifting, no fine detail. The phrase is part of the lockup, either arced along the inside of the frame or set beneath the scene like a badge, never floating as a caption. A slight handmade quality at the edges is welcome; sterile vector perfection is not. Back print, roughly 10 to 12 inches tall



Three links to hand-illustrated apparel or print work you made (not a full portfolio dump, your three best)

Two or three sentences on your illustration process, including what tools you draw in

Confirmation that you understand and agree to the no-AI rule

How many days you would need for the test design



Applications that skip these steps will not get a reply.

We're looking for a sharp, persistent, and coachable Outbound Sales Representative to cold call real estate agents, generate interest in our media services, and book appointments/shoots directly into our pipeline. This is not a script-reading job — you'll be trained on our services, our ideal client, and our objection handling, and you'll be measured on real booked revenue, not just call volume.



What You'll Do:

-Make outbound cold calls daily to real estate agents in our two active markets — Richmond, VA and Northern Virginia (NOVA) to introduce Priceless Productions RE's services

-Qualify leads and identify agents actively listing or about to list properties

-Book photography/video/media appointments directly into our scheduling system (
 / HD PhotoHub)

-Follow up consistently with warm leads who don't convert on the first call

-Log every call outcome accurately in our CRM, including which market the booking belongs to (no exceptions — data quality is part of the job)

-Hit weekly/monthly call volume and booking targets

-Report daily/weekly activity and results to management



What Success Looks Like (KPIs):

-Calls per day: 80–100

-Appointments/bookings per week: 3–5 to start, with targets increasing as you ramp up and build rapport with our agent network

-Show-up/completion rate on booked jobs

CRM logging accuracy: 100% of calls logged same-day, tagged by market (Richmond or NOVA)



Who We're Looking For:

We want outgoing, ambitious, competitive people who genuinely enjoy sales, not someone looking for a quiet data-entry job. If you like the challenge of turning a "no" into a "yes" and want your paycheck to reflect your effort, this is for you.



Requirements:

Proven cold calling or outbound sales experience (real estate industry experience a strong plus)

Excellent spoken English with a neutral, professional phone presence

Comfortable handling rejection and staying persistent without getting discouraged

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet work environment, and a working headset

Experience with CRM tools (
 experience a plus, but trainable)

Self-motivated — able to work independently and hit targets without micromanagement

Available for full-time hours, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday



Compensation Details:

Base pay: $4.00/hour, paid weekly

Commission: 1% of the total value of every booked sale that results from your outbound calls, paid once the job is completed/invoiced

Example: Our average job is $400–$500, so every booking earns you an extra $4–$5 on top of your hourly rate — with no cap on how many you can book. Book 5 jobs in a week and that's an extra $20–25 added straight to your paycheck.

Performance review at 30/60/90 days with opportunity for base pay increase based on results

How to Apply



Please apply with:

A short voice recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself in English

Your cold calling / sales experience, specifically any real estate or service-based industry experience

Your available start date



Applications without a voice sample will not be considered.

title: Senior QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper & Systems Specialist – Part-Time
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper who can do more than record transactions and reconcile accounts.



We need someone who has personally established or improved bookkeeping systems, created clear accounting procedures, and taught business owners or internal teams how to follow them.



This is not an entry-level role. We do not want to teach the selected candidate how to organize our bookkeeping. We need someone who can review our current setup, identify inefficiencies, recommend improvements, and guide us in using QuickBooks correctly.



The role will begin with one U.S.-based company whose books are currently updated and have a relatively light workload. Based on performance, the selected candidate may gradually manage the QuickBooks accounts of up to five related companies within the agreed working hours.



Initial Schedule



Part-time: 20 hours per week

Four hours per day, Monday through Friday

The four-hour shift must fall between 10:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time

The exact shift will be agreed upon before hiring

Potential to transition into a full-time role if business needs and performance support it



Core Responsibilities



Review the existing QuickBooks Online setup and condition of the books

Identify accounting errors, workflow gaps, duplicate work, and inefficiencies

Recommend and implement a more organized bookkeeping system

Record and properly categorize financial transactions

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, loans, payment processors, and other balance-sheet accounts

Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable

Create and monitor invoices, bills, purchase orders, and payments

Review the chart of accounts and recommend necessary corrections

Prepare routine and adjusting journal entries with proper supporting documentation

Complete month-end closing procedures

Prepare accurate Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, AP, and AR reports

Investigate discrepancies instead of making unsupported adjustments

Review financial reports for unusual balances, trends, or potential errors

Maintain organized supporting documents and accounting records

Establish weekly and monthly bookkeeping workflows

Create clear bookkeeping checklists and SOPs

Teach management and team members what documents and information must be submitted, when they are due, and how they should be organized

Communicate issues, risks, and recommendations clearly and proactively

Gradually manage multiple company files while maintaining separate and accurate records for each entity



Required Qualifications



At least five years of professional bookkeeping or accounting experience

At least four years of substantial, hands-on QuickBooks Online experience

Advanced knowledge of QuickBooks Online—not merely data entry

Experience managing the complete bookkeeping cycle independently

Proven experience setting up, cleaning up, or significantly improving a QuickBooks system

Experience creating charts of accounts, workflows, checklists, or bookkeeping SOPs

Experience handling multiple companies or client accounts

Strong knowledge of bank and credit-card reconciliation, AP/AR, month-end close, journal entries, and financial statements

Ability to explain accounting processes clearly to non-accountants

Strong written and verbal communication

Organized and concise thinking

Strong attention to detail and ability to follow written instructions exactly

Comfortable identifying problems and recommending solutions without waiting to be told what to do

Experience supporting U.S.-based businesses

Reliable availability during the required U.S. Eastern Time window



Preferred Qualifications



QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification

Accounting degree or recognized professional accounting qualification

Experience with food, restaurant, retail, wholesale, manufacturing, or inventory-based companies

Experience handling intercompany transactions or several related entities

Experience preparing books and supporting schedules for an external CPA or tax preparer



This Role Is Not Suitable for Someone Who:



Only performs transaction entry and basic bank reconciliation

Requires the client to design the bookkeeping process

Has never personally established or improved an accounting workflow

Cannot clearly explain the reasoning behind an accounting treatment

Makes adjustments simply to force accounts to balance

Cannot work independently

Frequently misses written instructions or required application details

Is unable to communicate technical information in a clear and organized manner



Compensation



Please propose a fixed monthly rate for 20 hours per week.



The workload is expected to be relatively light initially because the first company’s books are already updated. Additional companies may be assigned gradually, provided the work can be completed accurately within the agreed 20 hours per week.



How to Apply



Use the exact subject line:



SYSTEMS – [Your Full Name]



Your application must contain all seven items below, numbered from 1 to 7:



Résumé



Provide a working, publicly accessible link to your updated résumé. Applications without a résumé will not be considered.



QuickBooks Online Experience



State your total years of bookkeeping/accounting experience and your total years of hands-on QuickBooks Online experience.



System-Building Example



Describe one specific bookkeeping or QuickBooks system that you personally built or significantly improved. Explain:



The problems you found

The system, workflow, or controls you introduced

The SOPs or checklists you created

How you trained the client or team

The result of your changes



Please describe your personal contribution—not only what your previous company or manager implemented.



Multi-Company Experience



State how many separate companies or QuickBooks files you have managed simultaneously and what responsibilities you personally handled.



Proposed Rate



Provide your fixed monthly rate for 20 hours per week. Do not provide only an hourly rate.



Availability



Provide the exact four-hour shift you can consistently work Monday through Friday within 10:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time. Also disclose any current clients or employment commitments that could affect this schedule.



Certifications



Attach or provide working links to any QuickBooks, accounting, or bookkeeping certifications you claim.



Important: Applications that omit the required subject line, résumé, fixed monthly rate, exact schedule, or system-building example will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates must complete a practical bookkeeping assessment and participate in an interview. References and certifications may be verified before hiring.

title: DevOps / Testing / QA-QC Engineer
description:
Location: Remote — must work Sydney business hours (9:00am–6:00pm AEST/AEDT)

Employment type: Full-time

Reports to: IT / Engineering Manager



About the role

We are looking for a hands-on DevOps and QA engineer to take ownership of environments, releases and

product quality across four production platforms. This is a combined role: you will keep our AWS infrastructure

and deployment pipelines healthy, and you will also plan and run the testing that gets each release out the door.

Our products serve the healthcare industry, supporting both business (B2B) and consumer-facing (B2C) use

cases. Our platforms include a practice management system used daily by clinics, a patient booking system, and

further products supporting our wider product ecosystem. Downtime and defects are felt immediately by real

clients and their end users, so quality matters here.

You will work alongside a development team of 8+ engineers. Priorities shift as releases land, so we need

someone who can move between products quickly without losing context or dropping quality.



What you'll do

DevOps

• Own and maintain AWS infrastructure: EC2, RDS, S3, Route 53, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, load balancers

and certificates

• Build, maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines for build, test and deployment

• Manage development, staging, UAT and production environments, including test data refreshes and

environment parity

• Monitor system health, set up alerting, and respond to i
; produce root cause summaries afterwards

• Manage backups, restore testing, and disaster recovery procedures

• Handle SSL/TLS certificates, DNS changes, and domain configuration

• Support release management: release notes, deployment windows, rollback plans



Testing / QA / QC

• Write and maintain test plans, test cases and regression suites for all four products

• Perform functional, integration, regression, cross-browser and UAT testing on each release

• Build and maintain automated test coverage (UI and API) where it delivers value

• Run API testing and validate integrations between systems

• Perform smoke and sanity checks on production immediately after deployment

• Log, triage, prioritise and verify defects in Jira; drive them through to closure with developers

• Maintain QA documentation, runbooks and knowledge base articles in Confluence

• Contribute to sprint planning and refinement with a quality and risk perspective

• Enforce release quality gates — sign-off is yours



Required experience

• 5+ years in a DevOps, testing, QA or combined engineering role

• Strong, current hands-on AWS experience — EC2, RDS, S3, Route 53 and related services

• Solid working knowledge of Jira and Confluence — not just as a user, but configuring workflows, boards,

test documentation and reporting

• Experience delivering on a large project with a team of 8 or more developers, including release

coordination across multiple workstreams

• Proven ability to switch between projects quickly — adaptable, dynamic, comfortable with changing

priorities and multiple concurrent products

Practical experience across the full testing lifecycle: test planning, execution, defect management and

release sign-off

• Linux server administration and shell scripting

• Version control workflows (Git — branching, pull requests, code review process)

• Clear written and spoken English; able to communicate with developers, management and non-technical

staff

• Able to work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time, consistently and reliably

Nice to have

• Test automation frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) and API testing tools (Postman/Newman)

• PHP / Laravel, and experience deploying via Laravel Forge

• SQL — MySQL, PostgreSQL and/or SQL Server; able to write queries to validate data

• Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and containerisation (Docker)

• Performance and load testing experience

• Security testing awareness — OWASP Top 10, vulnerability scanning

• Exposure to healthcare or medical software, and the data handling expectations that come with it

• Familiarity with Australian Privacy Act obligations, data residency requirements or ISO 27001

• ISTQB or AWS certification



What we're looking for in a person

• Ownership. You see a problem through to resolution rather than passing it along.

• Pragmatism. You know when a test suite needs automating and when a checklist is enough.

• Attention to detail. You catch the edge case before the client does.

• Flexibility. You can leave one product mid-week, pick up another, and be productive the same day.

• Communication. You keep Jira and Confluence current so nobody has to ask you for status.



Working arrangements

Remote work is fine. What is not flexible is the hours — you need to be online and contactable during Sydney

business hours, 9:00am to 6:00pm, Monday to Friday, so that you overlap fully with the development team and

with the clients using our software. Occasional after-hours deployment windows may be required, with time in

lieu.



How to apply

Send your CV along with a short note covering:

• The largest team and project you have worked on, and what you owned on it

• Your AWS experience — which services, and what you built or maintained

• An example of a defect or i
 you caught before it reached customers

title: Project Manager - Digital Products
description:
Employment type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Fully remote (any location)

Working hours: 9:00am – 6:00pm Sydney time (AEST/AEDT), Mon–Fri

Team size: 8+ developers plus QA across three products



About us

We are a healthcare organisation. Alongside our clinical and operational business, we build and run our own

software — the platforms our practices, partners and customers use every day, spanning both B2B and B2C use

cases. Our development, QA and product teams work remotely across multiple time zones, anchored to Sydney

business hours.

We are a small, hands-on technology group. Decisions get made quickly, the approval chain is short, and the

person managing a project is genuinely the person who owns it.



About the role

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to take end-to-end ownership of three of our customer-

facing digital products.

This is a multi-project role, and that is the whole point of it. The three products have different users, different

release rhythms and different stakeholders, and you will be moving between all of them in any given week. If

you like the certainty of one long-running project, this is not the role. If you are energised by holding several

threads at once and keeping every one of them moving, read on.

The products

Product 1 — Booking Widget

An embeddable online appointment booking component that lets our business locations take bookings directly

from their own websites. High visibility, high traffic, and unforgiving of regressions.

Product 2 — Content Hub

A digital hub for content and imaging assets, serving both internal teams and external partners.

Product 3 — Product Catalogue

The central catalogue of products that feeds our customer-facing systems and partner integrations. Data quality

and integration reliability are the core challenges here.



What you will do

• Own end-to-end delivery for all three products — scope, plan, schedule, dependencies, risk, budget and

release.

• Run the day-to-day delivery cadence in Jira: backlog grooming, sprint planning, stand-ups, velocity and

burndown reporting, and honest status reporting to stakeholders.

• Keep Confluence current and authoritative — requirements, functional specs, architecture decisions,

runbooks and release notes.

• Coordinate a delivery team of 8+ developers alongside QA, working with tech leads on sequencing,

capacity and cross-product dependencies.

• Own the QA/QC gate. Agree the test plan, coordinate UAT, triage and prioritise defects, and make the

go/no-go call on every release.

• Plan releases against AWS-hosted environments (EC2, RDS) with the engineering team — environment

readiness, release windows, data migrations and rollback plans.

• Manage stakeholders across operations, marketing and external partners; translate their needs into a backlog

the developers can actually work from.

Actively manage the trade-offs between the three products when they compete for the same people, and

make the resourcing call rather than escalating it by default.

• Surface risks and blockers early, in writing, with a proposed path forward.

• Continuously improve how we deliver — process, tooling, documentation and handover quality.



What you must bring

• 5+ years' experience as a Project Manager or Delivery Manager on commercial software products (not

internal IT projects alone).

• Proven track record managing large delivery efforts with development teams of 8 or more engineers, plus

dedicated QA.

• Expert-level Jira — epics and stories, boards, sprints, workflows, JQL, dashboards and delivery reporting.

You should be comfortable configuring, not just using.

• Expert-level Confluence — you treat it as the single source of truth and you keep it that way: specs,

decision logs, runbooks, release notes, meeting outcomes.

• Working knowledge of AWS, specifically EC2 and RDS. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must

be able to plan releases, environments, migrations, backups and rollbacks with engineers and understand

what you are agreeing to.

• Hands-on oversight of QA/QC — test planning, UAT coordination, defect triage and prioritisation, and

release sign-off.

• Comfortable running Agile (Scrum or Kanban) with the pragmatism to bend it when the work calls for it.

• Genuinely adaptable and fast-moving. You will switch between products inside the same week and be

expected to pick each one back up without losing the thread.

• Excellent written English and a written-first communication habit — this is non-negotiable in a distributed

team.

• Self-managing and highly organised, with the confidence to escalate risks early rather than hope they

resolve themselves.

• Available 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time, Monday to Friday.



Desirable

• Experience with booking or scheduling systems, e-commerce, or product catalogue / PIM platforms.

• Health or medical industry experience.

• Familiarity with PHP/Laravel back-ends and modern JavaScript front-ends — enough to follow a technical

conversation.

• Bitbucket or Git branching, pull request and release workflows.

• Awareness of CI/CD and deployment tooling (Laravel Forge or similar).

• Experience managing third-party integrations and external vendors.

• PMP, PRINCE2 or Certified Scrum Master certification.



Remote work and hours

This role is fully remote — you can be based anywhere — but you must be online and available during Sydney

business hours, 9:00am to 6:00pm (AEST/AEDT), Monday to Friday. Sydney observes daylight saving, so the

UTC offset shifts between +10 and +11 through the year. Please only apply if that overlap works for you long

term.



What we offer

• Fully remote work, with the autonomy that comes with it.

• Real ownership of named products, not a slice of someone else's roadmap.

• Direct access to decision makers — short approval chains, fast answers.

• A small, capable team where your delivery process choices actually stick.



How to apply

Send your CV and a short cover note to [insert application
 or Seek/LinkedIn apply link]. In your note,

please tell us: the largest development team you have personally run, how you kept its QA cycle honest, and the

last time you had to pick up an unfamiliar project at short notice.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

WHO WILL DO WELL IN THIS ROLE?

title: Wholesale Sales Assistant
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME ANDA VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING*****



Wholesale Sales Assistant



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break

Salary: $1,200 per month



Job Overview: 

We are seeking a detail-oriented Wholesale Sales Assistant to support our growing U.S. wholesale business. This role will serve as the primary coordinator for wholesale order documentation and ERP transactions while providing management with timely, accurate reports to support informed decision-making. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sales order documentation, pricing verification, ERP order entry, purchase order creation, and sales reporting, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure efficient order processing and exceptional customer support.



Key Responsibilities:



Order Processing & Documentation

* Create and maintain all required wholesale sales documentation.

* Verify customer purchase orders for completeness and accuracy.

* Create Sales Orders (SO) in the ERP system.

* Create Purchase Orders (PO) in the ERP system as required.

* Ensure all documentation complies with internal procedures before orders are released to Operations.



Pricing & Data Verification

* Verify customer pricing against approved pricing lists and contracts.

* Confirm that promotions, discounts, freight terms, and payment terms are accurately reflected.

* Identify pricing discrepancies and coordinate with Sales Management to resolve issues before order processing.



Sales Reporting & Analytics

* Prepare recurring sales reports for management.

* Track wholesale sales performance by customer, channel, product category, and salesperson.

* Maintain dashboards to monitor order status, shipments, backorders, inventory allocation, and sales trends.

* Support management with ad hoc reporting and data analysis.



ERP & Process Support

* Maintain accurate customer and order information within the ERP system.

* Ensure data integrity across Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, inventory allocation, and shipping records.

* Assist in developing standardized operating procedures and documentation.

* Support continuous improvement initiatives to streamline wholesale operations.



Customer Communication & Support

* Respond to wholesale customer inquiries and requests received through designated wholesale
 accounts.

* Provide timely updates regarding order status, product availability, shipping timelines, and documentation requests.

* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer inquiries and ensure accurate information is communicated.

* Escalate complex issues to Sales Management or the appropriate departments as needed.



Cross-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with Sales, Operations, Warehouse, Purchasing, Customer Service, and Finance to ensure orders are processed accurately and shipped on time.

* Communicate order status updates and resolve documentation-related issues promptly.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* 1–3 years of experience in sales support, order management, customer service, operations, or a related role.

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and basic reporting.

* Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Experience using ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Acumatica, or similar platforms is preferred.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Amazon International Marketplace Specialist
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME ANDA VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING*****



Amazon International Marketplace Specialist



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM PST, with a 1-hour break

Salary: $1000 per month



Job Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Amazon International Marketplace Specialist to oversee and grow our presence across Amazon’s global marketplaces. This role requires hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts, driving sales growth, and optimizing operations across multiple regions. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and has a proven track record of successfully navigating international e-commerce environments.



Key Responsibilities:

* Manage day-to-day operations of Amazon accounts across international marketplaces (e.g., US, UK, Germany, Japan, Canada, etc.).

* Develop and execute strategies to increase sales, improve conversion rates, and enhance product visibility internationally.

* Optimize product listings for SEO, content, and localized messaging in different markets.

* Monitor inventory levels, forecast demand, and coordinate with supply chain and fulfillment partners.

* Analyze sales performance, customer reviews, and competitor activity to inform strategy.

* Implement Amazon advertising campaigns (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, etc.) to maximize ROI.

* Ensure compliance with Amazon policies, international trade regulations, and local laws.

* Collaborate with marketing, logistics, and product teams to execute promotions and launches.



Qualifications:

SCHEDULE

COMPENSATION



• $1,000 USD per month for the first 90 days

HOW TO APPLY

About the Role



The Creator Lane is looking for an experienced Lead Video Editor & Project Manager to oversee our remote editing team and ensure every client project is delivered on time, on brand, and at a consistently high creative standard.

This role sits at the intersection of creative leadership and operational execution. You will manage a team of editors working across multiple client channels, review their work, provide feedback, maintain production standards, and build systems that allow the editing department to scale.



You will be the quality control layer between our editors and our clients: making sure timelines are met, creative direction is followed, files are organized, and every video leaving the team represents the quality The Creator Lane is known for.

If you are an exceptional editor who also enjoys leading people, building workflows, and turning a creative team into a well-run production machine, this role is for you.



What You'll Own:

- Manage and support a remote team of video editors working across multiple client projects

- Working directly with the founder in launching his personal branded channels and establishing his content’s editing style as his lead editor. 

- Fill in gaps on editing projects to hit deadlines as needed

- Assign projects, track progress, and ensure all deliverables are completed on schedule

- Review edits for storytelling, pacing, retention, technical quality, and alignment with each client's established brand style

- Provide clear, actionable revision notes and creative feedback to editors

- Maintain consistent editing standards across all channels and client accounts

- Own project organization: file structures, assets, submissions, revisions, and final deliverables

- Monitor production timelines and proactively identify bottlenecks before they impact deadlines

- Create and improve editing workflows, systems, and processes as the team grows

- Collaborate with leadership to refine creative direction and improve output quality

- Step in on priority edits or complex projects when needed

- Help develop editors through feedback, coaching, and creative guidance

- Work directly with founder to share progress updates and take feedback on close to final edits to be completed by editing staff



What You Bring:

- Proven experience as a professional video editor with a strong portfolio

- Previous experience managing, leading, or mentoring a creative team

- Strong understanding of YouTube, social media content, storytelling, and audience retention

- Advanced proficiency in video editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro required; After Effects experience is a plus)

- Strong creative judgment and the ability to identify what makes content engaging

- Exceptional organization and project management skills

- Ability to communicate feedback clearly and respectfully while maintaining high standards

- Experience managing remote workflows and collaborating through digital tools

- A proactive mindset: you don't just identify problems, you build solutions



Requirements:

- Available and responsive during standard U.S. business hours

- Reliable internet and a functional home office setup

- Ability to manage multiple projects, editors, and deadlines simultaneously

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work



Who Thrives Here



This role is built for someone who understands that great creative teams need more than great editors — they need leadership, systems, and accountability. You are someone who can spot the weak points in a video, give an editor the exact feedback needed to improve it, and build the workflow that prevents the same issues from happening again.



You care about the details: organized project files, clean submissions, clear communication, and deadlines that actually get hit. You enjoy developing people, improving processes, and creating an environment where editors can do their best work.
